butter-streak.name: Butter Streak
butter-streak.desc: Each dash leaves a strip of melted butter that slows pests and burns them for 2 s. Between dashes, it also leaves one on the path Tibo just walked.

chip-shuriken.name: Chip Shuriken
chip-shuriken.desc: Spinning chips that spiral outward.

deep-fryer.name: Deep Fryer
deep-fryer.desc: Sprays hot oil in a cone.

frozen-fries.name: Frozen Fries
frozen-fries.desc: Shoots frozen fries that freeze enemies in place.

fry-knives.name: Fry Knives
fry-knives.desc: Fires sharp fries in the direction Tibo faces.

fry-lance.name: Fry Lance
fry-lance.desc: One very long fry that pierces a whole line.

fry-sentry.name: Fry Cook Sentry
fry-sentry.desc: Drops a fry-cook turret that shoots nearby enemies.

frying-pan.name: Frying Pan
frying-pan.desc: Swings a pan in front of Tibo. Enemy bullets it swats fly back at whoever shot them. Each elite Tibo kills charges the next swing bigger and harder.

grab-bag.name: Grab Bag
grab-bag.desc: Reaches into a sack and fires a different weapon's attack every time.

gravy-boat.name: Gravy Boat
gravy-boat.desc: Pours scalding gravy pools on enemies.

hash-boomerang.name: Hash Boomerang
hash-boomerang.desc: A crispy hash brown that flies out and comes back.

hash-brown-shield.name: Hash Brown Shield
hash-brown-shield.desc: Hash browns circle Tibo. Each takes up to 20 damage of one hit or bullet, then bursts into shards that hurt nearby enemies. Thorns add to shard damage. Broken ones re-crisp one at a time.

hot-potato.name: Hot Potato
hot-potato.desc: Hops from pest to pest and blows up on the last one when its count runs out.

julienne-dash.name: Julienne Dash
julienne-dash.desc: Each dash slices every pest along Tibo's path. Between dashes, it also slices along the path he just walked.

mash-mallet.name: Mash Mallet
mash-mallet.desc: A masher pounds the nearest pest at Tibo's feet.

mash-mortar.name: Mash Mortar
mash-mortar.desc: Sets down a mortar that fires globs of mash at pests far away. Each glob bursts and hits every pest around it.

mash-wave.name: Mash Wave
mash-wave.desc: A ring of mashed potato rolls out from Tibo.

mezzaluna.name: Mezzaluna
mezzaluna.desc: Chops in front of Tibo and behind him. The more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits.

peel-lash.name: Peel Lash
peel-lash.desc: A long potato peel cracks the nearest pest, then jumps to one beside it.

peeler.name: Peeler
peeler.desc: Slashes sideways. From level 4 it flings potato peels through the crowd, one more each level. Tibo's trusty kitchen tool.

potato-battery.name: Potato Battery
potato-battery.desc: Clips a live wire onto a pest. The wire zaps and slows every pest it touches. When the clipped pest dies, the wire jumps to the next one.

potato-rain.name: Potato Rain
potato-rain.desc: Calls down a shower of potatoes around Tibo.

reset-button.name: Reset Button
reset-button.desc: We reset the limits. Clears every enemy on screen. Bosses only flinch.

root-cellar.name: Root Cellar
root-cellar.desc: A ring of cellar cold around Tibo. Pests that cross it take frostbite and freeze for a moment. Bosses only slow.

root-spikes.name: Root Spikes
root-spikes.desc: Roots burst out of the ground under enemies.

rosti-disc.name: Rösti Disc
rosti-disc.desc: A flat rösti that bounces off the edges of the view.

salt-line.name: Salt Line
salt-line.desc: Tibo trails salt while he walks. Pests on the salt are slowed and stung.

seeker-sprouts.name: Seeker Sprouts
seeker-sprouts.desc: Sprouts that steer toward enemies.

skillet-flail.name: Skillet Flail
skillet-flail.desc: An iron skillet swings through the pests in front of Tibo and the pests behind him.

small-fry.name: Small Fry
small-fry.desc: A tiny fry that starts weak and gains damage with every kill it makes, for the rest of the run.

sprout-satellites.name: Sprout Satellites
sprout-satellites.desc: Potato sprouts circle Tibo for a while.

spud-cannon.name: Spud Cannon
spud-cannon.desc: A classic potato gun. Shots burst on impact.

spud-dice.name: Spud Dice
spud-dice.desc: Throws a potato die. 1 is a dud, 2 freezes, 3 burns, 4 splits, 5 pays gold, 6 blows up big.

spud-dynamo.name: Spud Dynamo
spud-dynamo.desc: Two starch sparks orbit Tibo and zap what they touch.

spud-lob.name: Spud Lob
spud-lob.desc: Lobs heavy potatoes high. They crash down through crowds.

starch-bolt.name: Starch Bolt
starch-bolt.desc: Static from a pile of starch strikes random enemies.

starch-chain.name: Starch Chain
starch-chain.desc: A spark that jumps from enemy to enemy.

starch-puddle.name: Starch Puddle
starch-puddle.desc: Drops a puddle of charged starch on the nearest crowd. Pests standing in it are zapped and slowed until it dries.

steam-vent.name: Steam Vent
steam-vent.desc: Hot steam from a baked potato hurts everything close.

tater-mines.name: Tater Mines
tater-mines.desc: Buries spuds that burst when enemies step close.

tater-pup.name: Tater Tot Pup
tater-pup.desc: A loyal tot that follows Tibo and shoots.

tot-toss.name: Tot Toss
tot-toss.desc: Throws tater tots at the nearest enemy.

whisk-vortex.name: Whisk Vortex
whisk-vortex.desc: Spins a whisk whirlpool under the biggest crowd and drags pests into it.

big-fry.name: Big Fry
big-fry.desc: The fry pierces everything and grows bigger as it grows stronger.

bottomless-sack.name: Bottomless Sack
bottomless-sack.desc: Pulls two snacks at a time, and they come out evolved.

cast-iron.name: Cast Iron
cast-iron.desc: Swings both ways. Swatted bullets hit harder, pierce, and home in on pests. Each elite kill charges the next swing.

cold-storage.name: Cold Storage
cold-storage.desc: A wider, colder ring. Pests freeze longer and take harder frostbite.

crater-pound.name: Mash Crater
crater-pound.desc: The masher pounds two pests at Tibo's feet, and each pound lands wider.

dynamo-coil.name: Dynamo Coil
dynamo-coil.desc: The sparks stay out, and a third spark joins them.

factory-reset.name: Factory Reset
factory-reset.desc: A full reset. Clears the screen, keeps the drops, heals Tibo.

fry-fortress.name: Fry Fortress
fry-fortress.desc: Drops three armored fry turrets at a time. They stand longer and their crinkle fries pierce.

ghee-glide.name: Ghee Glide
ghee-glide.desc: Each dash leaves a strip of hot ghee that slows and burns pests. Between dashes, it also leaves one on the path Tibo just walked. Tibo walks 15% faster on the ghee.

golden-harvest.name: Golden Harvest
golden-harvest.desc: A downpour of golden potatoes. Kills can drop gold.

gratin-arc.name: Gratin Arc
gratin-arc.desc: A cheesy arc that chains far and crits often.

gratin-puddle.name: Gratin Puddle
gratin-puddle.desc: A wider puddle of gratin that lasts longer and zaps harder.

gravy-flood.name: Gravy Flood
gravy-flood.desc: Gravy pools grow and drift after Tibo.

hash-bulwark.name: Hash Bulwark
hash-bulwark.desc: More hash browns that re-crisp faster and take up to 30 damage of a hit. Their shards hit harder and freeze enemies.

hashnado.name: Hashnado
hashnado.desc: Hash browns spin out in a crispy storm and return.

inferno-basket.name: Inferno Basket
inferno-basket.desc: A long blast of fryer oil. Double damage to elites and bosses.

iron-flail.name: Iron Flail
iron-flail.desc: A heavier skillet swings wider through the pests in front of Tibo and the pests behind him.

landmine-harvest.name: Landmine Harvest
landmine-harvest.desc: Rotten mines. Enemies they kill drop extra gold.

loaded-dice.name: Loaded Dice
loaded-dice.desc: Rolls two dice and keeps the higher. A pair doubles the throw.

mandoline-fury.name: Mandoline Fury
mandoline-fury.desc: Slices both ways at once and flings potato slices through the crowd. Each slash hit heals Tibo a little.

mashquake.name: Mashquake
mashquake.desc: Mash rolls out in waves that slow what they hit. Each wave flings clumps of mash across the field.

moon-cleaver.name: Moon Cleaver
moon-cleaver.desc: Chops twice in front and once behind, and flicks hash shreds back through the crowd. The more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.desc: Seeker sprouts that split when they hit.

permafrost-fries.name: Permafrost Fries
permafrost-fries.desc: Freezes longer. Frozen enemies take double damage.

pestle-barrage.name: Pestle Barrage
pestle-barrage.desc: Sets down three iron mortars at a time. Their globs burst wider, and each burst throws three small bursts around it.

pressure-cooker.name: Pressure Cooker
pressure-cooker.desc: A huge steam cloud. Each enemy it burns heals Tibo.

railfry.name: Railfry
railfry.desc: Three lances that cross the whole view.

rind-whip.name: Rind Whip
rind-whip.desc: A long potato peel cracks the nearest pest, then jumps across the pests beside it.

rosti-storm.name: Rösti Storm
rosti-storm.desc: Bouncing röstis that burst at every bounce.

sack-of-russets.name: Sack of Russets
sack-of-russets.desc: A whole sack of heavy potatoes, all at once.

salt-flats.name: Salt Flats
salt-flats.desc: A wider salt trail that slows pests harder and pushes them out of Tibo's path.

spicy-hot-potato.name: Spicy Hot Potato
spicy-hot-potato.desc: Hops further, and its blast throws two fresh hot potatoes.

spud-grid.name: Spud Grid
spud-grid.desc: Clips three live wires at once. Each wire zaps harder and bursts when it lets go.

spudzooka.name: Spudzooka
spudzooka.desc: Big potato rockets that split into cluster bursts.

stand-mixer.name: Stand Mixer
stand-mixer.desc: Two whirlpools pull harder. When one ends, it slams its catch together.

taproot-eruption.name: Taproot Eruption
taproot-eruption.desc: Giant roots erupt and throw enemies back.

tot-gatling.name: Tot Gatling
tot-gatling.desc: A nonstop stream of tater tots.

waffle-cut.name: Waffle Cut
waffle-cut.desc: Each dash cuts a cross through every pest along Tibo's path, then cuts it twice more, 0.5 s apart. Between dashes, it also cuts along the path he just walked.

baked-alaska.name: Baked Alaska
baked-alaska.desc: A hot potato that freezes each enemy it hops to. Frozen enemies take double damage. Its last hop shatters every frozen enemy nearby and throws two fresh hot potatoes. Frees a weapon slot.

cold-frame.name: Cold Frame
cold-frame.desc: Sprouts circle Tibo forever inside a wide cold ring. Pests that cross the ring or meet a sprout freeze for a moment. Bosses only slow. Frees a weapon slot.

fry-brigade.name: Fry Brigade
fry-brigade.desc: Tot pups in fry-cook hats follow Tibo, shoot, and plant fry turrets as they go. Frees a weapon slot.

gravy-whirlpool.name: Gravy Whirlpool
gravy-whirlpool.desc: Scalding gravy whirlpools drag in crowds and burn them. They grow, drift after Tibo and slam their catch. Frees a weapon slot.

griddle-guard.name: Griddle Guard
griddle-guard.desc: Hash browns circle Tibo and block hits and bullets. Where one blocks a bullet, the pan swings there and swats it back at the shooter. Broken hash browns burst into freezing shards, and the pan swings both ways. Frees a weapon slot.

hungry-sprouts.name: Hungry Sprouts
hungry-sprouts.desc: Homing sprouts that split when they hit and gain damage with every kill they make, for the rest of the run. Frees a weapon slot.

knife-block.name: Knife Block
knife-block.desc: Slices in front of Tibo and behind him at once and flings potato slices both ways. Each slash hit heals Tibo a little, and the more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits. Frees a weapon slot.

root-current.name: Root Current
root-current.desc: Clips three live wires. Every second, roots burst under each wired pest, throw pests back and carry the zap to every pest they hit. Frees a weapon slot.

salted-butter.name: Salted Butter
salted-butter.desc: Every step and every dash leaves salted butter that stings and slows pests, pushes them out of Tibo's path and sets them burning. Tibo walks 15% faster on it. Frees a weapon slot.

sowing-season.name: Sowing Season
sowing-season.desc: Golden potatoes rain down, and each one that misses stays planted as a mine. Kills can drop gold. Frees a weapon slot.

spud-artillery.name: Spud Artillery
spud-artillery.desc: A barrage of lobbed potatoes that explode. Frees a weapon slot.

starch-supercell.name: Starch Supercell
starch-supercell.desc: Lightning that chains between enemies. Frees a weapon slot.

gem-sling.name: Gem Sling
gem-sling.desc: Each XP gem Tibo picks up flings a potato wedge along his heading. More amount flings more wedges in a fan.

hot-streak.name: Hot Streak
hot-streak.desc: A fry-oil slash sweeps the pests around Tibo. Every second that Tibo keeps moving without being hit lights a flame at his feet, up to five, and each flame makes the slash reach farther and come faster. A hit puts out two flames, and a stop puts them all out.

locked-gatling.name: Locked Gatling
locked-gatling.desc: Each 2 second burst locks onto the nearest pest's angle and keeps firing tots that way while Tibo moves. More amount fires more lanes side by side.

mash-snowball.name: Mash Snowball
mash-snowball.desc: A ball of mash rolls behind Tibo and grows with every step he runs. When he stops or turns hard, it surges ahead along his last heading and splatters pests by its size. A full ball lets go on its own.

seed-potato.name: Seed Potato
seed-potato.desc: Tibo tosses a seed potato onto the nearest crowd. It sprouts in three stages and zaps pests around it every second. Walk over it to harvest a burst that grows with the stage and catch the potato to throw again. Left alone, it bursts weakly after 8 s.

spud-fence.name: Spud Fence
spud-fence.desc: Every 60 units Tibo walks, he plants a starch post. A live arc runs from each post to the one before and zaps pests that cross it. At most four posts stand, and a still Tibo plants none.

tailgate-fries.name: Tailgate Fries
tailgate-fries.desc: While Tibo runs, fries spray out behind him into whatever is chasing him. Standing still, he drips one fry behind him.

tater-twirl.name: Tater Twirl
tater-twirl.desc: Hash-brown wheels circle Tibo, spinning and hitting as fast as he runs. When he stands still they slow to a crawl.

tot-stampede.name: Tot Stampede
tot-stampede.desc: Every 40 units Tibo walks, a tater tot hops out behind him and charges the nearest pest, popping on contact. A still Tibo makes no tots.

gem-catapult.name: Gem Catapult
gem-catapult.desc: Each XP gem Tibo picks up flings a potato wedge along his heading, with each wedge hitting far harder. More amount flings more wedges in a fan.

mash-avalanche.name: Mash Avalanche
mash-avalanche.desc: The mash ball hits harder, and on its first hit it breaks into three smaller balls that fan out along its heading and splatter pests by their size.

potato-patch.name: Potato Patch
potato-patch.desc: Tibo tosses three fertilized seed potatoes at a time, and up to six grow at once. Their zaps and harvest bursts hit much harder. Walk over a plant to harvest it and throw again.

spark-corral.name: Spark Corral
spark-corral.desc: Every 60 units Tibo walks, he plants a charged starch post. A braided arc twice as wide runs between the posts and zaps pests much harder. More posts stand, and each lasts 9 s.

tailgate-party.name: Tailgate Party
tailgate-party.desc: Buttered fries spray out behind Tibo while he runs and hit much harder. Standing still, he drips one behind him.

tater-minigun.name: Tater Minigun
tater-minigun.desc: The same locked 2 second bursts, one lane per amount, with each tot hitting far harder.

tater-twister.name: Tater Twister
tater-twister.desc: More hash-brown wheels circle Tibo on a wider orbit and hit harder, spinning as fast as he runs. When he stands still they slow to a crawl.

tot-cavalry.name: Tot Cavalry
tot-cavalry.desc: Every 40 units Tibo walks, a squad of buttered tater tots charges out behind him and rams through two pests each. A still Tibo makes no tots.

wildfire-roast.name: Wildfire Roast
wildfire-roast.desc: Hot Streak's slash burns white-hot. Each flame Tibo keeps lit makes the sweep reach much farther, up to five. A hit puts out two flames, and a stop puts them all out.

grease-fire.name: Grease Fire
grease-fire.desc: Wildfire Roast's sweep sprays a huge cloud of burning fryer oil, and the flames at Tibo's feet light the oil into burning puddles as he runs. Each flame he keeps lit makes the sweep reach much farther, up to five. A hit puts out two flames, and a stop puts them all out. Frees a weapon slot.

hash-carousel.name: Hash Carousel
hash-carousel.desc: Golden hash-brown wheels circle Tibo and throw hash browns that fly out and back. They spin and throw as fast as he runs, and slow to a crawl when he stands still. Frees a weapon slot.

loot-sling.name: Loot Sling
loot-sling.desc: Pulls two evolved snacks from the sack at a time, and each XP gem Tibo picks up flings one more along his heading. Frees a weapon slot.

starch-garden.name: Starch Garden
starch-garden.desc: Tibo tosses fertilized seed potatoes onto crowds, and every 60 units he walks he plants a starch post with a seed potato at its foot. Every plant grows in three stages and zaps pests around it, and the arcs between posts grow stronger with their plants. Walk over a plant to harvest a burst. Frees a weapon slot.

tot-barrage.name: Tot Barrage
tot-barrage.desc: A nonstop stream of tater tots. Each tot that hits pops out a tot that charges the next pest, and walking sends squads of charging tots out behind Tibo. Frees a weapon slot.

afterburner-fries.name: Afterburner Fries
afterburner-fries.desc: Each dash blasts a fan of hot fries backward from where the dash started.

broadside.name: Broadside
broadside.desc: Fires a row of powder shells out of both sides of Tibo, square to the way he runs. Each shell bursts on the first pest it meets or where it lands.

comet-scythe.name: Comet Scythe
comet-scythe.desc: A scythe blade circles Tibo. Every two laps its orbit swings out wide and pulls back in close, so it cuts both the pests at Tibo's feet and the ring beyond them.

harvest-moon.name: Harvest Moon
harvest-moon.desc: A moon spud circles Tibo. Each pest it touches rides its orbit for a moment, then is flung out and hit. A flung pest cannot be caught again for a few seconds, and bosses are too heavy to catch.

hash-hawk.name: Hash Hawk
hash-hawk.desc: A hash-brown hawk circles above Tibo. Every few seconds it dives on the toughest pest in reach, a boss first, then an elite, and strikes everything beside it.

mash-golem.name: Mash Golem
mash-golem.desc: A golem of mash rises in front of Tibo and stomps the way he faces, shoving pests out of its path to open a lane. At the end of its walk it slams the ground and crumbles.

mash-landing.name: Mash Landing
mash-landing.desc: Each dash ends in a mash shockwave that hits every pest around Tibo and shoves it back.

peel-phantom.name: Peel Phantom
peel-phantom.desc: Each dash leaves a peel husk of Tibo where the dash began. Nearby pests chase the husk until it bursts.

skipping-cannonball.name: Skipping Cannonball
skipping-cannonball.desc: A cannonball skips along the way Tibo faces and bursts at every bounce, each burst bigger than the last. Amount adds a bounce.

sprout-squad.name: Sprout Squad
sprout-squad.desc: A pest that falls can sprout a seedling where it fell. Each seedling hops to the nearest pest and bites it until it wilts. More amount lets more seedlings grow at once.

spud-decoy.name: Spud Decoy
spud-decoy.desc: Every few seconds Tibo plants a wind-up spud behind him. Pests nearby walk to it instead of him, and then it bursts.

clockwork-spud.name: Clockwork Spud
clockwork-spud.desc: Tibo plants wind-up spuds behind him, and pests nearby walk to them. Each burst leaves a smaller spud that winds up and bursts once more.

eclipse-scythe.name: Eclipse Scythe
eclipse-scythe.desc: Sun and moon blades circle Tibo. While the sun blades swing out wide, the moon blades cut close at his feet, then they trade places, so pests near and far are always in reach.

full-broadside.name: Full Broadside
full-broadside.desc: Fires two rows of powder shells out of both sides of Tibo. Each shell bursts on the first pest it meets or where it lands, and throws three small shells that burst where they land.

hash-harrier.name: Hash Harrier
hash-harrier.desc: Ember-winged hash-brown harriers circle above Tibo and dive on the toughest pest in reach, a boss first, then an elite. Each dive leaves burning hash crumbs that scorch pests standing on them.

hunters-moon.name: Hunter's Moon
hunters-moon.desc: Bigger moon spuds circle Tibo and catch pests from farther out. Each flung pest bursts into moon dust where it lands and hits the pests around it. Bosses are too heavy to catch.

jet-fryer.name: Jet Fryer
jet-fryer.desc: Each dash blasts two fans of hot fries backward from where the dash started. Every fry splashes hot oil where it lands.

mash-colossus.name: Mash Colossus
mash-colossus.desc: A bigger golem of mash stomps the way Tibo faces. Each step leaves a patch of mash that slows pests, and its last slam sends a ring of mash rolling out.

mash-meteor.name: Mash Meteor
mash-meteor.desc: Each dash ends in a bigger mash shockwave, and a second, wider ring follows a moment later.

peel-poltergeist.name: Peel Poltergeist
peel-poltergeist.desc: Each dash leaves a haunted peel husk where the dash began. Pests chase it into its spinning peels, then it bursts into a ring of peels.

root-legion.name: Root Legion
root-legion.desc: More seedlings sprout and live longer, and a new one rises beside Tibo every half second. Each seedling that wilts leaves a root snare that holds pests in place for a moment.

russet-ricochet.name: Russet Ricochet
russet-ricochet.desc: Russet cannonballs skip out in a fan along the way Tibo faces and burst at every bounce, each burst bigger than the last. Every burst throws a small spud at a nearby pest, and the spud bursts too. Amount adds a bounce.

fry-by.name: Fry-By
fry-by.desc: Fries spray behind Tibo while he runs. Each dash blasts a wide double fan of fries back along his path, and every fan fry splashes hot oil where it lands. Frees a weapon slot.

gravy-pack.name: Gravy Pack
gravy-pack.desc: Four gravy-glazed tot pups run with Tibo. Each bite heals him 0.05 HP.

bacon-bits.name: Bacon Bits
bacon-bits.desc: +12% damage to elites and bosses per level.

butter-socks.name: Butter Socks
butter-socks.desc: +1 dash charge at levels 1, 3 and 5. Each level cuts the dash cooldown by 6%.

four-eyed-spud.name: Four-Eyed Spud
four-eyed-spud.desc: +10% luck per level. Shot weapons fire +1 projectile at levels 2 and 4.

gpu.name: GPU
gpu.desc: +1 projectile. Firing builds heat. At full heat, weapons fire at half speed for 3s. Each level adds fire rate and cooling.

hot-sauce.name: Hot Sauce
hot-sauce.desc: Raises crit chance with each level. The higher your crit chance, the less each level adds.

rotten-spud.name: Rotten Spud
rotten-spud.desc: +10% curse per level: stronger, faster, more enemies, but more XP and gold.

starch-plating.name: Starch Plating
starch-plating.desc: Cuts the damage of each hit, more with each level. Stronger enemies get through more.

thick-skin.name: Thick Skin
thick-skin.desc: Raises the chance to dodge a hit with each level. The higher your dodge chance, the less each level adds.

hot-start.name: Hot Start
hot-start.desc: After each dash, every weapon reloads 60% faster for 1.3 s. Each level adds 0.3 s. Tibo glows while it lasts.

couch-potato.name: Couch Potato
couch-potato.desc: While Tibo stands still, damage rises 4% a second per level, up to 20% per level. Moving resets it.

gravy-splash.name: Gravy Splash
gravy-splash.desc: Every 0.5 s, the HP Tibo healed splashes out as damage to nearby enemies: 100% of it per level.

hash-rush.name: Hash Rush
hash-rush.desc: Each dash in the last 4 s adds 4% damage per level, counting up to 3 dashes.

hearty-helping.name: Hearty Helping
hearty-helping.desc: +2% damage for every 50 max HP Tibo gains above his starting max HP. Each level adds another 2% per 50.

lean-lunch.name: Lean Lunch
lean-lunch.desc: +4% damage and -2% cooldown per level for each empty weapon slot.

mash-finisher.name: Mash Finisher
mash-finisher.desc: A hit mashes any pest left below 2% of its max HP per level, up to 15%. Elites mash at half that. Bosses never do.

packed-pan.name: Packed Pan
packed-pan.desc: +1% damage for each pest inside Tibo's pickup range, up to 10 pests. Each level adds another 1% per pest.

peel-out.name: Peel Out
peel-out.desc: After Tibo dodges a hit, his weapons deal double damage for 2 s. Peels spin around him while it lasts.

spry-sprout.name: Spry Sprout
spry-sprout.desc: Each level cuts the dash cooldown by 5%.

tater-trot.name: Tater Trot
tater-trot.desc: Each 1% of bonus move speed adds 1% fire rate, up to 8% per level.

aged-russet.name: Aged Russet
aged-russet.desc: +0.5% damage per level for each level Tibo has gained this run, up to +10% per level.

clean-plate.name: Clean Plate
clean-plate.desc: After 5 s without a hit, +12% crit chance per level. A hit sheds one level.

baked-buckler.name: Baked Buckler
baked-buckler.desc: Cuts the damage of each hit. Stronger enemies get through more.

coal-baked-spud.name: Coal-Baked Spud
coal-baked-spud.desc: 15% of hits set enemies on fire.

coupon-book.name: Coupon Book
coupon-book.desc: Everything you buy costs less.

freezer-burn.name: Freezer Burn
freezer-burn.desc: Frozen enemies shatter when they die and freeze enemies nearby.

ghost-pepper.name: Ghost Pepper
ghost-pepper.desc: Tibo stays untouchable for 0.15 s after each dash ends.

ghost-skin.name: Ghost Skin
ghost-skin.desc: Raises the chance to dodge a hit. The higher your dodge chance, the less it adds.

hot-pepper.name: Hot Pepper
hot-pepper.desc: Raises crit chance. The higher your crit chance, the less it adds.

philosophers-potato.name: Philosopher's Potato
philosophers-potato.desc: +10% to damage, area, speed and duration.

porcupine-spud.name: Porcupine Spud
porcupine-spud.desc: When Tibo is hit, he fires 10 fries outward.

second-spud.name: Second Spud
second-spud.desc: Revive once with half HP.

spicy-croquette.name: Spicy Croquette
spicy-croquette.desc: 12% of hits burst in a fiery blast.

static-tot.name: Static Tot
static-tot.desc: 10% of hits arc lightning to 3 more enemies.

thorny-jacket.name: Thorny Jacket
thorny-jacket.desc: Enemies that hit Tibo take 8 damage.

wandering-eyes.name: Wandering Eyes
wandering-eyes.desc: 20% of kills send 2 potato eyes after other enemies.

all-seeing-spud.name: All-Seeing Spud
all-seeing-spud.desc: 35% of kills send 4 potato eyes that pierce through enemies.

bonfire-spud.name: Bonfire Spud
bonfire-spud.desc: 25% of hits set enemies on fire, and the fire spreads to the enemies around them.

fry-volcano.name: Fry Volcano
fry-volcano.desc: When Tibo is hit, he erupts in a blast and fires 24 fries that pierce through enemies.

glacier-spud.name: Glacier Spud
glacier-spud.desc: 30% of kills shatter, freezing nearby enemies and slowing the enemies around them.

kaboom-spud.name: Kaboom Spud
kaboom-spud.desc: 25% of kills explode, hitting nearby enemies for half the dead enemy's max HP.

magma-croquette.name: Magma Croquette
magma-croquette.desc: 20% of hits erupt in a huge blast that sets enemies on fire.

meteor-russet.name: Meteor Russet
meteor-russet.desc: 3% of hits call down a meteor for 20× damage that also craters enemies around it.

storm-tot.name: Storm Tot
storm-tot.desc: 15% of hits arc lightning to 6 more enemies, with a thunderclap at each one.

static-socks.name: Static Socks
static-socks.desc: Each dash ends with a starch bolt on the 3 nearest enemies, 176 damage each.

frozen-pea.name: Frozen Pea
frozen-pea.desc: 8% of hits freeze the enemy for 1 s. Bosses slow instead.

fry-fuel.name: Fry Fuel
fry-fuel.desc: Every 30 kills refills one dash charge.

lightning-spud.name: Lightning Spud
lightning-spud.desc: 6% of hits call down lightning on the enemies around them.

mash-splat.name: Mash Splat
mash-splat.desc: Each dash lands in a mash splat that hits the enemies around Tibo.

midnight-fries.name: Midnight Fries
midnight-fries.desc: +5% damage. After 20:00, damage grows 6% more each minute.

moon-dust.name: Moon Dust
moon-dust.desc: 15% of kills burst into moon dust that slows enemies nearby.

receipt-spud.name: Receipt Spud
receipt-spud.desc: Each chest or crate you open gives +2% damage for the rest of the run.

souffle-spud.name: Soufflé Spud
souffle-spud.desc: When Tibo is hit, he puffs up and shoves nearby enemies away.

spud-spring.name: Spud Spring
spud-spring.desc: Cuts the dash cooldown by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times.

tailwind-tater.name: Tailwind Tater
tailwind-tater.desc: +1% damage for every 2% move speed above base.

tater-treat.name: Tater Treat
tater-treat.desc: Dogs use their abilities 25% more often.

mash-crater.name: Mash Crater
mash-crater.desc: Each dash lands in a wide mash crater that throws 8 hash browns outward.

copper-tot.name: Copper Tot
copper-tot.desc: Picking up gold has a 25% chance to hit a random pest on screen for heavy damage.

panic-fry.name: Panic Fry
panic-fry.desc: The first time each minute Tibo drops below 50% HP, pests slow by 5% for 3 s and his hits deal 25% more damage.

second-helping.name: Second Helping
second-helping.desc: Each snack Tibo eats at full HP gives +1% damage for the rest of the run, up to +10% per level.

spark-spud.name: Spark Spud
spark-spud.desc: Walking charges a spark. Every 300 units Tibo walks, it bursts, hitting and stunning pests around him.

spud-purse.name: Spud Purse
spud-purse.desc: Every 100 units Tibo walks, he drops a coin, 16 units sooner per extra copy.

warm-bowl.name: Warm Bowl
warm-bowl.desc: Charging any activation ring leaves a healing pool there for 10 s.

amusing.title: The Festival Mascot
amusing.desc: The potato festival's fluffy pink mascot. He waves hello, throws hearts and stuffing, then leaps in for a hug that squeezes the starch out of you.
amusing.name: amusing

beetle-queen.name: Colorado Queen
beetle-queen.title: Mother of Beetles
beetle-queen.desc: The striped potato beetle queen. Her brood hatches in a ring around Tibo.

compost-titan.name: Compost Titan
compost-titan.title: The Rot Heap
compost-titan.desc: A heap of rotting leaves and mulch. Maggots pour out of it.

deep-freezer.name: The Deep Freezer
deep-freezer.title: Keeper of Frozen Fries
deep-freezer.desc: A walking chest freezer. Its ice cubes freeze you for a moment.

fryer-king.name: The Fryer King
fryer-king.title: Lord of the Hot Oil
fryer-king.desc: A crowned deep fryer. It spits rings of boiling oil.

grater-golem.name: Grater Golem
grater-golem.title: The Shredder
grater-golem.desc: A box grater on legs. It charges along a marked line.

great-wireworm.name: The Great Wireworm
great-wireworm.title: Borer of Tubers
great-wireworm.desc: A huge wireworm. It burrows and bursts up under Tibo.

harvester.name: The Harvester
harvester.title: End of the Season
harvester.desc: A combine harvester. It charges down long lanes. Every potato's last fear.

ketchup-kraken.name: Ketchup Kraken
ketchup-kraken.title: Terror of the Bog
ketchup-kraken.desc: A kraken of ketchup. Its tentacles slam down in a pattern.

late-blight.name: Late Blight
late-blight.title: The Famine Fog
late-blight.desc: A creeping cloud of blight. Spore clouds bloom where it points.

sir-strawman.name: Sir Strawman
sir-strawman.title: Guardian of the Rows
sir-strawman.desc: A scarecrow knight. It throws fans of sharp straw.

the-mandoline.name: The Mandoline
the-mandoline.title: Slicer of Fries
the-mandoline.desc: A living mandoline slicer. Its blade sweeps across in lanes.

the-masher.name: The Masher
the-masher.title: Kitchen Enforcer
the-masher.desc: A giant potato masher. It slams where Tibo stands.

pack-lord.name: Pack Lord
pack-lord.title: Leader of the Hunt
pack-lord.desc: A giant alpha that runs the packs. It leaps in chained lunges and calls its hunters, and every pack scatters when it falls.

root-hydra.name: The Root Hydra
root-hydra.title: Three Heads
root-hydra.desc: A root-crusted hydra that bursts from the ground. Its three heads bite down in lanes.

root-hydra-frenzy.name: The Root Hydra
root-hydra-frenzy.title: Five Heads
root-hydra-frenzy.desc: Five heads, red-eyed and wounded. It lunges.

root-hydra-head.name: Root Hydra Head
root-hydra-head.title: Burrowing
root-hydra-head.desc: One of the Hydra's heads bursts from the ground, spits mud and sinks again. Every hit it takes now weakens the Hydra at 29:00.

root-hydra-mire.name: The Root Hydra
root-hydra-mire.title: Pools
root-hydra-mire.desc: Two heads dive into the ground and spit mud pools across the field.

root-hydra-stump.name: The Root Hydra
root-hydra-stump.title: Stump
root-hydra-stump.desc: Its middle head falls. Mud Golems crawl out of the ground.

queen.name: The Queen
queen.title: The Island Court
queen.desc: Her three attendants guard her from every blow, and return when left fallen.

shell-titan.name: The Shell Titan
shell-titan.title: Three Plates
shell-titan.desc: Its three plates open in order after each charge. Break through while one is exposed.

chip-canyons.name: Chip Canyons
chip-canyons.desc: Cliffs of stacked potato chips. Crabs scuttle in the cracks.

coin-laundromat.name: Coin Laundromat
coin-laundromat.desc: Rows of washers hum in an empty field. Nobody knows who pays the power bill.

compost-caves.name: Compost Caves
compost-caves.desc: Damp tunnels under the compost heap. Spore vents sting.

crop-circle.name: Crop Circle
crop-circle.desc: Wheat pressed flat in perfect rings. Something landed here and left its crew behind.

frozen-tundra.name: Frozen-Fries Tundra
frozen-tundra.desc: A frozen plain of fries. Frost patches chill Tibo.

fry-oil-desert.name: Fry-Oil Desert
fry-oil-desert.desc: Hot sand and pools of fryer oil that burn.

fry-palace.name: Fry Palace Drive-Thru
fry-palace.desc: A drive-thru alone in the wild, still open. Gulls and raccoons rule the parking lot.

gutterball-lanes.name: Gutterball Lanes
gutterball-lanes.desc: A bowling alley with no walls and no roof. The lanes are still oiled and the pins still stand.

ketchup-bog.name: Ketchup Bog
ketchup-bog.desc: A hot red marsh. Puddles of ketchup burn and slow.

mash-swamp.name: Mash Swamp
mash-swamp.desc: Knee-deep mashed potato. It slows Tibo down.

peel-forest.name: Peel Forest
peel-forest.desc: Trees with bark like potato peel. Thorny brambles scratch.

potato-field.name: Potato Field
potato-field.desc: Neat rows of potato plants. Where every run starts.

russet-moor.name: Russet Moor
russet-moor.desc: A misty moor of heather, standing stones and a ruined windmill. The packs hunt here.

vinegar-shoals.name: Vinegar Shoals
vinegar-shoals.desc: Golden tidal flats of wet sand and sour pools. Things burrow under the shallows.

duchess-gardens.name: Duchess Gardens
duchess-gardens.desc: A clipped hedge maze of jade lawns and grey gravel walks. The Court holds its audience here.

roast-caldera.name: Roast Caldera
roast-caldera.desc: Pale ash over a cooling caldera, cut by narrow channels of slow lava. The Shell's armoured beasts wade through it.

harvest-moon.name: Harvest Moon
harvest-moon.announce: Harvest Moon: double gold for 30 s

loose-change.name: Loose Change
loose-change.announce: Loose change in the dryers: double gold for 20 s

lost-saucer.name: Lost Saucer
lost-saucer.announce: A lost saucer! Shoot it down for gold!

lunch-rush.name: Lunch Rush
lunch-rush.announce: Lunch rush! Gulls dive across the lot!

strike.name: Strike
strike.announce: Strike! Bowling balls roll in from every side!

crab-tide.name: Crab Tide
crab-tide.announce: Crab tide! Crabs scuttle in from every side!

big-gust.name: Big Gust
big-gust.announce: A gust pulls every gem, coin and snack to Tibo!

fry-rush.name: Fry Rush
fry-rush.announce: Weapons fire 30% faster for 15 s!

picnic.name: Picnic
picnic.announce: Snacks rain around Tibo for 10 s!

beagle.name: Scout
beagle.desc: Points to the nearest crate, shrine or dog, and finds loose gold.

collie.name: Moss
collie.desc: Every few seconds, shoves the enemies around you back.

corgi.name: Waffles
corgi.desc: Barks every few seconds and freezes nearby enemies (not bosses).

dachshund.name: Frank
dachshund.desc: Digs up gold every few seconds, and sometimes a snack or a reroll.

greyhound.name: Zoom
greyhound.desc: Every few seconds, sprints through a line of enemies and hurts them all.

pomchi.name: Zelda
pomchi.desc: Marks the nearest elite or loot runner so it takes more damage.

pomeranian.name: Link
pomeranian.desc: His fluff takes the next hit on you, then he sneezes pests away.

retriever.name: Biscuit
retriever.desc: Every few seconds, brings gems, gold and snacks to you from far away.

saint-bernard.name: Barrel
saint-bernard.desc: When your health drops low, runs to you and heals you.

terrier.name: Pip
terrier.desc: Darts at the nearest enemy and bites it, about once a second.

zelda-and-link.name: Zelda & Link
zelda-and-link.desc: Link's fluff and Zelda's marks, plus an eclipse that shields you and marks every pest near you.

sigkitten.name: SIGKITTEN
sigkitten.desc: Hacks the pests' shots: they slow down as they near you, so you have more time to dodge. SIGSTOP, kind of.

dalmatian.name: Sprinkles
dalmatian.desc: Bites a nearby enemy every 2 seconds and gives it one of your burns, slows or freezes.

husky.name: Echo
husky.desc: Howls every few seconds, and every other dog in your pack acts at once.

newfoundland.name: Buoy
newfoundland.desc: Leaps at enemy shots that come close to you and catches them.

saluki.name: Gale
saluki.desc: Runs at your heels and lunges at a pest every 2 seconds, harder the faster you move.

shiba.name: Kiko
shiba.desc: When Tibo kills an elite, Kiko calls two spirit pups that hunt pests for 6 s.

whippet.name: Whip
whippet.desc: When Tibo is hit, Whip tugs him a short dash away, once every 15 s.

paidChest.name: Potato Crate
paidChest.desc: Costs gold. Holds an item. Each crate costs more than the last.

chargeShrine.name: Spud Shrine
chargeShrine.desc: Stand inside to charge it, then pick a stat.

curseShrine.name: Moldy Shrine
curseShrine.desc: Take curse for a pile of gold. Curses bring extra elites and bosses.

microwave.name: Microwave
microwave.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then copy one of your items. The copy melts another item of the same rarity.

crops.name: Crop Patch
crops.desc: Break it for gold and a snack.

eliteNest.name: Beetle Nest
eliteNest.desc: An elite waits here. It drops a chest.

bossLair.name: Boss Lair
bossLair.desc: A boss sleeps here. It guards a big chest.

dog.name: Stray Dog
dog.desc: A good dog looking for a friend. Walk up to it.

botDock.name: Bot Dock
botDock.desc: Stand by it to call a swarm of Grok Bots.

whetstone.name: Spud Whetstone
whetstone.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then level up one of your weapons.

dinnerBell.name: Dinner Bell
dinnerBell.desc: Ring it to call a ring of pests. They drop triple XP.

taterSlots.name: Tater Slots
taterSlots.desc: Pay gold to spin. Match two for an item.

seedVault.name: Seed Vault
seedVault.desc: Stand by it to charge it for rerolls, a skip and a banish.

taterMagnet.name: Tater Magnet
taterMagnet.desc: Stand by it to pull in every gem and coin.

rootTunnel.name: Root Tunnel
rootTunnel.desc: Stand by it to tunnel to a far place.

spudFreezer.name: Spud Freezer
spudFreezer.desc: Stand by it to freeze every enemy on the map for 7.5 s. Bosses only slow down.

frenzyFryer.name: Frenzy Fryer
frenzyFryer.desc: Stand by it for a 20 s frenzy.

goldenShrine.name: Golden Spud Shrine
goldenShrine.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then pick a big blessing.

dogKennel.name: Dog Kennel
dogKennel.desc: Stand by it to buy up to three levels for your dogs.

bubbler.name: Bubble Bot
bubbler.desc: Wraps Tibo in a bubble for a moment and patches him up.

gifter.name: Gift Bot
gifter.desc: Drops a handful of coins, a gem worth part of a level, and now and then a Bot Beacon.

tidier.name: Tidy Bot
tidier.desc: Sweeps every nearby gem and coin over to Tibo.

zapper.name: Zapper Bot
zapper.desc: Zaps the closest bugs. Elites only get a jolt, and bosses are too big to zap.

frozen-fries-big-chill.name: Big Chill
frozen-fries-big-chill.desc: Fries aim at the biggest pest.

frozen-fries-brain-freeze.name: Brain Freeze
frozen-fries-brain-freeze.desc: Every third volley hits much harder.

fry-knives-back-knives.name: Back Knives
fry-knives-back-knives.desc: Every other knife flies backward.

fry-knives-knife-storm.name: Knife Storm
fry-knives-knife-storm.desc: Holds, then throws three volleys at once.

fry-lance-jouster.name: Jouster
fry-lance-jouster.desc: The lance aims at the biggest pest.

fry-sentry-rush-hour.name: Rush Hour
fry-sentry-rush-hour.desc: Holds, then sets down twice as many.

gravy-boat-big-spill.name: Big Spill
gravy-boat-big-spill.desc: Pools land under the biggest pest.

gravy-boat-full-pour.name: Full Pour
gravy-boat-full-pour.desc: Holds, then pours three times at once.

root-spikes-deep-roots.name: Deep Roots
root-spikes-deep-roots.desc: Spikes hit the biggest pests first.

rosti-disc-disc-wheel.name: Disc Wheel
rosti-disc-disc-wheel.desc: Discs fly out evenly all around.

seeker-sprouts-burst.name: Sprout Burst
seeker-sprouts-burst.desc: Holds, then bursts out all around.

seeker-sprouts-hopper.name: Hopper
seeker-sprouts-hopper.desc: Sprouts hop on, then burst.

spud-cannon-bullseye.name: Bullseye
spud-cannon-bullseye.desc: Shells aim at the biggest pest.

spud-cannon-volley-fire.name: Volley Fire
spud-cannon-volley-fire.desc: Holds, then fires three volleys at once.

spud-lob-wide-lob.name: Wide Lob
spud-lob-wide-lob.desc: Potatoes land much farther apart.

starch-bolt-lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
starch-bolt-lightning-rod.desc: Bolts strike the biggest pests first.

starch-bolt-storm-front.name: Storm Front
starch-bolt-storm-front.desc: Holds, then strikes three times at once.

steam-vent-scald.name: Scald
steam-vent-scald.desc: Steam hurts elites and bosses much more.

tot-toss-tot-pile.name: Tot Pile
tot-toss-tot-pile.desc: Holds, then throws three volleys at once.

tot-toss-tot-sniper.name: Tot Sniper
tot-toss-tot-sniper.desc: Tots aim at the biggest pest.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.desc: Every 25 seconds an aurora makes experience worth triple and doubles Tibo's pickup reach. Tibo starts deep in the Potato Field.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: A blizzard blows all run. Tibo grows colder away from the campfires and slows as he freezes, and a campfire warms him back up. Tibo starts deep in the Frozen Tundra.

bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodmoon.desc: Elites come twice as often and hit harder, and each one drops triple experience and coins. Tibo starts deep in the Mash Swamp.

drop.name: Pest Drop
drop.desc: Pests fall from the sky around Tibo instead of walking in, and a shadow on the ground shows where each one will land.

echo.name: Echo Day
echo.desc: Every third hit from Tibo's weapons echoes a moment later and strikes every pest close to it. Tibo starts deep in the Peel Forest.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc: Only a ring of light stays around Tibo. Pests inside it take more damage, and pests outside it show only their eyes. Tibo starts deep in the Compost Caves.

meteors.name: Meteor Shower
meteors.desc: Meteors fall on the thickest crowds near Tibo, and each crater slows the pests inside it for a while. Tibo starts deep in the Chip Canyons.

migration.name: Migration
migration.desc: Every minute a herd of beetles charges across the map in a straight band, and each beetle drops rich experience. Tibo starts deep in the Peel Forest.

rings.name: Sprout Rings
rings.desc: Rings of sprouting potatoes dot the ground, and Tibo's weapons fire faster while he stands in one. Tibo starts deep in the Mash Swamp.

sizes.name: Odd Sizes
sizes.desc: A quarter of the pests are giants with more health and experience, and a quarter are tiny and fast. Tibo starts deep in the Crop Circle.

swarm.name: Swarm Day
swarm.desc: Every pest comes with a twin, so there are twice as many pests, each with half the health and half the experience. Tibo starts deep in the Potato Field.

tilt.name: Gravity Tilt
tilt.desc: The ground tilts and turns every 30 seconds, and pests and pickups slide downhill. Tibo starts deep in the Chip Canyons.

warp.name: Time Warp
warp.desc: Every 15 seconds time warps, and pests, bosses and enemy bullets move at half pace for 3 seconds. Tibo starts deep in the Compost Caves.

fog.name: Thick Fog
fog.desc: Fog fills the Compost Caves. Pests and bosses that lose Tibo in the fog creep along until they come close, and Tibo starts deep in the caves.

hail.name: Hailstorm
hail.desc: Hail pelts the pests near Tibo every moment, hurting and knocking back every pest and boss a stone lands on, and Tibo starts deep in the Peel Forest.

heat.name: Heatwave
heat.desc: Heat shimmers all run, burning ground spreads twice as often, and Tibo starts deep in the Fry-Oil Desert.

night.name: Long Night
night.desc: Night falls all run, pests and bosses rush in faster from the dark outside Tibo's light, and Tibo starts deep in the Potato Field.

rain.name: Downpour
rain.desc: Rain falls all run, mud puddles spread twice as often and wider, and Tibo starts deep in the Mash Swamp.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: Sand blows across the Fry-Oil Desert and piles into drifts that slow Tibo but not pests and bosses, and Tibo starts deep in the desert.

snow.name: Big Freeze
snow.desc: Snow falls all run, everyone moves slower, frost patches spread twice as often, and Tibo starts deep in the Frozen-Fries Tundra.

storm.name: Thunderstorm
storm.desc: Lightning strikes the thickest crowd near Tibo every few seconds, hurting and knocking back every pest and boss in the blast, and Tibo starts deep in the Ketchup Bog.

comet-treads.name: Comet Treads
comet-treads.desc: Zone and storm effects last 25% longer.

crown-of-plenty.name: Crown of Plenty
crown-of-plenty.desc: Shot weapons fire one more projectile.

ember-striders.name: Ember Striders
ember-striders.desc: Shots pierce one more enemy.

fryers-apron.name: Fryer's Apron
fryers-apron.desc: Killing an elite adds {elite} s of Frenzy and killing a boss adds {boss} s, up to {cap} s. In Frenzy, weapons fire {fire} times as fast, Tibo runs {move} times as fast and Tibo takes {hurt}% less damage.

larder-heart.name: Larder Heart
larder-heart.desc: Damage Tibo takes is paid from his XP bar first. A full bar pays {damage} damage. The bar never drops a level.

leftover-lederhosen.name: Leftover Lederhosen
leftover-lederhosen.desc: Damage past a pest's last HP carries to the nearest boss within {range} units, or else to the nearest pest. Carried damage never crits. Weapons deal {less}% less damage.

mash-ram-helm.name: Mash Ram Helm
mash-ram-helm.desc: Each dash ends in a mash burst. Each pest it hits takes {refund} s off the dash recharge. The dash recharges {slower}% slower.

one-potato-clogs.name: One Potato Clogs
one-potato-clogs.desc: Tibo holds at most {weapons} weapons. Each weapon slot the Clogs seal gives every held weapon {damage}% more damage and {area}% more area.

chili-bottle.name: Chili Bottle
chili-bottle.desc: Pick it up to breathe fire where Tibo faces for 10 s. The fire grows with his damage and area.

dig-spot.name: X Marks the Spot
dig-spot.desc: Stand on the X to dig up a chest.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.desc: Stand by it to light it. Crabs swarm in, and a chest lands at its foot.

mash-bomb.name: Mash Bomb
mash-bomb.desc: Break it to flatten every pest on screen. Elites and bosses lose a fifth of their max HP.

rowboat.name: Rowboat
rowboat.desc: Stand in it to row to the far shore.

treasure-map.name: Treasure Map
treasure-map.desc: Read it to mark an X. Dig at the X for a chest.

event-horizon.desc: Event Horizon: orbiting bodies erase small enemy bullets, each once per {dim} s. Each erase: +{gain}% orbit damage for {sec} s, up to +{cap}%

hold-the-line.desc: Hold the Line: armor up to {cap}, pests in melee reach take a free swing for {swing}× damage, and the dash becomes Brace; dash again to break out
hold-the-line.label: {armor} armor for each pest in melee reach, up to {twoCap}

overdrive.desc: Overdrive: dash through pests or bullets to refund the charge and build heat. At {heat} heat, vent nearby bullets and fire {rate}% faster for {sec} s
overdrive.label: dashing through a bullet refunds {refund}% of the recharge

ricochet.desc: Ricochet: each pierce, plus {jumps}, becomes a jump to the nearest new pest within {reach} or back in off the view's edge, for +{gain}% damage per jump.

ships-bell.desc: Ship's Bell: every {period} s, and early on a dash, blast weapons fire an extra volley

spreading-bog.desc: Pests that die in your pools leave bogs ({damage}% damage, up to {cap}). Tibo -{wade}% speed in bogs

static-step.desc: Static Step: walking stores sparks, up to {max}. Each storm volley spends one to fork every strike to a second pest for triple damage. With no sparks, storm weapons recharge {slow}% slower

the-hunt.desc: The Hunt: summons and dogs hunt the toughest pest in view for {quarry}% more damage. Its fall speeds them up {howl}% for {seconds} s
the-hunt.label: Summons and dogs deal {elite}% more damage to elites and bosses

butter-streak.name: 黄油带
butter-streak.desc: 每次冲刺都会留下一道融化的黄油带，2秒内让害虫减速并受到灼烧。两次冲刺之间，也会在Tibo刚走过的路上留下一道。

chip-shuriken.name: 薯片手里剑
chip-shuriken.desc: 旋转的薯片螺旋飞出。

frozen-fries.name: 冻薯条
frozen-fries.desc: 射出冻薯条，把敌人冻在原地。

fry-knives.name: 薯条飞刀
fry-knives.desc: 朝Tibo面向的方向射出锋利薯条。

fry-lance.name: 薯条长枪
fry-lance.desc: 一根超长薯条，穿透一整排。

fry-sentry.name: 薯条哨塔
fry-sentry.desc: 放下一座炸薯厨师炮塔，射击附近敌人。

frying-pan.name: 平底锅
frying-pan.desc: 在Tibo面前挥舞平底锅。拍回的敌方子弹会飞回射手。Tibo每击败一个精英，下一击就会蓄力，变得更大更重。

grab-bag.name: 福袋
grab-bag.desc: 把手伸进袋子，每次都打出另一把武器的攻击。

gravy-boat.name: 肉汁船
gravy-boat.desc: 向敌人倒下滚烫的肉汁池。

hash-boomerang.name: 薯饼回旋镖
hash-boomerang.desc: 飞出去再飞回来的脆薯饼。

hash-brown-shield.name: 薯饼盾
hash-brown-shield.desc: 薯饼环绕Tibo旋转。每块薯饼为一次攻击或子弹挡下至多20点伤害，然后碎成碎片，伤害附近的敌人。反伤会加到碎片伤害上。碎掉的薯饼会一块块重新炸脆。

hot-potato.name: 烫手山芋
hot-potato.desc: 在害虫之间来回弹跳，计数归零时在最后一只身上爆炸。

julienne-dash.name: 切丝冲刺
julienne-dash.desc: 每次冲刺都把Tibo路线上的害虫全部切成丝。两次冲刺之间，也会沿着Tibo刚走过的路切丝。

mash-mallet.name: 土豆锤
mash-mallet.desc: 捣薯器砸向Tibo脚边最近的害虫。

mash-mortar.name: 土豆泥臼炮
mash-mortar.desc: 放下一门臼炮，向远处的害虫发射土豆泥团。每团都会爆开，击中周围所有害虫。

mash-wave.name: 土豆泥波
mash-wave.desc: 一圈土豆泥从Tibo身边滚开。

mezzaluna.name: 半月刀
mezzaluna.desc: 在Tibo前后剁砍。Tibo损失的生命越多，伤害越高。

peel-lash.name: 薯皮鞭
peel-lash.desc: 一条长长的土豆皮抽中最近的害虫，再跳到旁边的一只身上。

peeler.name: 削皮刀
peeler.desc: 横向挥砍。4级起会向敌群甩出土豆皮，每级多一片。Tibo信赖的厨房工具。

potato-battery.name: 土豆电池
potato-battery.desc: 把带电的电线夹在一只害虫身上。电线会电击并减速碰到的每只害虫。被夹住的害虫死后，电线会跳到下一只身上。

potato-rain.name: 土豆雨
potato-rain.desc: 在Tibo周围召唤一场土豆雨。

reset-button.name: Reset按钮
reset-button.desc: 我们Reset了上限。清空屏幕上所有敌人。首领只会一缩。

root-cellar.name: 土豆地窖
root-cellar.desc: Tibo周围环绕着一圈地窖寒气。穿过它的害虫会被冻伤并短暂冻住。首领只会减速。

root-spikes.name: 根刺
root-spikes.desc: 树根从敌人脚下破土而出。

rosti-disc.name: 薯饼飞盘
rosti-disc.desc: 扁平的瑞士薯饼，在视野边缘反弹。

salt-line.name: 盐线
salt-line.desc: Tibo边走边撒盐。踩到盐的害虫会减速并受到刺痛。

seeker-sprouts.name: 追踪嫩芽
seeker-sprouts.desc: 会转向敌人的嫩芽。

skillet-flail.name: 铁锅连枷
skillet-flail.desc: 一只铁锅扫过Tibo身前的害虫，也扫过他身后的害虫。

small-fry.name: 小薯条
small-fry.desc: 一根起初很弱的迷你薯条，每亲手击杀一次就提升伤害，直到本局结束。

sprout-satellites.name: 嫩芽卫星
sprout-satellites.desc: 土豆嫩芽环绕Tibo一段时间。

spud-cannon.name: 土豆炮
spud-cannon.desc: 经典土豆枪。弹丸命中时爆开。

spud-dice.name: 土豆骰子
spud-dice.desc: 掷出一颗土豆骰子。1点哑火，2点冰冻，3点燃烧，4点分裂，5点给金币，6点大爆炸。

spud-dynamo.name: 土豆发电机
spud-dynamo.desc: 两团淀粉火花绕着Tibo转，碰到什么电什么。

spud-lob.name: 抛土豆
spud-lob.desc: 把沉重的土豆高高抛起，砸进敌群。

starch-bolt.name: 淀粉闪电
starch-bolt.desc: 淀粉堆的静电随机打中敌人。

starch-chain.name: 淀粉连锁
starch-chain.desc: 在敌人之间跳跃的电火花。

starch-puddle.name: 淀粉水洼
starch-puddle.desc: 在最近的一群害虫脚下倒出一滩带电淀粉。站在里面的害虫会被电击并减速，直到水洼变干。

steam-vent.name: 蒸汽口
steam-vent.desc: 烤土豆冒出的热蒸汽，伤害附近一切。

tater-mines.name: 土豆地雷
tater-mines.desc: 埋下土豆，敌人靠近就爆炸。

tater-pup.name: 薯球小狗
tater-pup.desc: 忠诚的薯球小狗，跟着Tibo射击。

tot-toss.name: 扔薯球
tot-toss.desc: 向最近的敌人扔薯球。

whisk-vortex.name: 打蛋漩涡
whisk-vortex.desc: 在最大的敌群下方转出打蛋器漩涡，把害虫卷进去。

big-fry.name: 大薯条
big-fry.desc: 薯条穿透一切，变得越强，个头越大。

bottomless-sack.name: 无底袋
bottomless-sack.desc: 一次掏出两份零食，而且掏出来就是进化版。

cast-iron.name: 铸铁锅
cast-iron.desc: 双向挥击。拍回的子弹伤害更高、会穿透，还会追踪害虫。每击败一个精英，下一击就会蓄力。

cold-storage.name: 冷藏库
cold-storage.desc: 更宽、更冷的寒圈。害虫冻得更久，冻伤更重。

crater-pound.name: 土豆坑
crater-pound.desc: 捣薯器砸向Tibo脚边的两只害虫，每一砸都更宽。

dynamo-coil.name: 发电线圈
dynamo-coil.desc: 火花一直留在外面，第三团也加入。

factory-reset.name: 出厂Reset
factory-reset.desc: 彻底Reset。清空屏幕，保留掉落，治疗Tibo。

fry-fortress.name: 薯条堡垒
fry-fortress.desc: 一次放下三座装甲薯条炮塔。它们持续更久，波纹薯条可穿透敌人。

ghee-glide.name: 酥油滑行
ghee-glide.desc: 每次冲刺都会留下一道滚烫的酥油带，让害虫减速并受到灼烧。两次冲刺之间，也会在Tibo刚走过的路上留下一道。Tibo在酥油上行走速度提高15%。

golden-harvest.name: 黄金丰收
golden-harvest.desc: 一场金色土豆雨。击杀可能掉金币。

gratin-arc.name: 焗薯电弧
gratin-arc.desc: 芝士电弧，连锁很远，经常暴击。

gratin-puddle.name: 焗烤淀粉洼
gratin-puddle.desc: 更大的焗烤淀粉水洼，停留更久，电击更重。

gravy-flood.name: 肉汁洪流
gravy-flood.desc: 肉汁池会变大，并追着Tibo漂移。

hash-bulwark.name: 薯饼壁垒
hash-bulwark.desc: 更多薯饼，重新炸脆更快，每次攻击挡下至多30点伤害。碎片伤害更高，并冻住敌人。

hashnado.name: 薯饼龙卷风
hashnado.desc: 薯饼化作酥脆风暴，旋出又飞回。

inferno-basket.name: 地狱炸篮
inferno-basket.desc: 长时间喷射炸油。对精英和首领双倍伤害。

iron-flail.name: 重铁连枷
iron-flail.desc: 更重的铁锅扫得更开，扫过Tibo身前的害虫，也扫过他身后的害虫。

landmine-harvest.name: 地雷丰收
landmine-harvest.desc: 腐烂地雷。被它炸死的敌人额外掉金币。

loaded-dice.name: 灌铅薯骰
loaded-dice.desc: 掷两颗骰子取大的点数。掷出对子时投掷翻倍。

mandoline-fury.name: 切片狂怒
mandoline-fury.desc: 双向切片，抛出土豆片。每次斩击给Tibo回一点血。

mashquake.name: 土豆泥地震
mashquake.desc: 土豆泥波浪减速敌人，还会甩出泥块。

moon-cleaver.name: 满月砍刀
moon-cleaver.desc: 前方剁两刀、后方剁一刀，并向身后的敌群甩出薯丝。Tibo损失的生命越多，伤害越高。

overgrowth.name: 疯长
overgrowth.desc: 追踪嫩芽，命中后分裂。

permafrost-fries.name: 永冻薯条
permafrost-fries.desc: 冻得更久。被冻住的敌人受到双倍伤害。

pestle-barrage.name: 杵臼齐射
pestle-barrage.desc: 一次放下三门铁臼炮。泥团爆开的范围更大，每次爆炸还会向四周抛出三个小爆炸。

pressure-cooker.name: 高压锅
pressure-cooker.desc: 巨大的蒸汽云。每烫到一个敌人就治疗Tibo。

railfry.name: 磁轨薯条
railfry.desc: 三道长枪横穿整个视野。

rind-whip.name: 厚皮鞭
rind-whip.desc: 一条长长的土豆皮抽中最近的害虫，再跳过旁边的几只害虫。

rosti-storm.name: 薯饼风暴
rosti-storm.desc: 弹跳的薯饼，每次反弹都会炸开。

sack-of-russets.name: 一袋土豆
sack-of-russets.desc: 一整袋沉甸甸的土豆，一次全扔出去。

salt-flats.name: 盐滩
salt-flats.desc: 更宽的盐道，减速更强，还会把害虫推离Tibo的路线。

spicy-hot-potato.name: 麻辣烫手山芋
spicy-hot-potato.desc: 弹得更远，爆炸时再抛出两颗新的烫手山芋。

spud-grid.name: 土豆电网
spud-grid.desc: 一次夹上三根带电的电线。每根电线电击更强，松开时会爆开。

spudzooka.name: 土豆火箭筒
spudzooka.desc: 大型土豆火箭，分裂成集束爆炸。

stand-mixer.name: 厨师机
stand-mixer.desc: 两个漩涡吸力更强。漩涡结束时，把卷进来的敌人砸到一起。

taproot-eruption.name: 主根喷发
taproot-eruption.desc: 巨大的主根破土而出，把敌人掀飞。

waffle-cut.name: 格子切
waffle-cut.desc: 每次冲刺都在Tibo路线上的害虫身上切出十字，随后再切两次，间隔0.5秒。两次冲刺之间，也会沿着Tibo刚走过的路切割。

baked-alaska.name: 火焰雪山
baked-alaska.desc: 每弹到一个敌人就把它冻住的烫手山芋。被冻住的敌人受到双倍伤害。最后一跳会震碎附近所有被冻住的敌人，再抛出两颗新的烫手山芋。腾出一个武器栏。

cold-frame.name: 冷床
cold-frame.desc: 嫩芽在一圈宽大的寒圈里永远环绕Tibo。穿过寒圈或撞上嫩芽的害虫会短暂冻住。首领只会减速。腾出一个武器栏。

fry-brigade.name: 薯条军团
fry-brigade.desc: 戴厨师帽的薯球小狗跟着Tibo射击，一路种下薯条哨塔。腾出一个武器栏。

gravy-whirlpool.name: 肉汁漩涡
gravy-whirlpool.desc: 滚烫的肉汁漩涡把敌群卷进来灼烧。漩涡会变大，追着Tibo漂移，再把卷进来的敌人砸到一起。腾出一个武器栏。

griddle-guard.name: 铁板守卫
griddle-guard.desc: 薯饼环绕Tibo旋转，挡下攻击和子弹。薯饼挡下子弹的地方，平底锅会在那里挥击，把子弹拍回射手。碎掉的薯饼会炸成冰冻碎片，平底锅双向挥击。腾出一个武器栏。

hungry-sprouts.name: 贪吃嫩芽
hungry-sprouts.desc: 会追踪敌人的嫩芽，命中后分裂，每亲手击杀一次就提升伤害，直到本局结束。腾出一个武器栏。

knife-block.name: 刀架
knife-block.desc: 同时切向Tibo前后两侧，向两边抛出土豆片。每次斩击给Tibo回一点血，Tibo损失的生命越多，伤害越高。腾出一个武器栏。

root-current.name: 根系电流
root-current.desc: 夹上三根带电的电线。每秒，每只被夹住的害虫脚下都会冒出根来，把害虫掀飞，并把电击传给每只被打中的害虫。腾出一个武器栏。

salted-butter.name: 咸黄油
salted-butter.desc: 每走一步、每次冲刺都会留下咸黄油，让害虫受到刺痛并减速，把害虫推离Tibo的路线并将其点燃。Tibo在咸黄油上行走速度提高15%。腾出一个武器栏。

sowing-season.name: 播种时节
sowing-season.desc: 金色土豆如雨落下，没砸中的会种在地里变成地雷。击杀可能掉金币。腾出一个武器栏。

spud-artillery.name: 土豆炮兵
spud-artillery.desc: 一轮会爆炸的土豆抛射弹幕。腾出一个武器栏。

starch-supercell.name: 淀粉雷暴
starch-supercell.desc: 在敌人之间连锁的闪电。腾出一个武器栏。

gem-sling.name: 宝石弹弓
gem-sling.desc: Tibo每捡一颗宝石，就朝前进方向甩出一块薯角。数量越多，扇形甩出的薯角越多。

hot-streak.name: 热油连斩
hot-streak.desc: 一道炸油斩击横扫Tibo周围的害虫。Tibo不受伤地持续移动，每满1秒脚下就燃起一团火焰，最多五团，每团都让斩击更远、更快。被击中熄灭两团，停下就全部熄灭。

locked-gatling.name: 锁定加特林
locked-gatling.desc: 每轮2秒的连射锁定最近害虫的方向，Tibo移动时也一直朝那边发射薯球。数量越多，并排的弹道越多。

mash-snowball.name: 土豆泥雪球
mash-snowball.desc: 一颗土豆泥球在Tibo身后滚动，他每跑一步就变大一点。他停下或急转弯时，它会沿最后的前进方向冲出，把害虫砸扁，球越大威力越大。滚到最大时会自己冲出去。

seed-potato.name: 种薯
seed-potato.desc: Tibo把一颗种薯扔进最近的敌群。它分三个阶段发芽，每秒电击周围的害虫。走过去收获会引发爆发，阶段越高威力越大，还能接住土豆再扔。放着不管，8秒后只会弱弱地爆开。

spud-fence.name: 土豆围栏
spud-fence.desc: Tibo每走60个单位，就插下一根淀粉桩。每根桩和上一根之间连着带电的电弧，电击穿过的害虫。最多同时立四根，Tibo不动就不插桩。

tailgate-fries.name: 甩尾薯条
tailgate-fries.desc: Tibo奔跑时，薯条从身后喷向追着他的一切。站着不动时，他会在身后掉出一根薯条。

tater-twirl.name: 土豆转圈圈
tater-twirl.desc: 薯饼轮环绕Tibo，Tibo跑多快，它们就转多快、打多快。他站着不动时，它们会慢得像在爬。

tot-stampede.name: 薯球狂奔
tot-stampede.desc: Tibo每走40个单位，身后就蹦出一颗薯球冲向最近的害虫，一碰就爆。Tibo不动就不出薯球。

gem-catapult.name: 宝石投石机
gem-catapult.desc: Tibo每捡一颗宝石，就朝前进方向甩出一块薯角，每块伤害高得多。数量越多，扇形甩出的薯角越多。

mash-avalanche.name: 土豆泥雪崩
mash-avalanche.desc: 土豆泥球伤害更高，首次命中时分裂成三颗小球，沿前进方向呈扇形散开，按各自大小砸扁害虫。

potato-patch.name: 土豆田
potato-patch.desc: Tibo一次扔出三颗施过肥的种薯，最多同时长六颗。电击和收获爆发都强得多。走过一株就能收获并再扔一次。

spark-corral.name: 火花围栏
spark-corral.desc: Tibo每走60个单位，就插下一根充能淀粉桩。桩之间连着两倍宽的交织电弧，电击害虫强得多。能立的桩更多，每根持续9秒。

tailgate-party.name: 甩尾派对
tailgate-party.desc: Tibo奔跑时，身后喷出黄油薯条，伤害高得多。站着不动时，他会在身后掉出一根。

tater-minigun.name: 土豆转管炮
tater-minigun.desc: 同样锁定方向的2秒连射，每点数量一条弹道，每颗薯球伤害高得多。

tater-twister.name: 土豆大旋风
tater-twister.desc: 更多薯饼轮在更大的轨道上环绕Tibo，伤害更高，Tibo跑多快它们就转多快。他站着不动时，它们会慢得像在爬。

tot-cavalry.name: 薯球铁骑
tot-cavalry.desc: Tibo每走40个单位，身后就冲出一队黄油薯球，每颗撞穿两只害虫。Tibo不动就不出薯球。

wildfire-roast.name: 热油燎原
wildfire-roast.desc: 热油连斩的斩击烧至白热。Tibo保持燃着的每团火焰都让横扫远得多，最多五团。被击中熄灭两团，停下就全部熄灭。

grease-fire.name: 油锅起火
grease-fire.desc: 热油燎原的横扫喷出一大团燃烧的炸油雾，Tibo脚下的火焰在奔跑时把油点燃成一片片燃烧的油洼。Tibo保持燃着的每团火焰都让横扫远得多，最多五团。被击中熄灭两团，停下就全部熄灭。腾出一个武器栏。

hash-carousel.name: 薯饼旋转木马
hash-carousel.desc: 金色薯饼轮环绕Tibo，掷出会飞出再飞回的薯饼。Tibo跑多快，它们就转多快、掷多快。他站着不动时，它们会慢得像在爬。腾出一个武器栏。

loot-sling.name: 战利品弹弓
loot-sling.desc: 一次从袋里掏出两份进化版零食，Tibo每捡一颗宝石，还会朝前进方向再甩出一份。腾出一个武器栏。

starch-garden.name: 淀粉菜园
starch-garden.desc: Tibo把施过肥的种薯扔进敌群，每走60个单位还会插下一根淀粉桩，桩脚种着一颗种薯。每株都分三个阶段生长，电击周围的害虫，桩之间的电弧也会随植株一起变强。走过一株就能收获一次爆发。腾出一个武器栏。

tot-barrage.name: 薯球弹幕
tot-barrage.desc: 连绵不断的薯球。每颗命中的薯球都会蹦出一颗薯球冲向下一只害虫，Tibo走动时身后还会冲出一队队薯球。腾出一个武器栏。

afterburner-fries.name: 加力薯条
afterburner-fries.desc: 每次冲刺都会从冲刺起点向后喷出一扇热薯条。

broadside.name: 舷炮齐射
broadside.desc: 从Tibo两侧垂直于奔跑方向发射一排火药弹。每发炮弹碰到第一个害虫或落地时爆炸。

comet-scythe.name: 彗星镰刀
comet-scythe.desc: 一把镰刀环绕Tibo旋转。每转两圈，轨道会向外大幅甩出再收回，既砍Tibo脚边的害虫，也砍外圈的害虫。

harvest-moon.name: 丰收月
harvest-moon.desc: 一颗月亮土豆环绕Tibo。碰到的害虫会随轨道转一会儿，然后被甩出并受到伤害。被甩出的害虫几秒内不会再被抓住，首领太重抓不动。

hash-hawk.name: 薯饼鹰
hash-hawk.desc: 一只薯饼鹰在Tibo上空盘旋。每隔几秒，它会俯冲攻击范围内最强的害虫，首领优先，其次是精英，并击中它身边的一切。

mash-golem.name: 土豆泥魔像
mash-golem.desc: 一个土豆泥魔像在Tibo面前升起，朝他面对的方向踏步前进，把害虫推开、开出一条路。走到尽头时它会重砸地面并崩塌。

mash-landing.name: 土豆泥着陆
mash-landing.desc: 每次冲刺结束时释放土豆泥冲击波，击中Tibo周围的所有害虫并将其击退。

peel-phantom.name: 薯皮幻影
peel-phantom.desc: 每次冲刺会在起点留下一个Tibo形状的薯皮空壳。附近的害虫会追着空壳跑，直到它爆开。

skipping-cannonball.name: 打水漂炮弹
skipping-cannonball.desc: 一颗炮弹沿Tibo面朝的方向弹跳前进，每次弹跳都会爆炸，一次比一次大。数量增加一次弹跳。

sprout-squad.name: 嫩芽小队
sprout-squad.desc: 倒下的害虫可能会在原地长出一株幼苗。每株幼苗会跳向最近的害虫并咬它，直到自己枯萎。数量越多，能同时生长的幼苗越多。

spud-decoy.name: 土豆诱饵
spud-decoy.desc: 每隔几秒，Tibo会在身后放下一个发条土豆。附近的害虫会走向它而不是Tibo，然后它会爆炸。

clockwork-spud.name: 机关土豆
clockwork-spud.desc: Tibo会在身后放下发条土豆，附近的害虫会走向它们。每次爆炸都会留下一个更小的土豆，上紧发条后再爆炸一次。

eclipse-scythe.name: 日食镰刀
eclipse-scythe.desc: 日之刃与月之刃环绕Tibo旋转。日之刃向外大幅甩出时，月之刃贴着他脚边砍，然后两者交换位置，远近的害虫都始终在攻击范围内。

full-broadside.name: 全舷炮齐射
full-broadside.desc: 从Tibo两侧各发射两排火药弹。每发炮弹碰到第一个害虫或落地时爆炸，并弹出三颗小炮弹，小炮弹落地即爆炸。

hash-harrier.name: 薯饼鹞
hash-harrier.desc: 长着余烬之翼的薯饼鹞在Tibo上空盘旋，俯冲攻击范围内最强的害虫，首领优先，其次是精英。每次俯冲都会留下燃烧的薯饼碎屑，灼烧站在上面的害虫。

hunters-moon.name: 猎人月
hunters-moon.desc: 更大的月亮土豆环绕Tibo，能从更远处抓住害虫。每只被甩出的害虫会在落地处炸成月光淀粉，伤害周围的害虫。首领太重抓不动。

jet-fryer.name: 喷气炸锅
jet-fryer.desc: 每次冲刺都会从冲刺起点向后喷出两扇热薯条。每根薯条落地处都会溅出热油。

mash-colossus.name: 土豆泥巨像
mash-colossus.desc: 一个更大的土豆泥魔像朝Tibo面对的方向踏步前进。每一步都会留下一滩让害虫减速的土豆泥，最后一记重砸会推出一圈向外滚动的土豆泥环。

mash-meteor.name: 土豆泥陨石
mash-meteor.desc: 每次冲刺结束时释放更大的土豆泥冲击波，片刻后还有一道更宽的第二圈。

peel-poltergeist.name: 薯皮骚灵
peel-poltergeist.desc: 每次冲刺会在起点留下一个闹鬼的薯皮空壳。害虫追着它冲进旋转的薯皮里，随后空壳爆开，甩出一圈薯皮。

root-legion.name: 根须军团
root-legion.desc: 长出更多幼苗，存活更久，并且每半秒在Tibo身边长出一株新幼苗。每株枯萎的幼苗会留下根须陷阱，把害虫短暂定在原地。

russet-ricochet.name: 土豆跳弹
russet-ricochet.desc: 土豆炮弹沿Tibo面朝的方向呈扇形打水漂前进，每次弹跳都会爆炸，一次比一次大。每次爆炸都会向附近的害虫扔出一颗小土豆，小土豆也会爆炸。数量增加一次弹跳。

fry-by.name: 薯条掠空
fry-by.desc: Tibo奔跑时，身后喷出薯条。每次冲刺都会沿着冲刺路径向后喷出宽阔的两层扇形薯条，扇形中的每根薯条落地处都会溅出热油。腾出一个武器栏。

gravy-pack.name: 肉汁狗群
gravy-pack.desc: 四只裹着肉汁的薯球小狗跟着Tibo跑。每咬一口给Tibo恢复0.05生命。

bacon-bits.name: 培根碎
bacon-bits.desc: 每级对精英和首领伤害+12%。

butter-socks.name: 黄油袜子
butter-socks.desc: 第1、3、5级时冲刺次数+1。每级冲刺冷却缩短6%。

four-eyed-spud.name: 四眼土豆
four-eyed-spud.desc: 每级幸运+10%。射击武器在2、4级时投射物+1。

gpu.name: GPU
gpu.desc: 投射物+1。攻击会积累热量。热量满时，武器以半速攻击3秒。每级提升攻速和散热。

hot-sauce.name: 辣酱
hot-sauce.desc: 每级提高暴击率。暴击率越高，每级提升越少。

rotten-spud.name: 烂土豆
rotten-spud.desc: 每级诅咒+10%：敌人更强、更快、更多，但经验和金币也更多。

starch-plating.name: 淀粉装甲
starch-plating.desc: 减少每次受到的伤害，每级减得更多。敌人越强，减伤越少。

thick-skin.name: 厚脸皮
thick-skin.desc: 每级提高闪避攻击的几率。闪避率越高，每级提升越少。

hot-start.name: 热薯启动
hot-start.desc: 每次冲刺后，所有武器装填加快60%，持续1.3秒。每级增加0.3秒。持续期间Tibo会发光。

couch-potato.name: 沙发土豆
couch-potato.desc: Tibo静止时，伤害每秒每级提高4%，最多每级20%。移动会重置。

gravy-splash.name: 肉汁飞溅
gravy-splash.desc: 每0.5秒，Tibo回复的生命会溅出，对附近敌人造成伤害：每级为回复量的100%。

hash-rush.name: 薯饼狂飙
hash-rush.desc: 最近4秒内每冲刺一次，每级伤害+4%，最多计算3次冲刺。

hearty-helping.name: 超大份
hearty-helping.desc: Tibo的最大生命每比初始值高50，伤害+2%。每级每50再加2%。

lean-lunch.name: 轻食午餐
lean-lunch.desc: 每有一个空武器栏，每级伤害+4%、冷却-2%。

mash-finisher.name: 捣泥终结
mash-finisher.desc: 命中时，生命低于最大生命2%×等级的害虫会被直接捣成泥，最多15%。精英的阈值减半。首领不受影响。

packed-pan.name: 满满一锅
packed-pan.desc: Tibo拾取范围内每有1只害虫，伤害+1%，最多算10只。每级每只再加1%。

peel-out.name: 削皮开溜
peel-out.desc: Tibo闪避攻击后，武器伤害翻倍，持续2秒。持续期间薯皮会绕着他旋转。

spry-sprout.name: 灵巧嫩芽
spry-sprout.desc: 每级冲刺冷却缩短5%。

tater-trot.name: 土豆小跑
tater-trot.desc: 每1%额外移速提供1%射速，每级最多8%。

aged-russet.name: 陈年土豆
aged-russet.desc: 本局Tibo每升一级，每级伤害+0.5%，每级最多+10%。

clean-plate.name: 光盘
clean-plate.desc: 5秒未被击中后，每级暴击率+12%。被击中会失去一级。

baked-buckler.name: 烤土豆盾
baked-buckler.desc: 减少每次受到的伤害。敌人越强，减伤越少。

boom-spud.name: 爆炸土豆
boom-spud.desc: 被击杀的敌人可能爆炸。

coupon-book.name: 优惠券本
coupon-book.desc: 所有购买都更便宜。

freezer-burn.name: 冷冻灼伤
freezer-burn.desc: 冰冻的敌人死亡时碎裂，并冻结附近的敌人。

ghost-pepper.name: 鬼椒
ghost-pepper.desc: 每次冲刺结束后，Tibo仍保持无敌0.15秒。

ghost-skin.name: 幽灵薯皮
ghost-skin.desc: 提高闪避攻击的几率。闪避率越高，提升越少。

hot-pepper.name: 朝天椒
hot-pepper.desc: 提高暴击率。暴击率越高，提升越少。

philosophers-potato.name: 贤者之薯
philosophers-potato.desc: 伤害、范围、速度和持续时间+10%。

porcupine-spud.name: 豪猪土豆
porcupine-spud.desc: Tibo受到攻击时，向四周射出10根薯条。

second-spud.name: 备胎土豆
second-spud.desc: 以一半生命复活一次。

static-tot.name: 静电薯球
static-tot.desc: 10%的命中会向另外3个敌人释放闪电。

thorny-jacket.name: 荆棘夹克
thorny-jacket.desc: 击中Tibo的敌人受到8点伤害。

wandering-eyes.name: 游荡薯眼
wandering-eyes.desc: 20%的击杀会放出2个土豆芽眼，追击其他敌人。

all-seeing-spud.name: 全视土豆
all-seeing-spud.desc: 35%的击杀会放出4个土豆芽眼，贯穿敌人。

bonfire-spud.name: 篝火土豆
bonfire-spud.desc: 25%的命中会点燃敌人，火焰还会蔓延到周围的敌人。

fry-volcano.name: 薯条火山
fry-volcano.desc: Tibo受到攻击时会伴随爆炸喷发，并射出24根贯穿敌人的薯条。

glacier-spud.name: 冰川土豆
glacier-spud.desc: 击杀敌人时，有30%的几率使其碎裂，冻结附近的敌人，并使这些敌人周围的其他敌人减速。

kaboom-spud.name: 轰隆土豆
kaboom-spud.desc: 击杀敌人时，有25%的几率使其爆炸，对附近的敌人造成相当于该敌人最大生命一半的伤害。

magma-croquette.name: 岩浆可乐饼
magma-croquette.desc: 20%的命中会引发巨大爆炸，点燃敌人。

meteor-russet.name: 陨石土豆
meteor-russet.desc: 3%的命中会召唤陨石，造成20倍伤害，砸出的陨坑还会波及周围敌人。

storm-tot.name: 风暴薯球
storm-tot.desc: 15%的命中会向另外6个敌人释放闪电，并在每个敌人身上炸响雷鸣。

static-socks.name: 静电袜
static-socks.desc: 每次冲刺结束时，向最近的3个敌人发射淀粉电弧，每道造成176伤害。

frozen-pea.name: 冷冻豌豆
frozen-pea.desc: 8%的命中会冻住敌人1秒。首领改为减速。

fry-fuel.name: 薯条燃料
fry-fuel.desc: 每击杀30个敌人，补充1次冲刺次数。

lightning-spud.name: 闪电土豆
lightning-spud.desc: 6%的命中会召唤闪电，劈向周围的敌人。

mash-splat.name: 啪叽土豆泥
mash-splat.desc: 每次冲刺落地都会溅出一摊土豆泥，击中Tibo周围的敌人。

midnight-fries.name: 夜宵薯条
midnight-fries.desc: 伤害+5%。20:00后，伤害每分钟再提高6%。

moon-dust.name: 月光淀粉
moon-dust.desc: 击杀敌人时，有15%的几率使其炸成一团月光淀粉，让附近的敌人减速。

receipt-spud.name: 小票土豆
receipt-spud.desc: 每打开一个宝箱或箱子，本局剩余时间内伤害+2%。

souffle-spud.name: 舒芙蕾土豆
souffle-spud.desc: Tibo受到攻击时会鼓起来，把附近的敌人推开。

spud-spring.name: 土豆弹簧
spud-spring.desc: 冲刺冷却缩短15%。最多叠加3次。

tailwind-tater.name: 顺风土豆
tailwind-tater.desc: 移速每比基础值高2%，伤害+1%。

tater-treat.name: 土豆零食
tater-treat.desc: 狗狗使用能力的频率提高25%。

mash-crater.name: 土豆泥坑
mash-crater.desc: 每次冲刺落地都会砸出一个大大的土豆泥坑，向外抛出8块薯饼。

copper-tot.name: 铜薯球
copper-tot.desc: 捡起金币时，有25%的几率对屏幕上随机一只害虫造成高额伤害。

panic-fry.name: 慌乱薯条
panic-fry.desc: 每分钟Tibo第一次降到50%生命以下时，害虫会减速5%，持续3秒，他的攻击伤害增加25%。

second-helping.name: 再来一份
second-helping.desc: Tibo满生命时每吃一份零食，本局剩余时间内伤害+1%，每级最多+10%。

spark-spud.name: 火花土豆
spark-spud.desc: 走路会积攒火花。Tibo每走300个单位，火花就会爆开，击中并眩晕他周围的害虫。

spud-purse.name: 土豆钱包
spud-purse.desc: Tibo每走100个单位就掉落一枚硬币，每多一份提前16个单位。

warm-bowl.name: 暖碗
warm-bowl.desc: 为任意激活圈充能后，会在那里留下一片治疗水洼，持续10秒。

amusing.title: 节日吉祥物
amusing.desc: 土豆节的粉色毛绒吉祥物。他挥手打招呼，扔出爱心和填充棉，然后扑过来一个熊抱，把你的淀粉都挤出来。
amusing.name: amusing

beetle-queen.name: 科罗拉多女王
beetle-queen.title: 甲虫之母
beetle-queen.desc: 条纹土豆甲虫的女王。她的幼虫在Tibo周围孵化成一圈。

compost-titan.name: 堆肥泰坦
compost-titan.title: 腐烂之山
compost-titan.desc: 一堆腐烂的落叶和覆盖物。蛆虫从里面涌出。

deep-freezer.name: 深冻冰柜
deep-freezer.title: 冻薯条看守者
deep-freezer.desc: 会走路的卧式冰柜。它的冰块会把你冻住片刻。

fryer-king.name: 炸锅之王
fryer-king.title: 热油领主
fryer-king.desc: 戴着王冠的油炸锅。喷出一圈圈滚油。

grater-golem.name: 擦丝魔像
grater-golem.title: 粉碎者
grater-golem.desc: 长了腿的四面擦丝器。沿着标记线冲锋。

great-wireworm.name: 巨型金针虫
great-wireworm.title: 块茎钻孔者
great-wireworm.desc: 一条巨大的金针虫。钻进地下，从Tibo脚下冒出。

harvester.name: 收割机
harvester.title: 季节终结者
harvester.desc: 一台联合收割机。沿长长的直线冲锋。所有土豆的最终噩梦。

ketchup-kraken.name: 番茄酱海怪
ketchup-kraken.title: 沼泽之恐
ketchup-kraken.desc: 番茄酱组成的海怪。触手按规律砸下。

late-blight.name: 晚疫病
late-blight.title: 饥荒之雾
late-blight.desc: 一团蔓延的疫病云。它指向哪里，哪里就冒出孢子云。

sir-strawman.name: 稻草人爵士
sir-strawman.title: 田垄守护者
sir-strawman.desc: 稻草人骑士。扇形抛出尖利的稻草。

the-mandoline.name: 切片器
the-mandoline.title: 薯条切手
the-mandoline.desc: 活过来的切片器。刀刃成排横扫。

the-masher.name: 捣泥者
the-masher.title: 厨房执法官
the-masher.desc: 巨大的土豆捣泥器。会砸向Tibo站的地方。

pack-lord.name: 兽群之主
pack-lord.title: 狩猎首领
pack-lord.desc: 统领兽群的巨型头领。它连续扑击并召唤猎手，它一倒下，所有兽群都会四散。

root-hydra.name: 根须九头蛇
root-hydra.title: 三首
root-hydra.desc: 一条裹满根须的九头蛇，从地下破土而出。三个头沿着直线咬下。

root-hydra-frenzy.name: 根须九头蛇
root-hydra-frenzy.title: 五首
root-hydra-frenzy.desc: 五个头，双眼通红，伤痕累累。它会猛扑。

root-hydra-head.name: 根须九头蛇之首
root-hydra-head.title: 潜地
root-hydra-head.desc: 九头蛇的一个头破土而出，喷出泥浆后又沉回地下。它现在受到的每一击都会削弱29:00出现的九头蛇。

root-hydra-mire.name: 根须九头蛇
root-hydra-mire.title: 泥池
root-hydra-mire.desc: 两个头钻入地下，在场地各处喷出泥池。

root-hydra-stump.name: 根须九头蛇
root-hydra-stump.title: 残桩
root-hydra-stump.desc: 它中间的头倒下了。泥巴魔像从地里爬出来。

queen.name: 女王
queen.title: 海岛宫廷
queen.desc: 她的三名侍从替她挡下每一击，倒下后若不管就会重新站起。

shell-titan.name: 甲壳泰坦
shell-titan.title: 三块装甲板
shell-titan.desc: 每次冲锋后，它的三块装甲板会依次打开。趁有一块露出时猛攻。

chip-canyons.name: 薯片峡谷
chip-canyons.desc: 层层薯片堆成的悬崖。螃蟹在缝隙里横行。

coin-laundromat.name: 投币洗衣房
coin-laundromat.desc: 空地上一排排洗衣机嗡嗡作响。没人知道电费谁交。

compost-caves.name: 堆肥洞穴
compost-caves.desc: 堆肥下的潮湿隧道。孢子喷口会刺痛。

crop-circle.name: 麦田怪圈
crop-circle.desc: 麦子被压成完美的圆环。有东西降落过，还落下了船员。

frozen-tundra.name: 冻薯条苔原
frozen-tundra.desc: 薯条冻成的平原。霜冻地块会让Tibo发冷。

fry-oil-desert.name: 炸油沙漠
fry-oil-desert.desc: 滚烫的沙子，还有会烫伤人的炸油池。

fry-palace.name: 薯条宫得来速
fry-palace.desc: 荒野里孤零零的得来速，居然还开着。海鸥和浣熊霸占了停车场。

gutterball-lanes.name: 洗沟球道
gutterball-lanes.desc: 没有墙也没有顶的保龄球馆。球道还上着油，球瓶还立着。

ketchup-bog.name: 番茄酱沼泽
ketchup-bog.desc: 炙热的红色沼泽。番茄酱水坑会灼烧、减速。

mash-swamp.name: 土豆泥沼
mash-swamp.desc: 没过膝盖的土豆泥。会拖慢Tibo。

peel-forest.name: 薯皮森林
peel-forest.desc: 树皮像土豆皮的树林。带刺的荆棘会划伤。

potato-field.name: 土豆田
potato-field.desc: 整齐的土豆田垄。每一局都从这里开始。

russet-moor.name: 赤薯荒原
russet-moor.desc: 雾气弥漫的荒原，长满石楠，立着巨石，还有一座破败的风车。兽群在此狩猎。

vinegar-shoals.name: 醋味浅滩
vinegar-shoals.desc: 金色的潮滩，满是湿沙和酸水洼。浅滩下有东西在钻洞。

duchess-gardens.name: 公爵夫人花园
duchess-gardens.desc: 修剪整齐的树篱迷宫，铺着翠玉般的草坪和灰色碎石小径。宫廷在此举行觐见。

roast-caldera.name: 烘烤火山口
roast-caldera.desc: 冷却中的火山口上覆着苍白的灰烬，被缓慢熔岩的狭窄沟渠切开。甲壳的披甲巨兽在其中跋涉。

harvest-moon.name: 丰收月
harvest-moon.announce: 丰收月：30秒内金币翻倍

loose-change.name: 零钱
loose-change.announce: 烘干机里有零钱：20秒内金币翻倍

lost-saucer.name: 迷路飞碟
lost-saucer.announce: 迷路飞碟！打下来换金币！

lunch-rush.name: 午餐高峰
lunch-rush.announce: 午餐高峰！海鸥扑向停车场！

strike.name: 全中
strike.announce: 全中！保龄球从四面八方滚来！

crab-tide.name: 蟹潮
crab-tide.announce: 蟹潮！螃蟹从四面八方涌来！

big-gust.name: 狂风
big-gust.announce: 一阵狂风把所有宝石、硬币和零食吸向Tibo！

fry-rush.name: 薯条狂潮
fry-rush.announce: 武器射速提升30%，持续15秒！

picnic.name: 野餐
picnic.announce: Tibo周围下起零食雨，持续10秒！

beagle.name: 小探
beagle.desc: 指向最近的箱子、神龛或狗狗，还能找到散落的金币。

collie.name: 苔苔
collie.desc: 每隔几秒把你周围的敌人推开。

corgi.name: 华夫
corgi.desc: 每隔几秒叫一声，冻住附近的敌人（首领除外）。

dachshund.name: 肠肠
dachshund.desc: 每隔几秒刨出金币，偶尔还有零食或刷新。

greyhound.name: 嗖嗖
greyhound.desc: 每隔几秒冲穿一排敌人，把它们全部打伤。

pomchi.name: Zelda
pomchi.desc: 标记最近的精英或运宝怪，让它受到更多伤害。

pomeranian.name: Link
pomeranian.desc: 他的毛替你挡下一次攻击，然后一个喷嚏把害虫吹开。

retriever.name: 饼干
retriever.desc: 每隔几秒从远处给你叼回宝石、金币和零食。

saint-bernard.name: 桶桶
saint-bernard.desc: 你生命低时，跑过来给你回血。

terrier.name: 豆豆
terrier.desc: 冲向最近的敌人咬一口，大约每秒一次。

zelda-and-link.name: Zelda & Link
zelda-and-link.breed: 博美犬与吉娃娃博美混血
zelda-and-link.desc: Link 的毛和 Zelda 的标记，再加上日食：护住你，并标记你附近的所有害虫。

sigkitten.name: SIGKITTEN
sigkitten.desc: 入侵害虫的子弹：子弹越靠近你越慢，让你有更多时间闪避。差不多就是SIGSTOP。

dalmatian.name: 糖点点
dalmatian.desc: 每2秒咬一口附近的敌人，附加你的燃烧、减速或冰冻效果之一。

husky.name: 回声
husky.desc: 每隔几秒嚎叫一声，狗队里其他每只狗都会立刻行动。

newfoundland.name: 浮标
newfoundland.desc: 扑向靠近你的敌人子弹并接住它们。

saluki.name: 呼呼
saluki.desc: 紧跟在你脚边奔跑，每2秒扑向一只害虫，你移动越快，扑得越狠。

shiba.name: 可可
shiba.desc: Tibo击杀精英时，可可会召唤两只灵体小狗，猎杀害虫6秒。

whippet.name: 甩甩
whippet.desc: Tibo受到攻击时，甩甩会把他拉开一小段冲刺的距离，每15秒一次。

paidChest.name: 土豆箱
paidChest.desc: 要花金币。内含一件道具。每个箱子都比上一个贵。

chargeShrine.name: 土豆神龛
chargeShrine.desc: 站在里面充能，然后选一项属性。

curseShrine.name: 发霉神龛
curseShrine.desc: 领下诅咒，换一堆金币。诅咒会带来更多精英和首领。

microwave.name: 微波炉
microwave.desc: 站在旁边充能，然后复制一件道具。复制会熔掉另一件同稀有度的道具。

crops.name: 菜地
crops.desc: 打碎它，获得金币和零食。

eliteNest.name: 甲虫巢
eliteNest.desc: 这里有精英守着。会掉落宝箱。

bossLair.name: 首领巢穴
bossLair.desc: 首领在此沉睡。它守着一个大宝箱。

dog.name: 流浪狗
dog.desc: 一只好狗狗在找朋友。走过去吧。

botDock.name: Bot充电站
botDock.desc: 站在旁边，召唤一大群Grok Bot。

whetstone.name: 土豆磨刀石
whetstone.desc: 站在旁边充能，然后升级一把武器。

dinnerBell.name: 开饭铃
dinnerBell.desc: 敲响它，召来一圈害虫。它们掉落三倍经验。

taterSlots.name: 土豆老虎机
taterSlots.desc: 花金币转一次。两个一样就得道具。

seedVault.name: 种薯金库
seedVault.desc: 站在旁边充能，获得刷新次数、1次跳过和1次放逐。

taterMagnet.name: 土豆磁铁
taterMagnet.desc: 站在旁边，吸来所有宝石和金币。

rootTunnel.name: 树根隧道
rootTunnel.desc: 站在旁边，钻地道去远方。

spudFreezer.name: 土豆冰柜
spudFreezer.desc: 站在旁边，冻住地图上所有敌人7.5秒。首领只会减速。

frenzyFryer.name: 狂热油炸锅
frenzyFryer.desc: 站在旁边，狂热20秒。

goldenShrine.name: 黄金土豆神龛
goldenShrine.desc: 站在里面充能，然后选一项大祝福。

dogKennel.name: 狗窝
dogKennel.desc: 站在旁边，最多为你的狗狗买三个等级。

bubbler.name: 泡泡Bot
bubbler.desc: 用泡泡裹住Tibo一会儿，顺便帮他回血。

gifter.name: 礼物Bot
gifter.desc: 掉落一把金币、一颗值小半级的宝石，偶尔还有一个Bot信标。

tidier.name: 清洁Bot
tidier.desc: 把附近所有宝石和金币扫到Tibo身边。

zapper.name: 电击Bot
zapper.desc: 电击最近的虫子。精英只会被电一下，首领太大电不动。

frozen-fries-big-chill.name: 冰封大个
frozen-fries-big-chill.desc: 薯条瞄准最大的害虫。

frozen-fries-brain-freeze.name: 透心凉
frozen-fries-brain-freeze.desc: 每三轮齐射有一轮伤害大增。

fry-knives-back-knives.name: 回马刀
fry-knives-back-knives.desc: 每隔一把飞刀向后飞。

fry-knives-knife-storm.name: 飞刀风暴
fry-knives-knife-storm.desc: 蓄力后一次扔出三轮。

fry-lance-heavy-lance.name: 重型长枪
fry-lance-heavy-lance.desc: 每三道光束有一道超大。

fry-lance-jouster.name: 骑枪对决
fry-lance-jouster.desc: 长枪瞄准最大的害虫。

fry-sentry-rush-hour.name: 高峰时段
fry-sentry-rush-hour.desc: 蓄力后一次放下两倍数量。

gravy-boat-big-spill.name: 当头一泼
gravy-boat-big-spill.desc: 肉汁池落在最大的害虫脚下。

gravy-boat-deep-dish.name: 深盘
gravy-boat-deep-dish.desc: 一个巨大的池，而非多个。

gravy-boat-full-pour.name: 一倒到底
gravy-boat-full-pour.desc: 蓄力后一次倒三回。

peeler-haymaker.name: 全力一挥
peeler-haymaker.desc: 每三次挥砍有一次超大。

root-spikes-deep-roots.name: 根深蒂固
root-spikes-deep-roots.desc: 根刺优先扎最大的害虫。

root-spikes-root-quake.name: 根震
root-spikes-root-quake.desc: 每三次爆发有一次超大。

rosti-disc-disc-wheel.name: 飞盘转轮
rosti-disc-disc-wheel.desc: 飞盘均匀飞向四周。

rosti-disc-hard-toss.name: 大力飞盘
rosti-disc-hard-toss.desc: 每三次投掷有一次超大。

seeker-sprouts-burst.name: 嫩芽爆发
seeker-sprouts-burst.desc: 蓄力后向四周爆发。

seeker-sprouts-hopper.name: 跳跳芽
seeker-sprouts-hopper.desc: 嫩芽跳上目标后爆开。

sprout-satellites-big-sprout.name: 巨芽
sprout-satellites-big-sprout.desc: 一颗巨大卫星，而非多颗。

spud-cannon-bullseye.name: 正中靶心
spud-cannon-bullseye.desc: 炮弹瞄准最大的害虫。

spud-cannon-volley-fire.name: 齐射
spud-cannon-volley-fire.desc: 蓄力后一次发射三轮。

spud-lob-big-bounce.name: 大弹跳
spud-lob-big-bounce.desc: 每三次抛投有一次超大。

spud-lob-wide-lob.name: 广抛
spud-lob-wide-lob.desc: 土豆落点分得远得多。

starch-bolt-big-bolt.name: 巨型闪电
starch-bolt-big-bolt.desc: 一道巨型闪电，而非多道。

starch-bolt-lightning-rod.name: 避雷针
starch-bolt-lightning-rod.desc: 闪电优先劈最大的害虫。

starch-bolt-storm-front.name: 风暴前线
starch-bolt-storm-front.desc: 蓄力后一次劈三下。

steam-vent-scald.name: 烫伤
steam-vent-scald.desc: 蒸汽对精英和首领伤害大增。

tot-toss-tot-pile.name: 薯球堆
tot-toss-tot-pile.desc: 蓄力后一次扔出三轮。

tot-toss-tot-sniper.name: 薯球狙击
tot-toss-tot-sniper.desc: 薯球瞄准最大的害虫。

aurora.name: 极光
aurora.desc: 每25秒出现一次极光，经验价值变为三倍，Tibo的拾取范围翻倍。Tibo从土豆田深处出发。

blizzard.name: 暴风雪
blizzard.desc: 整局暴风雪肆虐。Tibo离篝火越远就越冷，冻得越厉害就越慢，靠近篝火能让他暖和回来。Tibo从冻薯条苔原深处出发。

bloodmoon.name: 血月
bloodmoon.desc: 精英出现频率翻倍、攻击更痛，每个精英掉落三倍经验和金币。Tibo从土豆泥沼深处出发。

drop.name: 害虫雨
drop.desc: 害虫不再走过来，而是从Tibo周围的天空落下，地上的影子会标出每只的落点。

echo.name: 回响日
echo.desc: Tibo的武器每第三次命中会在片刻后产生回响，击中附近所有害虫。Tibo从薯皮森林深处出发。

eclipse.name: 日食
eclipse.desc: Tibo周围只留下一圈光。光圈内的害虫受到更多伤害，光圈外的害虫只露出眼睛。Tibo从堆肥洞穴深处出发。

meteors.name: 流星雨
meteors.desc: 流星砸向Tibo附近最密集的敌群，每个陨坑会让坑内的害虫减速一段时间。Tibo从薯片峡谷深处出发。

migration.name: 迁徙
migration.desc: 每分钟有一群甲虫排成直线横穿地图，每只甲虫都会掉落大量经验。Tibo从薯皮森林深处出发。

rings.name: 发芽圈
rings.desc: 地面散布着发芽土豆圈，Tibo站在圈内时武器射速更快。Tibo从土豆泥沼深处出发。

sizes.name: 大小不一
sizes.desc: 四分之一的害虫是生命和经验更多的巨型害虫，四分之一是又小又快的迷你害虫。Tibo从麦田怪圈深处出发。

swarm.name: 虫潮日
swarm.desc: 每只害虫都带着一个双胞胎，害虫数量翻倍，但每只只有一半生命和一半经验。Tibo从土豆田深处出发。

tilt.name: 重力倾斜
tilt.desc: 地面每30秒倾斜转动一次，害虫和拾取物会向下坡滑。Tibo从薯片峡谷深处出发。

warp.name: 时间扭曲
warp.desc: 每15秒时间扭曲一次，害虫、首领和敌人子弹以半速移动3秒。Tibo从堆肥洞穴深处出发。

fog.name: 浓雾
fog.desc: 大雾笼罩堆肥洞穴。在雾中跟丢Tibo的害虫和首领会慢慢摸索，直到靠近，Tibo从洞穴深处出发。

hail.name: 冰雹
hail.desc: 冰雹不停砸向Tibo附近的害虫，被砸中的害虫和首领都会受伤并被击退，Tibo从薯皮森林深处出发。

heat.name: 热浪
heat.desc: 整局热浪滚滚，燃烧地面的蔓延频率翻倍，Tibo从炸油沙漠深处出发。

night.name: 长夜
night.desc: 整局都是黑夜，害虫和首领会从Tibo光照外的黑暗中更快冲来，Tibo从土豆田深处出发。

rain.name: 暴雨
rain.desc: 整局下雨，泥坑出现频率翻倍且更大，Tibo从土豆泥沼深处出发。

sandstorm.name: 沙尘暴
sandstorm.desc: 风沙吹过炸油沙漠，堆成沙丘，只减慢Tibo，不影响害虫和首领，Tibo从沙漠深处出发。

snow.name: 大冰封
snow.desc: 整局下雪，所有人移动变慢，冰霜区蔓延频率翻倍，Tibo从冻薯条苔原深处出发。

storm.name: 雷暴
storm.desc: 每隔几秒闪电会劈向Tibo附近最密集的敌群，范围内的害虫和首领都会受伤并被击退，Tibo从番茄酱沼泽深处出发。

comet-treads.name: 彗星战靴
comet-treads.desc: 区域和风暴效果持续时间延长25%。

crown-of-plenty.name: 丰饶王冠
crown-of-plenty.desc: 射击武器多发射一个投射物。

ember-striders.name: 余烬行者
ember-striders.desc: 射击可多穿透一个敌人。

fryers-apron.name: 炸锅围裙
fryers-apron.desc: 击杀精英增加{elite}秒狂热，击杀首领增加{boss}秒，最多{cap}秒。狂热期间，武器射速变为{fire}倍，Tibo移速变为{move}倍，受到的伤害减少{hurt}%。

larder-heart.name: 粮仓之心
larder-heart.desc: Tibo受到的伤害先从经验条扣除。满经验条可抵消{damage}伤害。经验条永远不会掉级。

leftover-lederhosen.name: 剩料皮短裤
leftover-lederhosen.desc: 超出害虫剩余生命值的伤害会转移到{range}单位内最近的首领，没有则转移到最近的害虫。转移的伤害不会暴击。武器伤害降低{less}%。

mash-ram-helm.name: 土豆泥羊角盔
mash-ram-helm.desc: 每次冲刺结束时爆出一团土豆泥。每击中一只害虫，冲刺充能时间减少{refund}秒。冲刺充能慢{slower}%。

one-potato-clogs.name: 独薯木屐
one-potato-clogs.desc: Tibo最多持有{weapons}把武器。木屐每封印一个武器栏，所有持有武器的伤害提高{damage}%、范围提高{area}%。

chili-bottle.name: 辣椒瓶
chili-bottle.desc: 捡起后，Tibo会朝面对的方向喷火10秒。火焰随他的伤害和范围增强。

dig-spot.name: X 标记处
dig-spot.desc: 站在X上，挖出一个宝箱。

lighthouse.name: 灯塔
lighthouse.desc: 站在旁边，点亮灯塔。螃蟹蜂拥而来，塔下落下一个宝箱。

mash-bomb.name: 土豆泥炸弹
mash-bomb.desc: 打破它，压扁屏幕上所有害虫。精英和首领损失五分之一最大生命。

rowboat.name: 划艇
rowboat.desc: 站进船里，划到对岸。

treasure-map.name: 藏宝图
treasure-map.desc: 读一读，标出一个X。在X处挖出宝箱。

event-horizon.desc: 事件视界：环绕物抹除小型敌方子弹，每个环绕物每 {dim} 秒一次。每次抹除：环绕伤害 +{gain}%，持续 {sec} 秒，最多 +{cap}%

hold-the-line.desc: 坚守阵线：护甲最多{cap}，近战范围内的害虫白挨一击{swing}倍伤害，冲刺变为架势；再次冲刺即可脱身
hold-the-line.label: 近战范围内每有1只害虫，护甲+{armor}，最多{twoCap}

overdrive.desc: 超频：冲刺穿过害虫或子弹可返还冲刺次数并积累热量。热量达到{heat}时，蒸汽清除附近子弹，武器攻速+{rate}%，持续{sec}秒
overdrive.label: 冲刺穿过子弹返还{refund}%冲刺充能时间

ricochet.desc: 跳弹：每次穿透，再加{jumps}次，会跳向{reach}内最近的新害虫，或从画面边缘弹回，每次跳跃+{gain}%伤害。

ships-bell.desc: 船钟：每 {period} 秒（冲刺可提前），爆炸武器额外齐射一轮

spreading-bog.desc: 在你的水洼中死去的害虫会留下沼泽（{damage}%伤害，最多{cap}个）。Tibo在沼泽中速度-{wade}%

static-step.desc: 静电步：行走积攒火花，最多{max}个。每次风暴齐射消耗一个，使每次攻击分叉到第二只害虫，造成三倍伤害。没有火花时，风暴武器充能慢{slow}%

the-hunt.desc: 狩猎：召唤物和狗狗追猎视野内最耐打的害虫，伤害提高{quarry}%。它倒下后，它们加速{howl}%，持续{seconds}秒
the-hunt.label: 召唤物和狗狗对精英和首领的伤害提高{elite}%

butter-streak.name: 奶油帶
butter-streak.desc: 每次衝刺都會留下一道融化的奶油帶，2秒內讓害蟲減速並受到灼燒。兩次衝刺之間，也會在Tibo剛走過的路上留下一道。

chip-shuriken.name: 洋芋片手裡劍
chip-shuriken.desc: 旋轉的洋芋片螺旋飛出。

frozen-fries.name: 冷凍薯條
frozen-fries.desc: 射出冷凍薯條，把敵人凍在原地。

fry-knives.name: 薯條飛刀
fry-knives.desc: 朝Tibo面對的方向射出鋒利薯條。

fry-lance.name: 薯條長槍
fry-lance.desc: 一根超長薯條，貫穿一整排。

fry-sentry.name: 薯條哨塔
fry-sentry.desc: 放下一座炸薯廚師砲塔，射擊附近的敵人。

frying-pan.name: 平底鍋
frying-pan.desc: 在Tibo面前揮舞平底鍋。拍回的敵方子彈會飛回射手。Tibo每擊敗一個菁英，下一擊就會蓄力，變得更大更重。

grab-bag.name: 福袋
grab-bag.desc: 把手伸進袋子，每次都打出另一把武器的攻擊。

gravy-boat.name: 肉汁船
gravy-boat.desc: 朝敵人倒下滾燙的肉汁池。

hash-boomerang.name: 薯餅迴力鏢
hash-boomerang.desc: 飛出去再飛回來的酥脆薯餅。

hash-brown-shield.name: 薯餅盾
hash-brown-shield.desc: 薯餅環繞Tibo旋轉。每塊薯餅為一次攻擊或子彈擋下至多20點傷害，然後碎成碎片，傷害附近的敵人。反傷會加到碎片傷害上。碎掉的薯餅會一塊塊重新炸脆。

hot-potato.name: 燙手山芋
hot-potato.desc: 在害蟲之間來回彈跳，計數歸零時在最後一隻身上爆炸。

julienne-dash.name: 切絲衝刺
julienne-dash.desc: 每次衝刺都把Tibo路線上的害蟲全部切成絲。兩次衝刺之間，也會沿著Tibo剛走過的路切絲。

mash-mallet.name: 馬鈴薯槌
mash-mallet.desc: 搗薯器砸向Tibo腳邊最近的害蟲。

mash-mortar.name: 薯泥臼砲
mash-mortar.desc: 放下一門臼砲，向遠處的害蟲發射馬鈴薯泥團。每團都會炸開，擊中周圍所有害蟲。

mash-wave.name: 薯泥波
mash-wave.desc: 一圈馬鈴薯泥從Tibo身邊滾開。

mezzaluna.name: 半月刀
mezzaluna.desc: 在Tibo前後剁砍。Tibo損失的生命值越多，傷害越高。

peel-lash.name: 薯皮鞭
peel-lash.desc: 一條長長的馬鈴薯皮抽中最近的害蟲，再跳到旁邊的一隻身上。

peeler.name: 削皮刀
peeler.desc: 橫向揮砍。4級起甩出薯皮穿過敵群，每級多一片。Tibo信賴的廚房工具。

potato-battery.name: 馬鈴薯電池
potato-battery.desc: 把帶電的電線夾在一隻害蟲身上。電線會電擊並減速碰到的每隻害蟲。被夾住的害蟲死後，電線會跳到下一隻身上。

potato-rain.name: 馬鈴薯雨
potato-rain.desc: 在Tibo周圍召喚一場馬鈴薯雨。

reset-button.name: Reset按鈕
reset-button.desc: 我們Reset了上限。清空畫面上所有敵人。頭目只會縮一下。

root-cellar.name: 馬鈴薯地窖
root-cellar.desc: Tibo周圍環繞著一圈地窖寒氣。穿過它的害蟲會被凍傷並短暫凍住。頭目只會減速。

root-spikes.name: 根刺
root-spikes.desc: 樹根從敵人腳下破土而出。

rosti-disc.name: 薯餅飛盤
rosti-disc.desc: 扁平的瑞士薯餅，在視野邊緣反彈。

salt-line.name: 鹽線
salt-line.desc: Tibo邊走邊撒鹽。踩到鹽的害蟲會減速並受到刺痛。

seeker-sprouts.name: 追蹤嫩芽
seeker-sprouts.desc: 會轉向敵人的嫩芽。

skillet-flail.name: 鐵鍋連枷
skillet-flail.desc: 一隻鐵鍋掃過Tibo身前的害蟲，也掃過他身後的害蟲。

small-fry.name: 小薯條
small-fry.desc: 一根起初很弱的迷你薯條，每親手擊殺一次就提升傷害，直到本局結束。

sprout-satellites.name: 嫩芽衛星
sprout-satellites.desc: 馬鈴薯嫩芽繞著Tibo轉一陣子。

spud-cannon.name: 馬鈴薯砲
spud-cannon.desc: 經典馬鈴薯槍。砲彈命中時炸開。

spud-dice.name: 馬鈴薯骰子
spud-dice.desc: 擲出一顆馬鈴薯骰子。1點啞火，2點冰凍，3點燃燒，4點分裂，5點給金幣，6點大爆炸。

spud-dynamo.name: 馬鈴薯發電機
spud-dynamo.desc: 兩團澱粉火花繞著Tibo轉，碰到什麼電什麼。

spud-lob.name: 拋馬鈴薯
spud-lob.desc: 把沉重的馬鈴薯高高拋起，砸進敵群。

starch-bolt.name: 澱粉閃電
starch-bolt.desc: 澱粉堆的靜電隨機打中敵人。

starch-chain.name: 澱粉連鎖
starch-chain.desc: 在敵人之間跳躍的電火花。

starch-puddle.name: 澱粉水窪
starch-puddle.desc: 在最近的一群害蟲腳下倒出一灘帶電澱粉。站在裡面的害蟲會被電擊並減速，直到水窪變乾。

steam-vent.name: 蒸氣口
steam-vent.desc: 烤馬鈴薯冒出的熱蒸氣，傷害附近的一切。

tater-mines.name: 馬鈴薯地雷
tater-mines.desc: 埋下馬鈴薯，敵人靠近就爆炸。

tater-pup.name: 薯球小狗
tater-pup.desc: 忠心的薯球小狗，跟著Tibo射擊。

tot-toss.name: 丟薯球
tot-toss.desc: 朝最近的敵人丟薯球。

whisk-vortex.name: 打蛋漩渦
whisk-vortex.desc: 在最大的敵群底下轉出打蛋器漩渦，把害蟲捲進去。

big-fry.name: 大薯條
big-fry.desc: 薯條穿透一切，變得越強，個頭越大。

bottomless-sack.name: 無底袋
bottomless-sack.desc: 一次掏出兩份零食，而且一掏出來就是進化版。

cast-iron.name: 鑄鐵鍋
cast-iron.desc: 雙向揮擊。拍回的子彈傷害更高、會穿透，還會追蹤害蟲。每擊敗一個菁英，下一擊就會蓄力。

cold-storage.name: 冷藏庫
cold-storage.desc: 更寬、更冷的寒圈。害蟲凍得更久，凍傷更重。

crater-pound.name: 馬鈴薯坑
crater-pound.desc: 搗薯器砸向Tibo腳邊的兩隻害蟲，每一砸都更寬。

dynamo-coil.name: 發電線圈
dynamo-coil.desc: 火花一直留在外面，第三團也加入。

factory-reset.name: 原廠Reset
factory-reset.desc: 徹底Reset。清空畫面，保留掉落物，治療Tibo。

fry-fortress.name: 薯條堡壘
fry-fortress.desc: 一次放下三座裝甲薯條砲塔。它們持續更久，波浪薯條可穿透敵人。

ghee-glide.name: 酥油滑行
ghee-glide.desc: 每次衝刺都會留下一道滾燙的酥油帶，讓害蟲減速並受到灼燒。兩次衝刺之間，也會在Tibo剛走過的路上留下一道。Tibo在酥油上行走速度提高15%。

golden-harvest.name: 黃金豐收
golden-harvest.desc: 一場金色馬鈴薯雨。擊殺可能掉金幣。

gratin-arc.name: 焗烤電弧
gratin-arc.desc: 起司電弧，連鎖很遠，常常爆擊。

gratin-puddle.name: 焗烤澱粉窪
