spark-corral.desc: Duk taku 60 da Tibo ya taka, yana kafa turken sitaci mai lantarki. Murɗaɗɗen bakan walƙiya mai faɗi ninki biyu na gudana tsakanin turakun, yana harbin ƙwari da ƙarfi sosai. Ƙarin turaku na tsayawa, kowanne yana ɗorewa 9 s.

tailgate-party.name: Bikin Soya
tailgate-party.desc: Soyayyen dankali mai man shanu na fesuwa a bayan Tibo idan yana gudu, kuma bugunsa ya fi ƙarfi sosai. Idan yana tsaye, yana ɗiga ɗaya a bayansa.

tater-minigun.name: Minigun Dankali
tater-minigun.desc: Irin jerin harbin daƙiƙa 2 da aka kafe, layi ɗaya ga kowane yawa, kuma kowane ɗan dankali na bugu da ƙarfi sosai.

tater-twister.name: Guguwar Dankali
tater-twister.desc: Ƙarin fayafayan kosan dankali na kewaye Tibo a zagaye mafi faɗi, suna bugawa da ƙarfi, suna juyawa daidai da saurin gudunsa. Idan yana tsaye, suna yin tafiyar hawainiya.

tot-cavalry.name: Dakarun Dankali
tot-cavalry.desc: Duk taku 40 da Tibo ya taka, rundunar ’yan dankali masu man shanu na kai hari daga bayansa, kowanne na ratsa ƙwari biyu. Idan Tibo yana tsaye, babu ’yan dankali.

wildfire-roast.name: Gobara a Jere
wildfire-roast.desc: Saran Zafi a Jere na ci da wuta fara fat. Kowace wuta da Tibo ya riƙe a kunne na sa sharewar ta ƙara nisa sosai, har biyar. Bugu ɗaya na kashe wuta biyu, tsayawa kuma na kashe su duka.

grease-fire.name: Wutar Man Soya
grease-fire.desc: Sharewar Gobara a Jere na fesa babban gajimaren man soya mai ci da wuta, kuma wutar da ke ƙafafun Tibo na kunna man ya zama kududdufai masu ci yayin da yake gudu. Kowace wuta da Tibo ya riƙe a kunne na sa sharewar ta ƙara nisa sosai, har biyar. Bugu ɗaya na kashe wuta biyu, tsayawa kuma na kashe su duka. Yana buɗe gurbin makami.

hash-carousel.name: Zagayen Kosan Dankali
hash-carousel.desc: Fayafayan kosan dankali na zinariya suna kewaye Tibo kuma suna jefa kosan dankali da ke tafiya waje su dawo. Suna juyawa da jifa daidai da saurin gudunsa, kuma suna yin tafiyar hawainiya idan yana tsaye. Yana buɗe gurbin makami.

loot-sling.name: Majajjawar Ganima
loot-sling.desc: Yana jawo kayan ciye-ciye biyu a rikiɗe daga buhu lokaci guda, kuma kowane lu’u-lu’un XP da Tibo ya tattara na wurga ƙarin ɗaya ta inda yake fuskanta. Yana buɗe gurbin makami.

starch-garden.name: Lambun Sitaci
starch-garden.desc: Tibo na jefa irin dankali masu takin zamani kan taron maƙiya, kuma duk taku 60 da ya taka, yana kafa turken sitaci da irin dankali a gindinsa. Kowace shuka na girma a matakai uku kuma tana harbin ƙwarin da ke kewaye da ita, kuma bakunan walƙiya tsakanin turakun suna ƙara ƙarfi tare da shukokinsu. Taka shuka don girbe fashewa. Yana buɗe gurbin makami.

tot-barrage.name: Luguden ’Yan Dankali
tot-barrage.desc: Ruwan ’yan dankali marar tsayawa. Duk ɗan dankalin da ya buga na fitar da wani da ke kai hari kan ƙwaro na gaba, kuma idan Tibo yana tafiya, rundunonin ’yan dankali na kai hari daga bayansa. Yana buɗe gurbin makami.

afterburner-fries.name: Soyayyen Dankalin Roka
afterburner-fries.desc: Kowace zabura na harba soyayyen dankali masu zafi a baya daga inda zaburar ta fara.

broadside.name: Harbin Gefe
broadside.desc: Yana harba jerin harsasan bindiga daga gefen Tibo biyu, a tsaye da hanyar gudunsa. Kowane harsashi na fashewa a kan ƙwaron farko da ya haɗu da shi ko inda ya sauka.

comet-scythe.name: Laujen Tauraro
comet-scythe.desc: Lauje na kewaya Tibo. Bayan kowace kewaya biyu, kewayarsa na faɗaɗa sannan ta dawo kusa, don haka yana yanka ƙwarin da ke ƙafar Tibo da zoben da ke bayansu.

harvest-moon.name: Watan Girbi
harvest-moon.desc: Watan dankali na kewaya Tibo. Kowane ƙwaro da ya taɓa na bin kewayarsa na ɗan lokaci, sannan a jefar da shi a buge shi. Ƙwaron da aka jefa ba za a sake kama shi ba na ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, kuma shugabanni sun yi nauyi a kama su.

hash-hawk.name: Shahon Dankali
hash-hawk.desc: Shaho na kosan dankali na shawagi a saman Tibo. Bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi yana faɗawa kan ƙwaro mafi tauri da ke kusa, shugaba da farko, sannan gwarzo, ya bugi duk abin da ke gefensa.

mash-golem.name: Ƙaton Dankali
mash-golem.desc: Ƙaton dakakken dankali na tashi a gaban Tibo ya yi tafiya ta inda yake fuskanta, yana ture ƙwari daga hanyarsa don buɗe hanya. A ƙarshen tafiyarsa yana buga ƙasa ya rushe.

mash-landing.name: Saukar Dankali
mash-landing.desc: Kowace zabura na ƙarewa da girgizar dakakken dankali da ke bugun kowane ƙwaro kewaye da Tibo ta ture shi baya.

peel-phantom.name: Fatalwar Ɓawo
peel-phantom.desc: Kowace zabura na barin kwafin Tibo na ɓawo inda zaburar ta fara. Ƙwarin da ke kusa na bin kwafin har sai ya fashe.

skipping-cannonball.name: Harsashin Igwa Mai Tsalle
skipping-cannonball.desc: Harsashin igwa na tsalle-tsalle a hanyar da Tibo ke fuskanta yana fashewa a kowane tsalle, kowace fashewa ta fi ta baya girma. Yawa na ƙara tsalle ɗaya.

sprout-squad.name: Rundunar Toho
sprout-squad.desc: Ƙwaron da ya faɗi zai iya tsiro da ɗan toho inda ya faɗi. Kowane toho na tsallaka zuwa ƙwaro mafi kusa ya cije shi har sai ya bushe. Ƙarin yawa na bari ƙarin toho su tsiro lokaci ɗaya.

spud-decoy.name: Dankalin Yaudara
spud-decoy.desc: A duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi Tibo na dasa dankali mai zare a bayansa. Ƙwarin da ke kusa na zuwa wurinsa maimakon Tibo, sannan ya fashe.

clockwork-spud.name: Dankalin Agogo
clockwork-spud.desc: Tibo na dasa dankalin zare a bayansa, kuma ƙwarin da ke kusa na zuwa wurinsu. Kowace fashewa na barin ƙaramin dankali da ake murɗa zarensa, sannan ya sake fashewa sau ɗaya.

eclipse-scythe.name: Laujen Kusufi
eclipse-scythe.desc: Laujojin rana da na wata na kewaya Tibo. Yayin da laujojin rana ke faɗaɗa nesa, laujojin wata na yanka kusa da ƙafafunsa, sannan su musanya wurare, don haka ƙwari na kusa da na nesa kullum suna cikin isa.

full-broadside.name: Cikakken Harbin Gefe
full-broadside.desc: Yana harba jerin harsasan bindiga biyu daga gefen Tibo biyu. Kowane harsashi na fashewa a kan ƙwaron farko da ya haɗu da shi ko inda ya sauka, kuma yana jefa ƙananan harsasai uku da ke fashewa inda suka sauka.

hash-harrier.name: Shirwar Dankali
hash-harrier.desc: Shirwayen kosan dankali masu fikafikan garwashi suna shawagi a saman Tibo, suna faɗawa kan ƙwaro mafi tauri da ke kusa, shugaba da farko, sannan gwarzo. Kowace faɗuwa tana barin ɓuraguzan kosan dankali masu ci da wuta waɗanda ke ƙona ƙwarin da ke tsaye a kansu.

hunters-moon.name: Watan Mafarauci
hunters-moon.desc: Manyan watannin dankali na kewaya Tibo suna kama ƙwari daga nesa fiye. Kowane ƙwaron da aka jefa na fashewa zuwa ƙurar wata inda ya faɗi, ya bugi ƙwarin da ke kewaye. Shugabanni sun yi nauyi a kama su.

jet-fryer.name: Tukunyar Soya Roka
jet-fryer.desc: Kowace zabura na harba layi biyu na soyayyen dankali masu zafi a baya daga inda zaburar ta fara. Kowane soyayyen dankali na watsa man soya mai zafi inda ya faɗi.

mash-colossus.name: Gagarumin Ƙaton Dankali
mash-colossus.desc: Wani ƙaton dakakken dankali mafi girma yana tafiya ta inda Tibo yake fuskanta. Kowane taku yana barin tabon dakakken dankali da ke rage gudun ƙwari, kuma bugunsa na ƙarshe yana tura zoben dakakken dankali yana birgima waje.

mash-meteor.name: Tauraron Dankali
mash-meteor.desc: Kowace zabura na ƙarewa da babbar girgizar dakakken dankali, sannan bayan ɗan lokaci zobe na biyu mafi faɗi ya biyo baya.

peel-poltergeist.name: Aljanin Ɓawo
peel-poltergeist.desc: Kowace zabura na barin ɓawo mai aljani inda zaburar ta fara. Ƙwari na bin sa har cikin ɓawayensa masu juyawa, sannan ya fashe da zoben ɓawaye.

root-legion.name: Rundunar Saiwa
root-legion.desc: Ƙarin toho na tsirowa kuma suna daɗewa, kuma sabon toho na fitowa kusa da Tibo kowace rabin daƙiƙa. Kowane toho da ya bushe yana barin tarkon saiwa da ke riƙe ƙwari a wurinsu na ɗan lokaci.

russet-ricochet.name: Harsashin Dankali Mai Tsalle
russet-ricochet.desc: Harsasan dankali suna tsalle-tsalle a buɗe kamar fanka a hanyar da Tibo ke fuskanta, suna fashewa a kowane tsalle, kowace fashewa ta fi ta baya girma. Kowace fashewa na jefa ɗan dankali kan ƙwaro na kusa, shi ma ya fashe. Yawa na ƙara tsalle ɗaya.

fry-by.name: Shawagin Soya
fry-by.desc: Soyayyen dankali na fesuwa a bayan Tibo idan yana gudu. Kowace zabura na harba faffaɗan layi biyu na soyayyen dankali a baya a kan hanyarsa, kuma kowane soyayyen dankali na layin na watsa man soya mai zafi inda ya faɗi. Yana buɗe gurbin makami.

gravy-pack.name: Garken Miya
gravy-pack.desc: Kwikwiyon dankali huɗu masu miya suna gudu tare da Tibo. Kowane cizo na warkar da Tibo 0.05 HP.

bacon-bits.name: Guntun Suya
bacon-bits.desc: +12% lahani ga gwaraza da shugabanni a kowane mataki.

butter-socks.name: Safar Man Shanu
butter-socks.desc: +1 adadin zabura a mataki 1, 3 da 5. Kowane mataki na rage hutun zabura da 6%.

four-eyed-spud.name: Dankali Mai Ido Huɗu
four-eyed-spud.desc: +10% sa’a a kowane mataki. Makaman harsasai suna harba +1 harsashi a mataki 2 da 4.

gpu.name: GPU
gpu.desc: +1 harsashi. Harbi na tara zafi. Idan zafi ya cika, makamai na harbi da rabin sauri na 3s. Kowane mataki na ƙara saurin harbi da sanyaya.

hot-sauce.name: Yaji
hot-sauce.desc: Yana ƙara damar bugun ƙarfi a kowane mataki. Yayin da damar bugun ƙarfinka ke ƙaruwa, ƙarin kowane mataki na raguwa.

root-network.name: Hanyar Saiwoyi
root-network.desc: +0.25 HP a kowace daƙiƙa a kowane mataki.

rotten-spud.name: Ruɓaɓɓen Dankali
rotten-spud.desc: +10% la’ana a kowane mataki: maƙiya masu ƙarfi, sauri da yawa, amma ƙarin XP da zinariya.

sour-cream.name: Kindirmo
sour-cream.desc: +20% lahanin bugun ƙarfi a kowane mataki.

starch-plating.name: Sulken Sitaci
starch-plating.desc: Yana rage lahanin kowane bugu, fiye da haka a kowane mataki. Maƙiya masu ƙarfi na ƙara ratsawa.

thick-skin.name: Fata Mai Kauri
thick-skin.desc: Tana ƙara damar kaucewa bugu a kowane mataki. Yayin da damar kaucewarka ke ƙaruwa, ƙarin kowane mataki na raguwa.

hot-start.name: Farawa da Zafi
hot-start.desc: Bayan kowace zabura, kowane makami na sake cikawa da sauri da 60% na 1.3 s. Kowane mataki na ƙara 0.3 s. Tibo na haskakawa yayin da yake aiki.

couch-potato.name: Dankalin Kujera
couch-potato.desc: Yayin da Tibo ke tsaye cak, lahani na ƙaruwa da 4% a daƙiƙa a kowane mataki, har zuwa 20% a kowane mataki. Motsi na mayar da shi farko.

gravy-splash.name: Fantsamar Miya
gravy-splash.desc: A duk 0.5 s, HP da Tibo ya warke na fantsama a matsayin lahani ga maƙiya na kusa: 100% nasa a kowane mataki.

hash-rush.name: Gudun Kosan Dankali
hash-rush.desc: Kowace zabura a cikin daƙiƙa 4 da suka wuce na ƙara lahani 4% a kowane mataki, har zabura 3.

hearty-helping.name: Rabo Mai Yawa
hearty-helping.desc: +2% lahani ga kowane ƙarin iyakar HP 50 da Tibo ya samu sama da iyakar HP ɗinsa na farko. Kowane mataki na ƙara wani 2% ga kowane 50.

lean-lunch.name: Abinci Kaɗan
lean-lunch.desc: +4% lahani da -2% hutu a kowane mataki ga kowane gurbin makami da babu komai.

mash-finisher.name: Dakan Ƙarshe
mash-finisher.desc: Bugu na murƙushe duk ƙwaron da ya rage ƙasa da 2% na iyakar HP ɗinsa a kowane mataki, har zuwa 15%. Gwaraza na murƙushewa a rabin haka. Shugabanni ba sa taɓa yi.

packed-pan.name: Kasko Maƙil
packed-pan.desc: +1% lahani ga kowane ƙwaro a cikin nisan ɗaukar Tibo, har ƙwari 10. Kowane mataki na ƙara wani 1% ga kowane ƙwaro.

peel-out.name: Guduwar Ɓawo
peel-out.desc: Bayan Tibo ya kauce wa bugu, makamansa na yin lahani ninki biyu na 2 s. Ɓawo na juyawa kewaye da shi yayin da yake aiki.

spry-sprout.name: Toho Mai Kuzari
spry-sprout.desc: Kowane mataki na rage hutun zabura da 5%.

tater-trot.name: Sassarfar Dankali
tater-trot.desc: Kowane 1% na ƙarin saurin tafiya na ƙara 1% saurin harbi, har zuwa 8% a kowane mataki.

aged-russet.name: Tsohon Dankali
aged-russet.desc: +0.5% lahani a kowane mataki ga kowane mataki da Tibo ya hau a wannan zagaye, har zuwa +10% a kowane mataki.

clean-plate.name: Faranti Mai Tsabta
clean-plate.desc: Bayan 5 s ba tare da bugu ba, +12% damar bugun ƙarfi a kowane mataki. Bugu ɗaya na rage mataki ɗaya.

baked-buckler.name: Garkuwar Dankali
baked-buckler.desc: Tana rage lahanin kowane bugu. Maƙiya masu ƙarfi na ƙara ratsawa.

boom-spud.name: Dankalin Fashewa
boom-spud.desc: Maƙiyan da aka kashe na iya fashewa.

coal-baked-spud.name: Dankalin Garwashi
coal-baked-spud.desc: 15% na bugu na cinna wa maƙiya wuta.

coupon-book.name: Littafin Rangwame
coupon-book.desc: Duk abin da ka saya na rahusa.

freezer-burn.name: Ƙunar Firji
freezer-burn.desc: Maƙiyan da suka daskare na tarwatsewa idan sun mutu, su daskarar da maƙiya na kusa.

ghost-pepper.name: Barkonon Fatalwa
ghost-pepper.desc: Ba a iya taɓa Tibo na 0.15 s bayan kowace zabura ta ƙare.

ghost-skin.name: Fatar Fatalwa
ghost-skin.desc: Tana ƙara damar kaucewa bugu. Yayin da damar kaucewarka ke ƙaruwa, ƙarin da take bayarwa na raguwa.

heavy-russet.name: Dankali Mai Nauyi
heavy-russet.desc: 2% na bugu na BONK da lahani ninki 15.

hot-pepper.name: Barkono
hot-pepper.desc: Yana ƙara damar bugun ƙarfi. Yayin da damar bugun ƙarfinka ke ƙaruwa, ƙarin da yake bayarwa na raguwa.

philosophers-potato.name: Dankalin Masani
philosophers-potato.desc: +10% ga lahani, faɗi, sauri da tsawo.

porcupine-spud.name: Dankalin Beguwa
porcupine-spud.desc: Idan an bugi Tibo, yana harba dankalin soya 10 zuwa kowane ɓangare.

second-spud.name: Dankali na Biyu
second-spud.desc: Farfaɗo sau ɗaya da rabin HP.

spicy-croquette.name: Kosan Dankali Mai Yaji
spicy-croquette.desc: 12% na bugu na fashewa da harshen wuta.

static-tot.name: Dankalin Lantarki
static-tot.desc: 10% na bugu na tura walƙiya zuwa ƙarin maƙiya 3.

thorny-jacket.name: Rigar Ƙaya
thorny-jacket.desc: Maƙiyan da suka bugi Tibo na shan lahani 8.

vampire-tot.name: Dankalin Jini
vampire-tot.desc: Warkar da 0.05 HP a kowane kisa.

wandering-eyes.name: Idanun Yawo
wandering-eyes.desc: 20% na kisa na aika idanun dankali 2 su bi wasu maƙiya.

all-seeing-spud.name: Dankali Mai Ganin Komai
all-seeing-spud.desc: 35% na kisa na aika idanun dankali 4 da ke huda maƙiya.

bonfire-spud.name: Dankalin Babbar Wuta
bonfire-spud.desc: 25% na bugu na cinna wa maƙiya wuta, kuma wutar na bazuwa zuwa maƙiyan da ke kewaye da su.

fry-volcano.name: Dutsen Wutar Dankalin Soya
fry-volcano.desc: Idan an bugi Tibo, yana fashewa da ƙarfi ya harba dankalin soya 24 da ke huda maƙiya.

glacier-spud.name: Dankalin Ƙanƙara
glacier-spud.desc: A 30% na kisa, maƙiyin da aka kashe na tarwatsewa, ya daskarar da maƙiya na kusa, ya kuma rage gudun maƙiyan da ke kewaye da su.

kaboom-spud.name: Dankalin Babbar Fashewa
kaboom-spud.desc: A 25% na kisa, maƙiyin da aka kashe na fashewa, ya yi wa maƙiya na kusa lahani daidai da rabin iyakar HP ɗinsa.

magma-croquette.name: Kosan Dankali na Magma
magma-croquette.desc: 20% na bugu na tayar da babbar fashewa da ke cinna wa maƙiya wuta.

meteor-russet.name: Dankalin Meteor
meteor-russet.desc: 3% na bugu na saukar da meteor da lahani ninki 20, wanda kuma ke bugun maƙiyan da ke kewaye da shi.

storm-tot.name: Dankalin Hadari
storm-tot.desc: 15% na bugu na tura walƙiya zuwa ƙarin maƙiya 6, tare da tsawa a kan kowanne.

static-socks.name: Safa Mai Lantarki
static-socks.desc: Kowace zabura na ƙarewa da walƙiyar sitaci a kan maƙiya 3 mafi kusa, lahani 176 kowanne.

frozen-pea.name: Daskararren Wake
frozen-pea.desc: 8% na bugu na daskarar da maƙiyi na 1 s. Shugabanni kuma na rage gudu maimakon haka.

fry-fuel.name: Fetur ɗin Soya
fry-fuel.desc: Kowane kisa 30 na maido da zabura ɗaya.

lightning-spud.name: Dankalin Walƙiya
lightning-spud.desc: 6% na bugu na saukar da walƙiya kan maƙiyan da ke kewaye da su.

mash-splat.name: Fantsamar Dankali
mash-splat.desc: Kowace zabura na sauka da fantsamar dakakken dankali da ke bugun maƙiyan da ke kewaye da Tibo.

midnight-fries.name: Dankalin Soya na Tsakar Dare
midnight-fries.desc: +5% lahani. Bayan 20:00, lahani na ƙara ƙaruwa da 6% kowane minti.

moon-dust.name: Ƙurar Wata
moon-dust.desc: 15% na kisa na fashewa zuwa ƙurar wata da ke rage gudun maƙiya na kusa.

receipt-spud.name: Dankalin Rasiti
receipt-spud.desc: Kowane akwati ko kwali da ka buɗe na ba da +2% lahani har ƙarshen zagayen.

souffle-spud.name: Dankali Mai Kumburi
souffle-spud.desc: Idan aka bugi Tibo, yana kumbura ya ture maƙiya na kusa can.

spud-spring.name: Tsallen Dankali
spud-spring.desc: Yana rage hutun zabura da 15%. Yana taruwa har sau 3.

tailwind-tater.name: Dankalin Iskar Baya
tailwind-tater.desc: +1% lahani ga kowane 2% na saurin tafiya sama da na asali.

tater-treat.name: Tukuicin Dankali
tater-treat.desc: Karnuka na amfani da dabarunsu 25% fiye da da.

mash-crater.name: Ramin Dakakken Dankali
mash-crater.desc: Kowace zabura na sauka a cikin babban ramin dakakken dankali da ke watsa kosan dankali 8 waje.

copper-tot.name: Dankalin Jan Ƙarfe
copper-tot.desc: Ɗaukar zinariya na da damar 25% ta bugi wani ƙwaro a kan allo da babban lahani.

panic-fry.name: Dankalin Soya na Tsoro
panic-fry.desc: A lokacin farko a kowane minti da Tibo ya faɗi ƙasa da 50% HP, ƙwari suna jinkiri da 5% na tsawon 3 s, kuma bugunsa yana yin lahani ƙarin 25%.

second-helping.name: Ƙarin Abinci
second-helping.desc: Kowane kayan ciye-ciye da Tibo ya ci da cikakken HP na ba da +1% lahani har ƙarshen zagayen, har zuwa +10% a kowane mataki.

spark-spud.name: Dankalin Tartsatsi
spark-spud.desc: Tafiya na cajin tartsatsi. Duk taku 300 da Tibo ya taka, yana fashewa, yana bugun ƙwarin da ke kewaye da shi kuma yana sa su dimauta.

spud-purse.name: Jakar Kuɗin Dankali
spud-purse.desc: Duk taku 100 da Tibo ya taka, yana jefa tsabar kuɗi, taku 16 da wuri ga kowane ƙarin kwafi.

warm-bowl.name: Kwano Mai Ɗumi
warm-bowl.desc: Cajin kowane zoben kunnawa na barin tafkin warkarwa a wurin na 10 s.

armoured-dune-manticore.name: Manticore na Tudun Yashi Mai Sulke

amusing.title: ’Yar Tsanar Biki
amusing.desc: ’Yar tsanar bikin dankali, mai laushi da ruwan hoda. Yana ɗaga hannu, yana jefa zukata da auduga, sannan ya yi tsalle ya rungume ka har ya matse sitaci daga jikinka.
amusing.name: amusing

beetle-queen.name: Sarauniyar Colorado
beetle-queen.title: Uwar Ƙwari
beetle-queen.desc: Sarauniyar ƙwaron dankali mai ratsi. ’Ya’yanta na ƙyanƙyashewa a zobe kewaye da Tibo.

compost-titan.name: Ƙaton Taki
compost-titan.title: Tulin Ruɓa
compost-titan.desc: Tulin ganyaye masu ruɓewa da taki. Tsutsotsi na kwarara daga cikinsa.

deep-freezer.name: Babban Firji
deep-freezer.title: Mai Gadin Dankalin Ƙanƙara
deep-freezer.desc: Firjin ajiya mai tafiya. Ƙanƙararsa tana daskarar da kai na ɗan lokaci.

fryer-king.name: Sarkin Soya
fryer-king.title: Hakimin Zafaffen Mai
fryer-king.desc: Tukunyar soya mai rawani. Tana tofa zobban tafasasshen mai.

grater-golem.name: Ƙaton Abin Gurza
grater-golem.title: Mai Gutsurewa
grater-golem.desc: Abin gurza a kan ƙafafu. Yana kai hari a kan layin da aka yi wa alama.

great-wireworm.name: Babbar Tsutsar Waya
great-wireworm.title: Mai Huda Dankali
great-wireworm.desc: Babbar tsutsar waya. Tana huda ƙasa ta fito ƙarƙashin Tibo.

harvester.name: Injin Girbi
harvester.title: Ƙarshen Damina
harvester.desc: Injin girbi. Yana kai hari a dogayen layuka. Tsoron ƙarshe na kowane dankali.

ketchup-kraken.name: Dodon Tumatir
ketchup-kraken.title: Firgicin Fadama
ketchup-kraken.desc: Dodon teku na miyar tumatir. Hannayensa na buga ƙasa a tsari.

late-blight.name: Ruɓar Ganye
late-blight.title: Hazon Yunwa
late-blight.desc: Gajimaren cutar shuka mai rarrafe. Gajimaren fumfuna na fitowa inda ya nuna.

sir-strawman.name: Malam Ciyawa
sir-strawman.title: Mai Tsaron Layuka
sir-strawman.desc: Dodon gona mai sulke. Yana jefa ciyawa masu kaifi a buɗe kamar fanka.

the-mandoline.name: Abin Yanka
the-mandoline.title: Mai Yanka Dankalin Soya
the-mandoline.desc: Abin yanka mai rai. Wuƙarsa na sharewa a kan layuka.

the-masher.name: Taɓarya
the-masher.title: Ɗan Sandan Kicin
the-masher.desc: Ƙatuwar taɓarya. Tana buga inda Tibo ke tsaye.

pack-lord.name: Sarkin Garke
pack-lord.title: Jagoran Farauta
pack-lord.desc: Ƙaton jagora mai shugabantar garkuna. Yana tsalle a jere yana kai hari, yana kiran mafarautansa, kuma kowane garke yana watsewa idan ya faɗi.

root-hydra.name: Dodon Saiwa
root-hydra.title: Kawuna Uku
root-hydra.desc: Dodo mai lulluɓin saiwoyi da ke fitowa daga ƙasa. Kawunansa uku suna cizo a kan layuka.

root-hydra-frenzy.name: Dodon Saiwa
root-hydra-frenzy.title: Kawuna Biyar
root-hydra-frenzy.desc: Kawuna biyar masu jajayen idanu da raunuka. Yana kai farmaki.

root-hydra-head.name: Kan Dodon Saiwa
root-hydra-head.title: Haƙa Ƙasa
root-hydra-head.desc: Ɗaya daga cikin kawunan dodon yana fitowa daga ƙasa, ya tofa laka, sannan ya sake nutsewa. Kowane bugu da ya sha yanzu yana raunana dodon na 29:00.

root-hydra-mire.name: Dodon Saiwa
root-hydra-mire.title: Tafkuna
root-hydra-mire.desc: Kawuna biyu suna nutsewa cikin ƙasa suna tofa tafkunan laka a ko’ina a filin.

root-hydra-stump.name: Dodon Saiwa
root-hydra-stump.title: Kututture
root-hydra-stump.desc: Kansa na tsakiya ya faɗi. Ƙattan Laka suna rarrafe daga ƙasa.

queen.name: Sarauniya
queen.title: Fadar Tsibiri
queen.desc: Bayinta uku suna kare ta daga kowane bugu, kuma suna dawowa idan aka bar su a kwance.

shell-titan.name: Ƙaton Kwanso
shell-titan.title: Faranti Uku
shell-titan.desc: Farantinsa uku suna buɗewa bi da bi bayan kowane farmaki. Ka keta ciki yayin da ɗaya ke buɗe.

chip-canyons.name: Kwazazzabon Dankali
chip-canyons.desc: Tsaunuka na yankakken dankalin soyayye a jere. Kaguwa na rarrafe a cikin tsagu.

coin-laundromat.name: Wanki na Tsabar Kuɗi
coin-laundromat.desc: Layukan injin wanki na ƙara a filin da babu kowa. Ba wanda ya san wanda ke biyan kuɗin wuta.

compost-caves.name: Kogon Taki
compost-caves.desc: Ramuka masu danshi ƙarƙashin tulin taki. Ramukan fumfuna na harbawa.

crop-circle.name: Da’irar Gona
crop-circle.desc: Alkama da aka danne cikin zobba cikakku. Wani abu ya sauka a nan ya bar ma’aikatansa.

frozen-tundra.name: Filin Ƙanƙara na Dankali
frozen-tundra.desc: Fili mai sanyi na soyayyen dankali. Ƙanƙara na sanyaya Tibo.

fry-oil-desert.name: Hamadar Man Soya
fry-oil-desert.desc: Yashi mai zafi da kududdufan man soya da ke ƙonawa.

fry-palace.name: Fadar Soya ta Mota
fry-palace.desc: Gidan abinci na mota shi kaɗai a jeji, har yanzu a buɗe. Tsuntsayen teku da rakun ne ke mulkin filin ajiye motoci.

gutterball-lanes.name: Hanyoyin Bowling
gutterball-lanes.desc: Wurin bowling ne marar bango ko rufi. Har yanzu hanyoyin suna da mai, kwalaben kuma suna tsaye.

ketchup-bog.name: Fadamar Tumatir
ketchup-bog.desc: Fadama ja mai zafi. Kududdufan miyar tumatir na ƙonawa da rage gudu.

mash-swamp.name: Fadamar Dankali
mash-swamp.desc: Dakakken dankali har gwiwa. Yana rage gudun Tibo.

peel-forest.name: Dajin Ɓawo
peel-forest.desc: Bishiyoyi masu ɓawo kamar na dankali. Ƙayoyi suna karcewa.

potato-field.name: Gonar Dankali
potato-field.desc: Layukan shukar dankali a tsare. Nan ne kowane zagaye ke farawa.

russet-moor.name: Filin Dankalin Ja
russet-moor.desc: Fili mai hazo da ciyayi, duwatsu a tsaye da injin iska da ya rushe. Garkuna suna farauta a nan.

vinegar-shoals.name: Gaɓar Ruwan Tsami
vinegar-shoals.desc: Gaɓar teku mai launin zinariya da yashi mai jiƙe da tafkunan tsami. Wani abu yana haƙa rami ƙarƙashin ruwa mara zurfi.

duchess-gardens.name: Lambunan Basarakiya
duchess-gardens.desc: Hanyar ruɗu ta shingayen ciyayi da aka datse, ciyawar jade da hanyoyin tsakuwa masu toka. A nan Fada ke karɓar baƙi.

roast-caldera.name: Ramin Gasa
roast-caldera.desc: Toka mai fari a kan ramin dutsen wuta da ke hucewa, wanda ƙananan magudanan narkakken dutse masu tafiyar hawainiya suka ratsa. Manyan dabbobi masu sulke na Kwanso suna takawa a ciki.

harvest-moon.name: Watan Girbi
harvest-moon.announce: Watan Girbi: zinariya ninki biyu na 30 s

loose-change.name: Kuɗin Canji
loose-change.announce: Canji a cikin injinan busarwa: zinariya ninki biyu na 20 s

lost-saucer.name: Faifan da Ya Ɓata
lost-saucer.announce: Faifan da ya ɓata! Harbo shi don zinariya!

lunch-rush.name: Rububin Abincin Rana
lunch-rush.announce: Lokacin abincin rana! Tsuntsun teku na kutsowa a faɗin filin!

strike.name: Strike
strike.announce: Strike! Ƙwallon bowling na birgima daga ko’ina!

crab-tide.name: Ambaliyar Kaguwa
crab-tide.announce: Ambaliyar kaguwa! Kaguwa suna zuwa daga kowane gefe!

big-gust.name: Babbar Iska
big-gust.announce: Iska na jawo duk lu’u-lu’u, tsabar kuɗi da kayan ciye-ciye zuwa Tibo!

fry-rush.name: Rububin Soya
fry-rush.announce: Makamai na harba da sauri 30% na 15 s!

picnic.name: Liyafar Waje
picnic.announce: Kayan ciye-ciye na zuba kamar ruwan sama kewaye da Tibo na 10 s!

beagle.name: Scout
beagle.desc: Yana nuna kwali, rumfa ko kare mafi kusa, kuma yana samo zinariya a warwatse.

collie.name: Moss
collie.desc: A duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, yana ture maƙiyan da ke kewaye da kai baya.

corgi.name: Waffles
corgi.desc: A duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, yana yin haushi ya daskarar da maƙiya na kusa (ban da shugabanni).

dachshund.name: Frank
dachshund.desc: A duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, yana haƙo zinariya, wani lokaci kuma abin ciye-ciye ko damar Sake.

greyhound.name: Zoom
greyhound.desc: A duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, yana ratsa layin maƙiya da gudu yana cutar da su duka.

pomchi.name: Zelda
pomchi.desc: Yana yi wa gwarzo ko ɓarawon ganima mafi kusa alama don ya sha ƙarin lahani.

pomeranian.name: Link
pomeranian.desc: Gashinsa na ɗaukar bugu na gaba da zai same ka, sannan ya yi atishawa ya watsar da ƙwari.

retriever.name: Biscuit
retriever.desc: A duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, yana kawo maka lu’u-lu’u, zinariya da kayan ciye-ciye daga nesa.

saint-bernard.name: Barrel
saint-bernard.desc: Idan lafiyarka ta yi ƙasa, yana gudu zuwa gare ka ya warkar da kai.

terrier.name: Pip
terrier.desc: Yana afkawa maƙiyi mafi kusa ya cije shi, kusan sau ɗaya a daƙiƙa.

zelda-and-link.name: Zelda & Link
zelda-and-link.desc: Gashin Link da alamomin Zelda, tare da husufi da ke kare ka kuma ya yi wa kowane ƙwaro kusa da kai alama.

sigkitten.name: SIGKITTEN
sigkitten.desc: Yana kutse harsasan ƙwari: suna rage gudu yayin da suke kusantowa gare ka, don haka kana da ƙarin lokaci don kaucewa. Kamar SIGSTOP.

dalmatian.name: Sprinkles
dalmatian.desc: Yana cizon maƙiyi na kusa duk daƙiƙa 2 kuma yana ɗora masa ɗaya daga cikin ƙonewa, rage gudu ko daskarewa da kake da su.

husky.name: Echo
husky.desc: Yana kuka duk bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, kuma kowane sauran kare a tawagarka yana aiki nan take.

newfoundland.name: Buoy
newfoundland.desc: Yana tsallake zuwa harsasan abokan gaba da suka kusance ka, ya kama su.

saluki.name: Gale
saluki.desc: Yana gudu a bayanka yana afkawa ƙwaro sau ɗaya a kowace daƙiƙa 2, da ƙarfi yayin da kake ƙara sauri.

shiba.name: Kiko
shiba.desc: Idan Tibo ya kashe gwarzo, Kiko na kiran kwikwiyon ruhi biyu da ke farautar ƙwari na 6 s.

whippet.name: Whip
whippet.desc: Idan an bugi Tibo, Whip na jan shi nesa kaɗan kamar gajeriyar zabura, sau ɗaya a kowace 15 s.

paidChest.name: Kwalin Dankali
paidChest.desc: Yana cin zinariya. Yana ɗauke da kaya. Kowane kwali na tsada fiye da na baya.

chargeShrine.name: Rumfar Dankali
chargeShrine.desc: Tsaya a cikinta don cajin ta, sannan ka zaɓi hali.

curseShrine.name: Rumfa Mai Fumfuna
curseShrine.desc: Karɓi la’ana kan tarin zinariya. La’ana na kawo ƙarin gwaraza da shugabanni.

vendor.name: Amalanken Soya
vendor.desc: Yana sayar da kaya kan zinariya.

microwave.name: Microwave
microwave.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don cajin sa, sannan ka kwafi ɗaya daga cikin kayanka. Kwafin na narkar da wani kaya na aji ɗaya.

crops.name: Ƙaramar Gona
crops.desc: Fasa shi don zinariya da abin ciye-ciye.

eliteNest.name: Gidan Ƙwaro
eliteNest.desc: Gwarzo na jira a nan. Yana barin akwati.

bossLair.name: Kogon Shugaba
bossLair.desc: Shugaba na barci a nan. Yana gadin babban akwati.

dog.name: Karen Titi
dog.desc: Kare nagari da ke neman aboki. Je ka wurinsa.

botDock.name: Tashar Bot
botDock.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don kiran garken ’yan Grok Bot.

whetstone.name: Dutsen Wasa na Dankali
whetstone.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don cajin sa, sannan ka ɗaga matakin ɗaya daga cikin makamanka.

dinnerBell.name: Ƙararrawar Abinci
dinnerBell.desc: Kaɗa ta don kiran zoben ƙwari. Suna barin XP ninki uku.

taterSlots.name: Injin Sa’a
taterSlots.desc: Biya zinariya don juyawa. Haɗa biyu don samun kaya.

seedVault.name: Rumbun Iri
seedVault.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don cajin sa don Sake, Wuce ɗaya da Kore ɗaya.

taterMagnet.name: Babban Maganaɗisu
taterMagnet.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don jawo duk lu’u-lu’u da tsabar kuɗi.

rootTunnel.name: Ramin Saiwa
rootTunnel.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don bin rami zuwa wuri mai nisa.

taterLantern.name: Fitilar Dankali
taterLantern.desc: Fasa ta don ganin abin mamaki.

spudFreezer.name: Firjin Dankali
spudFreezer.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don daskarar da kowane maƙiyi a taswira na 7.5 s. Shugabanni kawai suna rage gudu.

frenzyFryer.name: Tukunyar Hauka
frenzyFryer.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don hauka na 20 s.

goldenShrine.name: Rumfar Dankalin Zinariya
goldenShrine.desc: Tsaya kusa da ita don cajin ta, sannan ka zaɓi babbar albarka.

dogKennel.name: Gidan Karnuka
dogKennel.desc: Tsaya kusa da shi don sayen har mataki uku ga karnukanka.

bubbler.name: Bot Mai Kumfa
bubbler.desc: Yana naɗe Tibo cikin kumfa na ɗan lokaci, yana gyara shi.

gifter.name: Bot Mai Kyauta
gifter.desc: Yana jefa ɗan dintsin tsabar kuɗi, lu’u-lu’u mai darajar wani ɓangare na mataki, kuma lokaci-lokaci Fitilar Bot.

tidier.name: Bot Mai Share
tidier.desc: Yana share duk lu’u-lu’u da tsabar kuɗi na kusa zuwa wurin Tibo.

zapper.name: Bot Mai Walƙiya
zapper.desc: Yana harbin ƙwari mafi kusa da walƙiya. Gwaraza na samun girgiza kawai, shugabanni kuma sun yi girma da yawa.

frozen-fries-big-chill.name: Babban Sanyi
frozen-fries-big-chill.desc: Yana nufar ƙwaro mafi girma.

frozen-fries-brain-freeze.name: Daskarar Kai
frozen-fries-brain-freeze.desc: Kowane harbi na uku ya fi ƙarfi sosai.

fry-knives-back-knives.name: Wuƙaƙen Baya
fry-knives-back-knives.desc: Kowace wuƙa ta biyu na tashi baya.

fry-knives-knife-storm.name: Guguwar Wuƙaƙe
fry-knives-knife-storm.desc: Yana jira, sai ya jefa harbi uku tare.

fry-lance-heavy-lance.name: Mashi Mai Nauyi
fry-lance-heavy-lance.desc: Kowane haske na uku ƙato ne.

fry-lance-jouster.name: Jarumi
fry-lance-jouster.desc: Mashin na nufar ƙwaro mafi girma.

fry-sentry-order-up.name: Ga Abinci!
fry-sentry-order-up.desc: Masu gadi na harbin ƙwaro mafi girma.

fry-sentry-rush-hour.name: Cunkoso
fry-sentry-rush-hour.desc: Yana jira, sai ya ajiye ninki biyu.

gravy-boat-big-spill.name: Zubar Miya
gravy-boat-big-spill.desc: Miya na sauka ƙasan ƙwaro mafi girma.

gravy-boat-full-pour.name: Cikakken Zuba
gravy-boat-full-pour.desc: Yana jira, sai ya zuba sau uku tare.

peeler-backhand.name: Marin Baya
peeler-backhand.desc: Sara na mayar da harsasai baya.

peeler-haymaker.name: Babban Naushi
peeler-haymaker.desc: Kowane sara na uku ƙato ne.

root-spikes-deep-roots.name: Saiwa Mai Zurfi
root-spikes-deep-roots.desc: Ƙaya na fara da ƙwari mafi girma.

root-spikes-root-quake.name: Girgizar Saiwa
root-spikes-root-quake.desc: Kowace fashewa ta uku ƙatuwa ce.

rosti-disc-disc-wheel.name: Kewayen Faifai
rosti-disc-disc-wheel.desc: Faifai na bazuwa daidai a kewaye.

rosti-disc-hard-toss.name: Jifa Mai Ƙarfi
rosti-disc-hard-toss.desc: Kowace jifa ta uku ƙatuwa ce.

seeker-sprouts-big-game.name: Babbar Farauta
seeker-sprouts-big-game.desc: Toho na farautar ƙwaro mafi girma.

seeker-sprouts-burst.name: Fashewar Toho
seeker-sprouts-burst.desc: Yana jira, sai ya fashe a kewaye.

seeker-sprouts-hopper.name: Mai Tsalle
seeker-sprouts-hopper.desc: Yana tsalle kai, sai ya fashe.

sprout-satellites-spin-cycle.name: Saurin Juyi
sprout-satellites-spin-cycle.desc: Taurari na juyawa da sauri sosai.

spud-cannon-bullseye.name: Kai Tsaye
spud-cannon-bullseye.desc: Harsasai na nufar ƙwaro mafi girma.

spud-cannon-volley-fire.name: Ruwan Harbi
spud-cannon-volley-fire.desc: Yana jira, sai ya harba harbi uku tare.

spud-lob-big-bounce.name: Babban Billa
spud-lob-big-bounce.desc: Kowace jifa ta uku ƙatuwa ce.

spud-lob-hot-landing.name: Saukar Zafi
spud-lob-hot-landing.desc: Dankali na fashewa inda ya sauka.

spud-lob-wide-lob.name: Jifa Mai Faɗi
spud-lob-wide-lob.desc: Dankali na sauka nesa da juna sosai.

starch-bolt-lightning-rod.name: Sandar Walƙiya
starch-bolt-lightning-rod.desc: Walƙiya na fara bugun ƙwari mafi girma.

starch-bolt-storm-front.name: Gaban Hadari
starch-bolt-storm-front.desc: Yana jira, sai ya buga sau uku tare.

steam-vent-rolling-boil.name: Tafarfasa
steam-vent-rolling-boil.desc: Tururi na tashi da sauri sosai.

steam-vent-scald.name: Ƙuna
steam-vent-scald.desc: Tururi ya fi cutar gwaraza da shugabanni sosai.

tater-pup-top-dog.name: Sarkin Karnuka
tater-pup-top-dog.desc: Kwikwiyoyi na bin ƙwaro mafi girma.

tot-toss-tot-pile.name: Tulin Dankali
tot-toss-tot-pile.desc: Yana jira, sai ya jefa harbi uku tare.

tot-toss-tot-sniper.name: Gwanin Harbi
tot-toss-tot-sniper.desc: Yana nufar ƙwaro mafi girma.

aurora.name: Hasken Sama
aurora.desc: A duk daƙiƙa 25 hasken sama na ninka darajar XP sau uku kuma yana ninka nisan ɗaukar Tibo. Tibo na farawa can cikin Gonar Dankali.

blizzard.name: Guguwar Dusar Ƙanƙara
blizzard.desc: Guguwar dusar ƙanƙara na kaɗawa duk zagayen. Tibo na ƙara jin sanyi idan ya yi nesa da wutar sansani, yana rage gudu yayin da yake daskarewa, kuma wutar sansani na sake ɗumama shi. Tibo na farawa can cikin Filin Ƙanƙara na Dankali.

bloodmoon.name: Watan Jini
bloodmoon.desc: Gwaraza na zuwa sau biyu fiye da da kuma suna bugawa da ƙarfi, kowanne kuma na barin XP da tsabar kuɗi sau uku. Tibo na farawa can cikin Fadamar Dankali.

drop.name: Ruwan Ƙwari
drop.desc: Ƙwari na faɗowa daga sama kewaye da Tibo maimakon su taho a ƙafa, kuma inuwa a ƙasa na nuna inda kowanne zai sauka.

echo.name: Ranar Amsa-kuwwa
echo.desc: Kowane bugu na uku daga makaman Tibo na maimaituwa bayan ɗan lokaci ya bugi kowane ƙwaro da ke kusa da shi. Tibo na farawa can cikin Dajin Ɓawo.

eclipse.name: Kusufi
eclipse.desc: Zoben haske kawai ke saura kewaye da Tibo. Ƙwarin da ke ciki na shan ƙarin lahani, na waje kuma idanunsu kawai ake gani. Tibo na farawa can cikin Kogon Taki.

meteors.name: Ruwan Duwatsun Sama
meteors.desc: Duwatsun sama na faɗowa kan taron ƙwari mafi yawa kusa da Tibo, kuma kowane rami na rage gudun ƙwarin da ke ciki na ɗan lokaci. Tibo na farawa can cikin Kwazazzabon Dankali.

migration.name: Ƙaura
migration.desc: Kowane minti garken ƙwaro na gudu ta taswira a layi madaidaici, kuma kowane ƙwaro na barin XP mai yawa. Tibo na farawa can cikin Dajin Ɓawo.

rings.name: Zobban Toho
rings.desc: Zobban dankali masu toho sun bazu a ƙasa, kuma makaman Tibo na harbi da sauri yayin da yake tsaye a ciki. Tibo na farawa can cikin Fadamar Dankali.

sizes.name: Girma Dabam-dabam
sizes.desc: Kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na ƙwari ƙattai ne masu ƙarin rai da XP, kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu kuma ƙanana ne masu sauri. Tibo na farawa can cikin Da’irar Gona.

swarm.name: Ranar Cincirindo
swarm.desc: Kowane ƙwaro na zuwa da tagwaye, don haka ƙwari sun ninka, kowanne da rabin rai da rabin XP. Tibo na farawa can cikin Gonar Dankali.

tilt.name: Karkatar Ƙasa
tilt.desc: Ƙasa na karkata da juyawa a duk daƙiƙa 30, kuma ƙwari da abubuwan ɗauka na zamewa ƙasa. Tibo na farawa can cikin Kwazazzabon Dankali.

warp.name: Karkacewar Lokaci
warp.desc: A duk daƙiƙa 15 lokaci na karkacewa, kuma ƙwari, shugabanni da harsasan abokan gaba na tafiya da rabin sauri na daƙiƙa 3. Tibo na farawa can cikin Kogon Taki.

fog.name: Hazo Mai Kauri
fog.desc: Hazo ya cika Kogon Taki. Ƙwari da shugabannin da suka rasa Tibo a cikin hazo na rarrafe har sai sun matso, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin kogon.

hail.name: Ruwan Ƙanƙara
hail.desc: Ƙanƙara na dukan ƙwarin da ke kusa da Tibo kowane lokaci, tana cutar da kuma ture kowane ƙwaro da shugaba da dutse ya faɗa kansa, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin Dajin Ɓawo.

heat.name: Tsananin Zafi
heat.desc: Zafi na rawa duk zagayen, ƙasa mai ƙuna na yaɗuwa sau biyu fiye da da, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin Hamadar Man Soya.

night.name: Dogon Dare
night.desc: Dare ya yi duk zagayen, ƙwari da shugabanni na sauri daga duhun da ke wajen hasken Tibo, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin Gonar Dankali.

rain.name: Mamakon Ruwa
rain.desc: Ruwa na sauka duk zagayen, kududdufan laka na yaɗuwa sau biyu fiye da da kuma sun fi faɗi, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin Fadamar Dankali.

sandstorm.name: Guguwar Yashi
sandstorm.desc: Yashi na hurawa a Hamadar Man Soya yana taruwa ya zama tuddai da ke rage gudun Tibo amma ba na ƙwari da shugabanni ba, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin hamadar.

snow.name: Babban Sanyi
snow.desc: Dusar ƙanƙara na sauka duk zagayen, kowa na tafiya a hankali, facin sanyi na yaɗuwa sau biyu fiye da da, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin Filin Ƙanƙara na Dankali.

storm.name: Aradu
storm.desc: Walƙiya na bugun taron ƙwari mafi yawa kusa da Tibo bayan ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, tana cutar da kuma ture kowane ƙwaro da shugaba a cikin fashewar, kuma Tibo na farawa can cikin Fadamar Tumatir.

comet-treads.name: Takun Tauraro
comet-treads.desc: Tasirin makaman yanki da na hadari na daɗewa da 25%.

crown-of-plenty.name: Kambin Yalwa
crown-of-plenty.desc: Makaman harbi na harba ƙarin harsashi ɗaya.

ember-striders.name: Takalman Garwashi
ember-striders.desc: Harsasai na huda ƙarin maƙiyi ɗaya.

fryers-apron.name: Zanin Soya
fryers-apron.desc: Kashe gwarzo na ƙara Hauka {elite} s, kashe shugaba kuma na ƙara {boss} s, har zuwa {cap} s. A cikin Hauka, makamai na harbi sau {fire} da sauri, Tibo na gudu sau {move} da sauri, kuma lahanin da Tibo ke sha na raguwa da {hurt}%.

larder-heart.name: Zuciyar Rumbu
larder-heart.desc: Lahanin da Tibo ke sha na fitowa daga sandar XP ɗinsa da farko. Cikakkiyar sanda na biyan lahani {damage}. Sandar ba ta taɓa sauke mataki.

leftover-lederhosen.name: Wandon Fata na Ragowa
leftover-lederhosen.desc: Lalacewar da ta wuce HP na ƙarshe na ƙwaro na komawa ga shugaba mafi kusa cikin nisan {range}, in ba haka ba ga ƙwaro mafi kusa. Lalacewar da aka mayar ba ta taɓa zama kirit ba. Makamai na yin lalacewa ƙasa da {less}%.

mash-ram-helm.name: Kwalkwalin Rago na Dankali
mash-ram-helm.desc: Kowace zabura na ƙarewa da fashewar dakakken dankali. Kowane ƙwaro da ta bugi na rage {refund} s daga hutun zabura. Hutun zabura na ƙaruwa da {slower}%.

one-potato-clogs.name: Takalman Dankali Ɗaya
one-potato-clogs.desc: Tibo na riƙe makamai {weapons} kawai a mafi yawa. Kowane gurbin makami da Takalman suka rufe na ba kowane makamin da ake riƙe ƙarin lahani {damage}% da ƙarin faɗi {area}%.

starch-mail.name: Sarƙar Sitaci
starch-mail.desc: Kowane makami na samun ƙarin faɗi 12%.

chili-bottle.name: Kwalbar Barkono
chili-bottle.desc: Ɗauke ta don hura wuta ta inda Tibo ke fuskanta na 10 s. Wutar na girma da lahaninsa da faɗinsa.

dig-spot.name: Wurin X
dig-spot.desc: Tsaya a kan X don tono akwati.

lighthouse.name: Hasumiyar Haske
lighthouse.desc: Tsaya kusa da ita don kunna ta. Kaguwa za su yi tururuwa, kuma akwati zai faɗo a gindinta.

mash-bomb.name: Bam ɗin Dankali
mash-bomb.desc: Fasa shi don murƙushe kowane ƙwaro a allo. Gwaraza da shugabanni na rasa kashi ɗaya cikin biyar na iyakar HP ɗinsu.

rowboat.name: Kwale-kwale
rowboat.desc: Tsaya a ciki don yin tuƙi zuwa ɗaya gaɓar.

treasure-map.name: Taswirar Dukiya
treasure-map.desc: Karanta ta don yin alamar X. Tona a wurin X don samun akwati.

event-horizon.desc: Event Horizon: abubuwan da ke kewayawa suna goge ƙananan harsasan maƙiya, kowanne sau ɗaya a kowace {dim} s. Kowace gogewa: +{gain}% lalacewar kewaye na {sec} s, har zuwa +{cap}%

hold-the-line.desc: Riƙe Layi: sulke har {cap}, ƙwarin da ke nisan kusa suna shan bugu kyauta da lahani ninki {swing}, kuma zabura ta zama Tsayuwa; sake zabura don fita
hold-the-line.label: Sulke {armor} ga kowane ƙwaro a nisan kusa, har {twoCap}

overdrive.desc: Ƙarin ƙarfi: yi zabura ta cikin ƙwari ko harsasai don dawo da adadin zabura da tara zafi. A zafi {heat}, tururi na share harsasan kusa, makamai kuma na harbi da sauri {rate}% na {sec} s
overdrive.label: zabura ta cikin harsashi na mayar da {refund}% na hutun zabura

ricochet.desc: Komawa: kowane huda, tare da {jumps}, ya zama tsalle zuwa sabon ƙwaro mafi kusa a cikin {reach} ko komawa daga gefen gani, domin +{gain}% lahani a kowane tsalle.

ships-bell.desc: Ƙararrawar Jirgi: kowane daƙiƙa {period}, da wuri idan an yi zabura, makaman fashewa suna ƙara harbi ɗaya

spreading-bog.desc: Kwarin da suka mutu a tafkunanka suna barin fadama ({damage}% lahani, har {cap}). Tibo -{wade}% gudu a fadama

static-step.desc: Takun Lantarki: tafiya na adana tartsatsi, har zuwa {max}. Kowane harbin guguwa yana kashe ɗaya don raba kowane bugu zuwa kwaro na biyu da ninki uku na lahani. Idan babu tartsatsi, makaman guguwa suna sake caji da {slow}% a hankali

the-hunt.desc: Farauta: kiraye-kiraye da karnuka suna farautar ƙwaro mafi ƙarfi a gani da ƙarin lahani {quarry}%. Faɗuwarsa tana ƙara musu sauri {howl}% na daƙiƙa {seconds}
the-hunt.label: Kiraye-kiraye da karnuka suna ƙara lahani {elite}% ga zaɓaɓɓu da shugabanni

butter-streak.name: Butter Streak
butter-streak.desc: Every rush dey leave strip of melted butter wey dey slow pests and burn dem for 2 s. Between one rush and anoda, e still dey leave one for di road wey Tibo just waka pass.

chip-shuriken.name: Chip Shuriken
chip-shuriken.desc: Chips wey dey spin as dem spread comot.

deep-fryer.name: Deep Fryer
deep-fryer.desc: E dey spray hot oil like cone.

frozen-fries.name: Frozen Fries
frozen-fries.desc: E dey shoot frozen fries wey dey freeze enemies for one place.

fry-knives.name: Fry Knives
fry-knives.desc: E dey fire sharp fries go where Tibo face.

fry-lance.name: Fry Lance
fry-lance.desc: One very long fry wey dey chook di whole line.

fry-sentry.name: Fry Cook Sentry
fry-sentry.desc: E dey drop fry-cook turret wey dey shoot enemies wey near.

frying-pan.name: Frying Pan
frying-pan.desc: E dey swing pan for Tibo front. Enemy bullets wey e knock go fly back to whoever shoot dem. Every elite wey Tibo kill dey charge di next swing make e big and strong pass.

grab-bag.name: Lucky Bag
grab-bag.desc: E dey put hand inside bag and fire different weapon attack every time.

gravy-boat.name: Stew Pot
gravy-boat.desc: E dey pour hot stew pools on top enemies.

hash-boomerang.name: Hash Boomerang
hash-boomerang.desc: Crispy hash brown wey dey fly go and come back.

hash-brown-shield.name: Hash Brown Shield
hash-brown-shield.desc: Hash browns dey circle Tibo. Each one fit take up to 20 damage from one hit or bullet, then e go burst to pieces wey dey wound enemies wey near. Thorns dey add to di pieces damage. Di ones wey break go crisp back one by one.

hot-potato.name: Hot Potato
hot-potato.desc: E dey jump from pest to pest and burst on top di last one when im count finish.

julienne-dash.name: Slice Rush
julienne-dash.desc: Every rush dey slice every pest wey dey for Tibo road. Between one rush and anoda, e still dey slice for di road wey e just waka pass.

mash-mallet.name: Mash Mallet
mash-mallet.desc: Masher dey pound di nearest pest for Tibo feet.

mash-mortar.name: Mash Mortar
mash-mortar.desc: E dey drop mortar wey dey fire lumps of mash at pests wey dey far. Each lump dey burst and e dey hit every pest wey dey around am.

mash-wave.name: Mash Wave
mash-wave.desc: Ring of mashed potato dey roll comot from Tibo.

mezzaluna.name: Mezzaluna
mezzaluna.desc: E dey chop for Tibo front and im back. Di more HP wey Tibo don lose, di harder e dey hit.

peel-lash.name: Peel Lash
peel-lash.desc: Long potato peel dey crack di nearest pest, then e jump to di one beside am.

peeler.name: Peeler
peeler.desc: E dey slash sideways. From level 4 e dey throw potato peel through di crowd, one more every level. Tibo trusted kitchen tool.

potato-battery.name: Potato Battery
potato-battery.desc: E dey clip live wire on top one pest. Di wire dey shock and slow every pest wey e touch. When di pest wey e clip die, di wire go jump enter di next one.

potato-rain.name: Potato Rain
potato-rain.desc: E dey call rain of potatoes round Tibo.

reset-button.name: Reset Button
reset-button.desc: We don reset di limits. E dey clear every enemy for screen. Ogas only flinch.

root-cellar.name: Root Store
root-cellar.desc: Ring of cellar cold round Tibo. Pests wey cross am go catch frostbite and freeze small. Ogas only slow down.

root-spikes.name: Root Spikes
root-spikes.desc: Roots dey burst comot from ground under enemies.

rosti-disc.name: Rösti Disc
rosti-disc.desc: Flat rösti wey dey bounce from di edges of di screen.

salt-line.name: Salt Line
salt-line.desc: Tibo dey drop salt as e dey waka. Pests wey step on di salt go slow and feel pepper.

seeker-sprouts.name: Seeker Sprouts
seeker-sprouts.desc: Sprouts wey dey turn follow enemies.

skillet-flail.name: Skillet Flail
skillet-flail.desc: Iron skillet dey swing through di pests for Tibo front and di pests for him back.

small-fry.name: Small Chop
small-fry.desc: Small fry wey start weak and dey gain damage for every kill wey e make, till di game end.

sprout-satellites.name: Sprout Satellites
sprout-satellites.desc: Potato sprouts dey circle Tibo for some time.

spud-cannon.name: Potato Cannon
spud-cannon.desc: Classic potato gun. Shots dey burst when dem hit.

spud-dice.name: Potato Dice
spud-dice.desc: E dey throw one potato die. 1 na dud, 2 dey freeze, 3 dey burn, 4 dey split, 5 dey pay gold, 6 dey burst big.

spud-dynamo.name: Potato Dynamo
spud-dynamo.desc: Two starch sparks dey orbit Tibo and zap wetin dem touch.

spud-lob.name: Potato Throw
spud-lob.desc: E dey throw heavy potatoes high. Dem dey crash down through crowd.

starch-bolt.name: Starch Bolt
starch-bolt.desc: Shock from heap of starch dey strike any enemy.

starch-chain.name: Starch Chain
starch-chain.desc: Spark wey dey jump from enemy to enemy.

starch-puddle.name: Starch Puddle
starch-puddle.desc: E drop one charged starch puddle on top di nearest crowd. Pests wey stand inside go shock and slow until e dry.

steam-vent.name: Steam Vent
steam-vent.desc: Hot steam from roast potato dey wound everything wey near.

tater-mines.name: Potato Mines
tater-mines.desc: E dey bury potatoes wey go burst when enemies come near.

tater-pup.name: Potato Puppy
tater-pup.desc: Loyal potato puppy wey dey follow Tibo and shoot.

tot-toss.name: Tot Toss
tot-toss.desc: E dey throw potato tots for di nearest enemy.

whisk-vortex.name: Whisk Vortex
whisk-vortex.desc: E dey spin whisk whirlpool under di biggest crowd and drag pests enter am.

big-fry.name: Big Fry
big-fry.desc: Di fry dey chook through everything, and e dey grow big as e dey get strong.

bottomless-sack.name: Bag Wey No Get Bottom
bottomless-sack.desc: E dey pull two snacks at once, and when dem comot, dem don evolve.

cast-iron.name: Iron Pot
cast-iron.desc: E dey swing both sides. Bullets wey e knock dey hit harder, chook, and follow pests. Every elite kill dey charge di next swing.

cold-storage.name: Cold Room
cold-storage.desc: Wider, colder ring. Pests go freeze long and catch strong frostbite.

crater-pound.name: Mash Crater
crater-pound.desc: Masher dey pound two pests for Tibo feet, and each pound land wider.

dynamo-coil.name: Dynamo Coil
dynamo-coil.desc: The sparks stay out, and a third spark join dem.

factory-reset.name: Factory Reset
factory-reset.desc: Full reset. E dey clear di screen, keep di drops, heal Tibo.

fry-fortress.name: Fry Fortress
fry-fortress.desc: E dey drop three armored fry turrets at once. Dem dey last longer, and their crinkle fries dey chook through.

ghee-glide.name: Ghee Glide
ghee-glide.desc: Every rush dey leave strip of hot ghee wey dey slow and burn pests. Between one rush and anoda, e still dey leave one for di road wey Tibo just waka pass. Tibo dey waka 15% faster on top di ghee.

golden-harvest.name: Golden Harvest
golden-harvest.desc: Rain of golden potatoes. Kills fit drop gold.

gratin-arc.name: Gratin Arc
gratin-arc.desc: Cheesy arc wey dey jump far and land big hits often.

gratin-puddle.name: Gratin puddle
gratin-puddle.desc: Wider gratin puddle wey last longer and shock harder.

gravy-flood.name: Stew Flood
gravy-flood.desc: Stew pools dey grow and follow Tibo.

hash-bulwark.name: Hash Wall
hash-bulwark.desc: More hash browns wey dey crisp back faster and fit take up to 30 damage from one hit. Di pieces dey hit harder and freeze enemies.

hashnado.name: Hashnado
hashnado.desc: Hash browns dey spin comot like crispy storm and come back.

inferno-basket.name: Fire Basket
inferno-basket.desc: Long blast of fryer oil. Double damage to elites and ogas.

iron-flail.name: Iron Flail
iron-flail.desc: Heavier skillet dey swing wider through di pests for Tibo front and di pests for him back.

landmine-harvest.name: Landmine Harvest
landmine-harvest.desc: Rotten mines. Enemies wey dem kill dey drop extra gold.

loaded-dice.name: Wayo Dice
loaded-dice.desc: E dey roll two dice and keep di higher one. Pair go double di throw.

mandoline-fury.name: Mandoline Fury
mandoline-fury.desc: E dey slice both sides at once and throw potato slices through di crowd. Every slash wey hit dey heal Tibo small.

mashquake.name: Mashquake
mashquake.desc: Mash dey roll comot for waves wey dey slow wetin dem hit. Every wave dey throw mash lumps across di field.

moon-cleaver.name: Moon Cutlass
moon-cleaver.desc: E dey chop two times for front and one time for back, and e dey throw hash pieces back through di crowd. Di more HP wey Tibo don lose, di harder e dey hit.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.desc: Seeker sprouts wey dey split when dem hit.

permafrost-fries.name: Forever Frozen Fries
permafrost-fries.desc: E dey freeze long pass. Enemies wey freeze dey take double damage.

pestle-barrage.name: Pestle Barrage
pestle-barrage.desc: E dey drop three iron mortar at once. Dia lumps dey burst wider, and each burst dey throw three small bursts around am.

pressure-cooker.name: Pressure Pot
pressure-cooker.desc: Big steam cloud. Every enemy wey e burn dey heal Tibo.

railfry.name: Railfry
railfry.desc: Three lances wey dey cross di whole screen.

rind-whip.name: Rind Whip
rind-whip.desc: Long potato peel dey crack di nearest pest, then e jump across di pests beside am.

rosti-storm.name: Rösti Storm
rosti-storm.desc: Röstis wey dey bounce and burst every time dem bounce.

sack-of-russets.name: Bag of Potatoes
sack-of-russets.desc: Full bag of heavy potatoes, all at once.

salt-flats.name: Salt Field
salt-flats.desc: Wider salt line wey dey slow pests well well and push dem comot from Tibo road.

spicy-hot-potato.name: Pepper Hot Potato
spicy-hot-potato.desc: E dey jump far pass, and im blast dey throw two fresh hot potatoes.

spud-grid.name: Potato Grid
spud-grid.desc: E dey clip three live wires at once. Every wire dey shock harder and burst when e leave.

spudzooka.name: Spudzooka
spudzooka.desc: Big potato rockets wey dey split into many bursts.

stand-mixer.name: Stand Mixer
stand-mixer.desc: Two whirlpools dey pull harder. When one finish, e dey slam wetin e catch together.

taproot-eruption.name: Big Root Burst
taproot-eruption.desc: Big roots dey burst comot and throw enemies back.

tot-gatling.name: Tot Gatling
tot-gatling.desc: Potato tots wey no dey stop.

waffle-cut.name: Waffle Cut
waffle-cut.desc: Every rush dey cut cross through every pest for Tibo road, then cut am two times again, 0.5 s apart. Between one rush and anoda, e still dey cut for di road wey e just waka pass.

baked-alaska.name: Baked Alaska
baked-alaska.desc: Hot potato wey dey freeze every enemy wey e jump reach. Enemies wey freeze dey take double damage. Im last jump go scatter all di frozen enemies wey dey near and throw two fresh hot potatoes. E dey free one weapon slot.

cold-frame.name: Cold Sprout Box
cold-frame.desc: Sprouts dey circle Tibo forever inside one wide cold ring. Pests wey cross di ring or jam sprout go freeze small. Ogas only slow down. E dey free one weapon slot.

fry-brigade.name: Fries Brigade
fry-brigade.desc: Potato puppies wey wear fry-cook cap dey follow Tibo, dey shoot, and dey plant fry turrets as dem dey go. E dey free one weapon slot.

gravy-whirlpool.name: Stew Whirlpool
gravy-whirlpool.desc: Hot hot stew whirlpools dey drag crowd enter and burn dem. Dem dey grow, follow Tibo and slam wetin dem catch together. E dey free one weapon slot.

griddle-guard.name: Pan Guard
griddle-guard.desc: Hash browns dey circle Tibo and dey block hits and bullets. Anywhere one block bullet, di pan go swing there knock am back to whoever shoot am. Hash browns wey break dey burst to pieces wey dey freeze, and di pan dey swing both sides. E dey free one weapon slot.

hungry-sprouts.name: Hungry Sprouts
hungry-sprouts.desc: Sprouts wey dey follow enemies, dey split when dem hit, and dey gain damage for every kill wey dem make, till di game end. E dey free one weapon slot.

knife-block.name: Knife Block
knife-block.desc: E dey slice for Tibo front and back at once and throw potato slices both sides. Every slash wey hit dey heal Tibo small, and di more HP wey Tibo don lose, di harder e dey hit. E dey free one weapon slot.

root-current.name: Root Current
root-current.desc: E dey clip three live wires. Every second, roots dey burst under every pest wey e clip, throw pests back and carry di shock reach every pest wey dem hit. E dey free one weapon slot.

salted-butter.name: Salted Butter
salted-butter.desc: Every step and every rush dey leave salted butter wey dey pepper and slow pests, push dem comot from Tibo road and put fire for dem. Tibo dey waka 15% faster on top am. E dey free one weapon slot.

sowing-season.name: Sowing Season
sowing-season.desc: Golden potatoes dey rain down, and any one wey miss go stay for ground as mine. Kills fit drop gold. E dey free one weapon slot.

spud-artillery.name: Potato Artillery
spud-artillery.desc: Plenti potatoes wey dem throw high wey dey burst. E dey free one weapon slot.

starch-supercell.name: Starch Storm
starch-supercell.desc: Lightning wey dey chain between enemies. E dey free one weapon slot.

gem-sling.name: Gem Catapult
gem-sling.desc: Every XP gem wey Tibo pick dey fling one potato wedge go di side wey e dey face. More amount dey fling more wedges wey spread like fan.

hot-streak.name: Hot Waka
hot-streak.desc: Fry-oil slash dey sweep di pests wey dey around Tibo. Every second wey Tibo keep dey move and nothing hit am, one flame go light for im leg, reach five, and every flame dey make di slash reach far pass and come fast pass. One hit dey off two flames, and if e stop, all of dem go off.

locked-gatling.name: Locked Gatling
locked-gatling.desc: Every 2 second burst dey lock on di nearest pest direction, and e go keep dey fire tots for dat side while Tibo dey waka. More amount dey fire more lanes side by side.

mash-snowball.name: Mash Snowball
mash-snowball.desc: One ball of mashed potato dey roll behind Tibo and e dey grow with every step wey e run. When e stop or turn sharp, di ball go shoot go front for di last direction wey e face and splash pests based on how big e be. Full ball go release on im own.

seed-potato.name: Seed Potato
seed-potato.desc: Tibo dey throw one seed potato enter di nearest crowd. E dey grow for three stages and e dey zap pests wey dey around am every second. Waka pass on top am to harvest one burst wey dey grow with di stage, and catch di potato to throw am again. If you leave am, e go burst small after 8 s.

spud-fence.name: Potato Fence
spud-fence.desc: Every 60 units wey Tibo waka, e go plant one starch post. Live current dey run from each post go di one before am, and e dey zap pests wey cross am. Na only four posts fit stand, and Tibo wey stand still no dey plant any.

tailgate-fries.name: Bumper Fries
tailgate-fries.desc: As Tibo dey run, fries dey spray comot for im back enter anything wey dey pursue am. If e stand still, e go drop one fry behind am.

tater-twirl.name: Potato Twirl
tater-twirl.desc: Hash brown wheels dey circle Tibo, dem dey spin and hit as fast as e dey run. If e stand still, dem go slow down like snail.

tot-stampede.name: Tot Stampede
tot-stampede.desc: Every 40 units wey Tibo waka, one potato tot go jump comot for im back and charge di nearest pest, and e go burst once e touch am. Tibo wey stand still no dey make tots.

gem-catapult.name: Gem Cannon
gem-catapult.desc: Every XP gem wey Tibo pick dey fling one potato wedge go di side wey e dey face, and each wedge dey hit harder well well. More amount dey fling more wedges wey spread like fan.

mash-avalanche.name: Mash Avalanche
mash-avalanche.desc: Di mash ball dey hit harder, and for im first hit e go break into three smaller balls wey spread like fan for im direction and splash pests based on how big dem be.

potato-patch.name: Potato Farm
potato-patch.desc: Tibo dey throw three seed potatoes wey get fertilizer at once, and reach six fit grow at di same time. Di zaps and harvest bursts dey hit harder well well. Waka pass on top one plant to harvest am and throw again.

spark-corral.name: Current Fence
spark-corral.desc: Every 60 units wey Tibo waka, e go plant one charged starch post. Braided current wey wide double dey run between di posts and e dey zap pests harder well well. More posts fit stand, and each one dey last 9 s.

tailgate-party.name: Bumper Owambe
tailgate-party.desc: Buttered fries dey spray comot for Tibo back as e dey run, and dem dey hit harder well well. If e stand still, e go drop one behind am.

tater-minigun.name: Potato Minigun
tater-minigun.desc: Di same locked 2 second bursts, one lane for each amount, and every tot dey hit harder well well.

tater-twister.name: Potato Twister
tater-twister.desc: More hash brown wheels dey circle Tibo for wider orbit and dem dey hit harder, dey spin as fast as e dey run. If e stand still, dem go slow down like snail.

tot-cavalry.name: Tot Cavalry
tot-cavalry.desc: Every 40 units wey Tibo waka, one squad of buttered potato tots go charge comot for im back, and each one go jam pass two pests. Tibo wey stand still no dey make tots.

wildfire-roast.name: Bush Fire Waka
wildfire-roast.desc: Hot Waka slash dey burn white-hot. Every flame wey Tibo keep alive dey make di sweep reach far well well, reach five. One hit dey off two flames, and if e stop, all of dem go off.

grease-fire.name: Oil Fire
grease-fire.desc: Bush Fire Waka sweep dey spray big cloud of fryer oil wey dey burn, and di flames for Tibo leg dey light di oil turn am to burning pool as e dey run. Every flame wey Tibo keep alive dey make di sweep reach far well well, reach five. One hit dey off two flames, and if e stop, all of dem go off. E dey free one weapon slot.

hash-carousel.name: Hash Carousel
hash-carousel.desc: Golden hash brown wheels dey circle Tibo and dey throw hash browns wey go comot and come back. Dem dey spin and throw as fast as e dey run, and if e stand still, dem go slow down like snail. E dey free one weapon slot.

loot-sling.name: Loot Catapult
loot-sling.desc: E dey pull two snacks wey don evolve from di bag at once, and every XP gem wey Tibo pick dey fling one more go di side wey e dey face. E dey free one weapon slot.

starch-garden.name: Starch Garden
starch-garden.desc: Tibo dey throw seed potatoes wey get fertilizer for crowd, and every 60 units wey e waka, e go plant one starch post wey get seed potato for im leg. Every plant dey grow for three stages and e dey zap pests wey dey near am, and di current between di posts dey strong pass as di plants dey grow. Waka pass on top one plant to harvest one burst. E dey free one weapon slot.

tot-barrage.name: Tot Barrage
tot-barrage.desc: Potato tots wey no dey stop. Each tot wey hit go throw out anoda tot wey go charge di next pest, and when Tibo dey waka, squads of tots go charge comot for im back. E dey free one weapon slot.

afterburner-fries.name: Jet Fries
afterburner-fries.desc: Every rush dey blast fan of hot fries go back from where di rush start.

broadside.name: Side Cannon
broadside.desc: E dey fire one line of powder shells from both sides of Tibo, straight across di way e dey run. Every shell dey burst for di first pest e meet or where e land.

comet-scythe.name: Comet Scythe
comet-scythe.desc: Scythe blade dey circle Tibo. Every two rounds, im orbit dey swing go wide and pull back come close, so e dey cut di pests for Tibo leg and di ring wey dey outside dem.

harvest-moon.name: Harvest Moon
harvest-moon.desc: Moon potato dey circle Tibo. Every pest wey e touch go ride im orbit small, then e go fling am comot and hit am. Pest wey e don fling no fit enter again for some seconds, and ogas too heavy to catch.

hash-hawk.name: Hash Hawk
hash-hawk.desc: Hash brown hawk dey circle on top Tibo. Every few seconds e dey dive on di strongest pest wey e fit reach, oga first, then elite, and e dey strike everything wey dey near am.

mash-golem.name: Mash Golem
mash-golem.desc: Mash golem dey rise for Tibo front and e dey match go di way Tibo face, e dey push pests comot from im road to open way. For di end of im waka, e go slam ground and scatter.

mash-landing.name: Mash Landing
mash-landing.desc: Every rush dey end with mash shockwave wey dey hit every pest around Tibo and push am back.

peel-phantom.name: Peel Ghost
peel-phantom.desc: Every rush dey leave peel shell of Tibo where di rush start. Pests wey dey near go chase di shell till e burst.

skipping-cannonball.name: Bouncing Cannonball
skipping-cannonball.desc: Cannonball dey bounce go di way Tibo face and e dey burst for every bounce, each burst big pass di last one. Amount dey add one bounce.

sprout-squad.name: Sprout Squad
sprout-squad.desc: Pest wey fall fit grow small seedling where e fall. Every seedling dey jump go di nearest pest and bite am till e wither. More amount mean more seedlings fit grow at once.

spud-decoy.name: Wayo Potato
spud-decoy.desc: Every few seconds Tibo dey plant wind-up potato behind am. Pests wey dey near go waka go meet am instead of Tibo, then e go burst.

clockwork-spud.name: Clockwork Potato
clockwork-spud.desc: Tibo dey plant wind-up potato behind am, and pests wey dey near go waka go meet dem. Every burst go leave smaller potato wey go wind up and burst one more time.

eclipse-scythe.name: Eclipse Scythe
eclipse-scythe.desc: Sun and moon blades dey circle Tibo. While di sun blades dey swing go wide, di moon blades dey cut close for im leg, then dem go swap place, so pests wey near and wey far dey always for reach.

full-broadside.name: Full Side Cannon
full-broadside.desc: E dey fire two lines of powder shells from both sides of Tibo. Every shell dey burst for di first pest e meet or where e land, and e dey throw three small shells wey dey burst where dem land.

hash-harrier.name: Hash Harrier
hash-harrier.desc: Hash brown harrier wey get wing like hot charcoal dey circle on top Tibo and dey dive on di strongest pest wey dem fit reach, oga first, then elite. Every dive dey leave burning hash crumbs wey dey burn any pest wey stand on top am.

hunters-moon.name: Hunter's Moon
hunters-moon.desc: Bigger moon potato dey circle Tibo and dey catch pest from far pass before. Every pest wey e fling go burst into moon dust for where e land and hit di pests wey dey around am. Ogas too heavy to catch.

jet-fryer.name: Jet Fryer
jet-fryer.desc: Every rush dey blast two fan of hot fries go back from where di rush start. Every fry dey splash hot oil for where e land.

mash-colossus.name: Mash Colossus
mash-colossus.desc: Bigger mash golem dey march go di way Tibo face. Every step dey leave patch of mash wey dey slow pests, and im last slam dey send ring of mash wey dey roll comot.

mash-meteor.name: Mash Meteor
mash-meteor.desc: Every rush dey end with bigger mash shockwave, and second ring wey wide pass go follow am small time after.

peel-poltergeist.name: Peel Wahala Ghost
peel-poltergeist.desc: Every rush dey leave haunted peel shell where di rush start. Pests go chase am enter im spinning peels, then e go burst into ring of peels.

root-legion.name: Root Legion
root-legion.desc: More seedlings dey grow and dem dey live long pass, and new one dey grow near Tibo every half second. Every seedling wey wither dey leave root trap wey go hold pests for one place small time.

russet-ricochet.name: Potato Ricochet
russet-ricochet.desc: Potato cannonballs dey bounce spread like fan go di way Tibo face and dem dey burst for every bounce, each burst big pass di last one. Every burst dey throw small potato go one pest wey dey near, and e go burst too. Amount dey add one bounce.

fry-by.name: Fry-By
fry-by.desc: Fries dey spray comot for Tibo back as e dey run. Every rush dey blast one wide double fan of fries go back along di road wey e pass, and every fry for di fan dey splash hot oil for where e land. E dey free one weapon slot.

gravy-pack.name: Stew Squad
gravy-pack.desc: Four potato puppy wey stew rub body dey run with Tibo. Every bite dey heal Tibo 0.05 HP.

bacon-bits.name: Suya Bits
bacon-bits.desc: +12% damage to elites and ogas every level.

butter-socks.name: Butter Socks
butter-socks.desc: +1 rush charge for level 1, 3 and 5. Every level dey cut di rush wait time by 6%.

four-eyed-spud.name: Four-Eye Potato
four-eyed-spud.desc: +10% luck every level. Shot weapons dey fire +1 shot for level 2 and 4.

gpu.name: GPU
gpu.desc: +1 shot. Firing dey build heat. When heat full, weapons go fire for half speed for 3s. Every level dey add fire rate and cooling.

hot-sauce.name: Pepper Sauce
hot-sauce.desc: E dey raise your big hit chance every level. Di higher your big hit chance, di less every level dey add.

rotten-spud.name: Rotten Potato
rotten-spud.desc: +10% curse every level: enemies go strong, fast and plenti, but more XP and gold.

starch-plating.name: Starch Armor
starch-plating.desc: E dey cut di damage of every hit, more every level. Strong enemies dey pass through more.

thick-skin.name: Thick Skin
thick-skin.desc: E dey raise your chance to dodge hit every level. Di higher your dodge chance, di less every level dey add.

hot-start.name: Hot Start
hot-start.desc: After every rush, every weapon dey reload 60% faster for 1.3 s. Every level dey add 0.3 s. Tibo dey shine while e last.

couch-potato.name: Couch Potato
couch-potato.desc: While Tibo stand still, damage dey rise 4% every second per level, reach 20% per level. If e move, e go reset.

gravy-splash.name: Stew Splash
gravy-splash.desc: Every 0.5 s, di HP wey Tibo heal dey splash comot as damage on enemies wey dey near: 100% of am per level.

hash-rush.name: Hash Rush
hash-rush.desc: Every rush for di last 4 s dey add 4% damage every level, e dey count reach 3 rushes.

hearty-helping.name: Big Portion
hearty-helping.desc: +2% damage for every 50 max HP wey Tibo gain pass im start max HP. Every level dey add anoda 2% for every 50.

lean-lunch.name: Light Lunch
lean-lunch.desc: +4% damage and -2% wait time per level for every empty weapon slot.

mash-finisher.name: Mash Finisher
mash-finisher.desc: Hit dey mash any pest wey remain below 2% of im max HP per level, reach 15%. Elites dey mash for half of dat. Ogas no dey mash at all.

packed-pan.name: Full Pan
packed-pan.desc: +1% damage for every pest wey dey inside Tibo pick range, reach 10 pests. Every level dey add anoda 1% for every pest.

peel-out.name: Peel Comot
peel-out.desc: After Tibo dodge hit, im weapons dey do double damage for 2 s. Peels dey spin around am while e last.

spry-sprout.name: Sharp Sprout
spry-sprout.desc: Every level dey cut di rush wait time by 5%.

tater-trot.name: Potato Waka
tater-trot.desc: Every 1% of bonus waka speed dey add 1% fire rate, reach 8% per level.

aged-russet.name: Old Potato
aged-russet.desc: +0.5% damage every level for every level wey Tibo don gain dis game, reach +10% every level.

clean-plate.name: Clean Plate
clean-plate.desc: After 5 s wey nothing hit Tibo, +12% big hit chance every level. One hit go remove one level.

baked-buckler.name: Roast Shield
baked-buckler.desc: E dey cut di damage of every hit. Strong enemies dey pass through more.

boom-spud.name: Boom Potato
boom-spud.desc: Enemies wey you kill fit burst.

coal-baked-spud.name: Charcoal Potato
coal-baked-spud.desc: 15% of hits dey put fire for enemies.

coupon-book.name: Coupon Book
coupon-book.desc: Everything wey you buy go cheap.

freezer-burn.name: Freezer Burn
freezer-burn.desc: Enemies wey freeze dey scatter when dem die, and dem dey freeze enemies wey near.

ghost-pepper.name: Ghost Pepper
ghost-pepper.desc: Nothing fit touch Tibo for 0.15 s after every rush finish.

ghost-skin.name: Ghost Skin
ghost-skin.desc: E dey raise your chance to dodge hit. Di higher your dodge chance, di less e dey add.

heavy-russet.name: Heavy Potato
heavy-russet.desc: 2% of hits dey BONK for 15× damage.

hot-pepper.name: Hot Pepper
hot-pepper.desc: E dey raise your big hit chance. Di higher your big hit chance, di less e dey add.

philosophers-potato.name: Professor Potato
philosophers-potato.desc: +10% to damage, area, speed and time.

porcupine-spud.name: Porcupine Potato
porcupine-spud.desc: When Tibo take hit, e dey fire 10 fries go every side.

second-spud.name: Spare Potato
second-spud.desc: Revive one time with half HP.

spicy-croquette.name: Pepper Croquette
spicy-croquette.desc: 12% of hits dey burst with fire blast.

static-tot.name: Shock Potato
static-tot.desc: 10% of hits dey send lightning go 3 more enemies.

thorny-jacket.name: Thorny Jacket
thorny-jacket.desc: Enemies wey hit Tibo go take 8 damage.

wandering-eyes.name: Waka Eyes
wandering-eyes.desc: 20% of kills dey send 2 potato eyes go chase oda enemies.

all-seeing-spud.name: See-Everything Potato
all-seeing-spud.desc: 35% of kills dey send 4 potato eyes wey dey chook pass enemies.

bonfire-spud.name: Bonfire Potato
bonfire-spud.desc: 25% of hits dey put fire for enemies, and di fire dey spread go di enemies wey dey around dem.

fry-volcano.name: Fry Volcano
fry-volcano.desc: When Tibo take hit, e dey erupt with blast and fire 24 fries wey dey chook pass enemies.

glacier-spud.name: Glacier Potato
glacier-spud.desc: For 30% of kills, di enemy wey die dey scatter, e dey freeze enemies wey near, and e dey slow di enemies wey dey around dem.

kaboom-spud.name: Kaboom Potato
kaboom-spud.desc: For 25% of kills, di enemy wey die dey burst, e dey hit enemies wey near for half of im max HP as damage.

magma-croquette.name: Magma Croquette
magma-croquette.desc: 20% of hits dey burst with big blast wey dey put fire for enemies.

meteor-russet.name: Meteor Potato
meteor-russet.desc: 3% of hits dey call meteor come down for 20× damage, and e dey hit enemies wey dey around am too.

storm-tot.name: Storm Potato
storm-tot.desc: 15% of hits dey send lightning go 6 more enemies, and thunder dey crack for each one.

static-socks.name: Shock Socks
static-socks.desc: Every rush dey end with starch bolt on di 3 enemies wey near pass, 176 damage each.

frozen-pea.name: Frozen Pea
frozen-pea.desc: 8% of hits dey freeze di enemy for 1 s. Ogas go slow instead.

fry-fuel.name: Fry Fuel
fry-fuel.desc: Every 30 kills dey refill one rush charge.

lightning-spud.name: Lightning Potato
lightning-spud.desc: 6% of hits dey call lightning come down on di enemies wey dey around dem.

mash-splat.name: Mash Splash
mash-splat.desc: Every rush dey land with mash splash wey dey hit di enemies wey dey around Tibo.

midnight-fries.name: Midnight Fries
midnight-fries.desc: +5% damage. After 20:00, damage dey grow 6% more every minute.

moon-dust.name: Moon Dust
moon-dust.desc: 15% of kills dey burst into moon dust wey dey slow enemies wey near.

receipt-spud.name: Receipt Potato
receipt-spud.desc: Every box or crate wey you open dey give +2% damage till di game end.

souffle-spud.name: Puff-Puff Potato
souffle-spud.desc: When something hit Tibo, e go swell up and push enemies wey near comot.

spud-spring.name: Potato Spring
spud-spring.desc: E dey cut di rush wait time by 15%. E fit stack reach 3 times.

tailwind-tater.name: Tailwind Potato
tailwind-tater.desc: +1% damage for every 2% waka speed wey pass di base.

tater-treat.name: Potato Treat
tater-treat.desc: Dogs dey use dia special power 25% more often.

mash-crater.name: Mash Crater
mash-crater.desc: Every rush dey land inside wide mash hole wey dey throw 8 hash browns comot.

copper-tot.name: Copper Potato
copper-tot.desc: When you pick gold, e get 25% chance to hit any pest for screen with heavy damage.

panic-fry.name: Panic Fries
panic-fry.desc: The first time for each minute wey Tibo drop below 50% HP, pests go slow by 5% for 3 s and him hits go do 25% more damage.

second-helping.name: Second Plate
second-helping.desc: Every snack wey Tibo chop when im HP full dey give +1% damage till di game end, reach +10% every level.

spark-spud.name: Spark Potato
spark-spud.desc: Waka dey charge spark. Every 300 units wey Tibo waka, e go burst, hit di pests wey dey around am and daze dem.

spud-purse.name: Potato Purse
spud-purse.desc: Every 100 units wey Tibo waka, e go drop one coin, 16 units sooner for every extra copy.

warm-bowl.name: Warm Bowl
warm-bowl.desc: If you charge any activation ring, e go leave healing pool for there for 10 s.

amusing.title: Di Festival Mascot
amusing.desc: Di potato festival soft pink mascot. E go wave hello, throw hearts and stuffing, then jump come hug you till starch comot for your body.
amusing.name: amusing

beetle-queen.name: Colorado Queen
beetle-queen.title: Mama of Beetles
beetle-queen.desc: Di potato beetle queen wey get stripes. Im pikin dem dey hatch for ring round Tibo.

compost-titan.name: Compost Titan
compost-titan.title: Di Rotten Heap
compost-titan.desc: Heap of rotten leaves and mulch. Maggots dey pour comot from am.

deep-freezer.name: Di Deep Freezer
deep-freezer.title: Keeper of Frozen Fries
deep-freezer.desc: Chest freezer wey dey waka. E ice cube dey freeze you small time.

fryer-king.name: Di Fryer King
fryer-king.title: Oga of Hot Oil
fryer-king.desc: Deep fryer wey wear crown. E dey spit rings of hot oil wey dey boil.

grater-golem.name: Grater Golem
grater-golem.title: Di Shredder
grater-golem.desc: Grater wey get legs. E dey charge along di line wey dem mark.

great-wireworm.name: Di Big Wireworm
great-wireworm.title: Potato Borer
great-wireworm.desc: Big wireworm. E dey dig ground come burst up under Tibo.

harvester.name: Di Harvester
harvester.title: Season Don End
harvester.desc: Combine harvester. E dey charge down long lanes. Every potato last fear.

ketchup-kraken.name: Ketchup Kraken
ketchup-kraken.title: Terror of di Swamp
ketchup-kraken.desc: Kraken wey dem make with ketchup. Im tentacles dey slam down for pattern.

late-blight.name: Late Blight
late-blight.title: Di Hunger Fog
late-blight.desc: Blight cloud wey dey creep. Spore clouds dey bloom where e point.

sir-strawman.name: Sir Strawman
sir-strawman.title: Guard of di Rows
sir-strawman.desc: Scarecrow wey be knight. E dey throw sharp straw spread like fan.

the-mandoline.name: Di Mandoline
the-mandoline.title: Fries Slicer
the-mandoline.desc: Mandoline slicer wey get life. Im blade dey sweep across for lanes.

the-masher.name: Di Masher
the-masher.title: Kitchen Police
the-masher.desc: Big potato masher. E dey slam where Tibo stand.

pack-lord.name: Pack Oga
pack-lord.title: Oga of di Hunt
pack-lord.desc: One giant alpha wey dey run di packs. E dey jump attack back to back and call im hunters, and every pack go scatter when e fall.

root-hydra.name: Di Root Hydra
root-hydra.title: Three Heads
root-hydra.desc: Hydra wey root cover, e dey burst comot from ground. Im three heads dey bite down for lanes.

root-hydra-frenzy.name: Di Root Hydra
root-hydra-frenzy.title: Five Heads
root-hydra-frenzy.desc: Five wounded heads with red eyes. E dey rush you.

root-hydra-head.name: Root Hydra Head
root-hydra-head.title: Under Ground
root-hydra-head.desc: One of di Hydra heads dey burst comot from ground, spit mud, then sink again. Every hit wey e take now go weaken di Hydra wey dey come for 29:00.

root-hydra-mire.name: Di Root Hydra
root-hydra-mire.title: Mud Pools
root-hydra-mire.desc: Two heads go enter ground and spit mud pools everywhere for di field.

root-hydra-stump.name: Di Root Hydra
root-hydra-stump.title: Stump
root-hydra-stump.desc: Im middle head don fall. Mud Golems dey crawl comot from ground.

queen.name: Di Queen
queen.title: Di Island Palace
queen.desc: Her three servants dey guard her from every blow, and dem go stand up again if you leave dem for ground.

shell-titan.name: Di Shell Titan
shell-titan.title: Three Plates
shell-titan.desc: Im three plates dey open one by one after every charge. Break am when one dey open.

chip-canyons.name: Chip Canyon
chip-canyons.desc: Cliffs of potato chips wey dem stack. Crabs dey waka inside di cracks.

coin-laundromat.name: Coin Laundromat
coin-laundromat.desc: Washing machines line up dey hum for empty field. Nobody sabi who dey pay di light bill.

compost-caves.name: Compost Caves
compost-caves.desc: Wet tunnels under di compost heap. Spore holes dey sting.

crop-circle.name: Crop Circle
crop-circle.desc: Wheat wey dem press flat for perfect rings. Something land here come leave im crew behind.

frozen-tundra.name: Frozen Fries Land
frozen-tundra.desc: Cold field of fries. Ice patches dey make Tibo cold.

fry-oil-desert.name: Fry Oil Desert
fry-oil-desert.desc: Hot sand and pools of frying oil wey dey burn.

fry-palace.name: Fry Palace Drive-Thru
fry-palace.desc: Drive-thru wey stand alone for bush, e still open. Gulls and raccoons dey control di parking lot.

gutterball-lanes.name: Gutterball Lanes
gutterball-lanes.desc: Bowling alley wey no get wall, no get roof. Di lanes still get oil and di pins still dey stand.

ketchup-bog.name: Ketchup Swamp
ketchup-bog.desc: Hot red swamp. Ketchup puddles dey burn and slow you.

mash-swamp.name: Mash Swamp
mash-swamp.desc: Mashed potato reach knee. E dey slow Tibo down.

peel-forest.name: Peel Forest
peel-forest.desc: Trees wey get bark like potato peel. Thorn bush dey scratch.

potato-field.name: Potato Farm
potato-field.desc: Potato plants line up neat neat. Na here every game dey start.

russet-moor.name: Red Potato Bush
russet-moor.desc: Misty bush land wey get heather, standing stones and one broken windmill. Di packs dey hunt here.

vinegar-shoals.name: Vinegar Shore
vinegar-shoals.desc: Golden beach of wet sand and sour pools. Something dey dig under di shallow water.

duchess-gardens.name: Duchess Gardens
duchess-gardens.desc: Maze of trimmed hedges wey get jade-green lawns and grey gravel paths. Na here Di Palace dey receive visitors.

roast-caldera.name: Roast Caldera
roast-caldera.desc: Pale ash dey cover one caldera wey dey cool, and small-small gutters of slow lava cut am. Di Shell beasts wey wear armour dey waka pass inside am.

harvest-moon.name: Harvest Moon
harvest-moon.announce: Harvest Moon: double gold for 30 s

loose-change.name: Loose Change
loose-change.announce: Loose change dey inside di dryers: double gold for 20 s

lost-saucer.name: Lost Saucer
lost-saucer.announce: Lost saucer! Shoot am down for gold!

lunch-rush.name: Lunch Rush
lunch-rush.announce: Lunch rush! Gulls dey dive across di car park!

strike.name: Strike
strike.announce: Strike! Bowling balls dey roll come from every side!

crab-tide.name: Crab Wahala
crab-tide.announce: Crab wahala! Crabs dey rush come from every side!

big-gust.name: Big Breeze
big-gust.announce: Breeze dey pull every gem, coin and snack come meet Tibo!

fry-rush.name: Fries Rush
fry-rush.announce: Weapons dey fire 30% faster for 15 s!

picnic.name: Picnic
picnic.announce: Snacks dey rain around Tibo for 10 s!

beagle.name: Scout
beagle.desc: E dey point to di nearest crate, shrine or dog, and e dey find gold wey scatter.

collie.name: Moss
collie.desc: Every few seconds, e dey push di enemies wey surround you back.

corgi.name: Waffles
corgi.desc: E dey bark every few seconds and freeze enemies wey near (ogas no dey freeze).

dachshund.name: Frank
dachshund.desc: E dey dig gold every few seconds, and sometimes snack or one Change.

greyhound.name: Zoom
greyhound.desc: Every few seconds, e dey run through line of enemies and wound all of dem.

pomchi.name: Zelda
pomchi.desc: E dey mark di nearest elite or loot runner so e go take more damage.

pomeranian.name: Link
